The one meaning of every null, absence and optional:
- `imagePinFor`'s `e: undefined`: no tree entry at the image's resolved path (refused `absent`). `ImagePin.draft` is true exactly when `pin.kind === 'draft'` (kept as the architecture names it, and pinned equal by every `imagePinFor` case). `uncommittedNotShown` is true exactly on a committed page in a ref view whose image `admitDraft` admits.
- `FetchQueue.run`'s `signal` absent: the caller never aborts the job (`dispose` still can). `createFetchQueue`'s `concurrency` absent: `DOCS_PWA_FETCH_CONCURRENCY`.
- `showBytes`'s `null`: the answer holds no bytes in the field its encoding names (missing, or base64 that does not decode). Never an empty file.
- `downloadDocFile`'s `loaders` absent: `api.docs`. Its answer is `{s: 'ok', value: undefined}` once the click is made, the loader's own failure arm unchanged, or `{s: 'failed', body: {ok: false, failure: 'malformed-answer', why: DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES}}`.
- `DocsAssetContext`'s `null` (the default): `DocImage` is outside a Docs page and refuses every image (`outside-page`); so does a `DocImage` with no `DocLinkContext`.
- `DetachedUrls.imageIndex: null` (an element `detachUrls` did not number, which no `img` is): the image waits behind **Load image** (fail closed).
**Decisions this task makes** (each pinned by a case below; refinements, not deviations: none contradicts the spec's text):

1. **A page is a draft page exactly when its own leaf opens a draft**, which `imagePinFor` asks of Task 5's `pinFor` (`pinFor(tree, page)?.kind === 'draft'`), so the rule for "which bytes this leaf shows" is derived once for the leaf and once for its images. A page whose leaf is not in the tree is committed (a committed page never resolves a draft). `docsLinks.ts` therefore imports `useDocsVisit.ts`, whose own imports never reach back (no cycle); its header now says "no React state or hook" instead of "no React".
2. **Raster bytes are `Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>`**, not the architecture's bare `Uint8Array`: under TypeScript 6's DOM lib a `Blob` part must be `ArrayBuffer`-backed, and Task 2's `DocsRasterBytes` already carries that type, so the signatures follow it (measured: the bare form fails `tsc` with TS2322 at `new Blob([bytes])`).
3. **M4.U1's control is the undetached tree through the intrinsic `img`.** The architecture's control ("`CHAT_COMPONENTS` renders `img[src="/api/..."]`") no longer holds on this base: chat's `img` refuses a relative source since W4's review (`isRefusedChatImageSrc`, review 408 F6), and renders it as a link. `SHARED_COMPONENTS` has no `img`, so the same hast tree rendered with it and no `detachUrls` puts `img[src="/api/example/x"]` in the DOM, which is what the control has to show.
4. **The hostile corpus is built as hast, each source exactly as written**, because the parse rewrites some of them (it percent-encodes a backslash, so `\\evil.example` would arrive as a path, Task 6's Decision 10). The leading control character is trimmed as a browser trims it, so `\x01x.png` is `specs/x.png`, which the fixture tree does not hold: refused `absent`, no request.
5. **The refusal vocabulary is `DocImageRefusal`**, keyed so a new `resolveDocRef` or `imagePinFor` word is a compile error until it has a sentence: `outside-page`, the three `imagePinFor` words, `not-image`, `external`, `too-large`, `fragment`, `repo`, `data`, `blob`, and every `resolveDocRef` refusal. A `mailto:` source is `scheme` (it is no image and has no host to open).
6. **The class cap is checked against the listed size before any fetch** (spec 5.5 "Cap"): the size of the side the pin names (the draft's for a `DraftPin`, the committed side's otherwise) over `DOCS_CLASS_CAP[class]` is refused `too-large` with both in KiB; an unknown size (`null`) is left to the server's cap.
7. **The two actions are buttons**, so no URL from a document is ever written into an `href` by `DocImage`: **Open image externally** calls `openExternal` on tap; **Open in viewer** (an `html` document) and a loaded image's own tap call `navigate` with `docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, {kind: 'path', ...}))`, the image's leaf at the page's ref with `view` dropped, exactly as `DocLink` links a document.
8. **`onDraftAsset` counts by delta**: `+1` when an image starts resolving to a `DraftPin`, `-1` when it stops (unmount, or a new pin), so the provider's sum is the number of drafted embeds on screen whatever the render order. Deferred draft images count too (they are embedded, not yet loaded).
9. **The queue is FIFO; a slot frees when its job settles.** A job whose caller aborts while waiting never starts and rejects with the signal's reason; a running job sees the abort through its own signal; `dispose()` aborts what runs, rejects what waits with an `AbortError`, and refuses later jobs. A loader that ignores its signal keeps its slot until it settles (the real bound is the server's, spec 6).
10. **A load is keyed by `docsApi.file(project, pin)`**, the bytes' own API URL, used as a string key only. A new key (a replaced image) aborts the old load and revokes the object URL that run created, and a result for an older key is never shown; a raster's object URL is made only after the load is known to be current, so an aborted load leaks none. An unmount aborts the same way (Task 9's Decision 16 relies on it: nothing outlives the screen), and the queue refuses a job whose signal is already aborted; rows M29-M34 pin each of these guards.
11. **Failures are chips** (`span.doc-img-failed`, `role="img"`, `aria-label` the alt): a docs word's sentence (`failureSentence`), a client slot's (`slotSentence`), a client-built `malformed-answer` when an SVG answer holds no bytes or is another class, or `loaderFailed` naming the error when a loader rejects (a defect, shown rather than swallowed). Only `alt` and `title` of the tree's own `img` props are passed to the `<img>`.
12. **New class names, registered by Task 11**: `doc-img-refused` (spec 4.14's list), `doc-img-link` (4.11), and five this task names for the parts 4.11 describes without one: `doc-img-chip` (the `draft` and "uncommitted change not shown" chips), `doc-img-load` (**Load image**), `doc-img-loading`, `doc-img-failed`, `doc-img-action` (the two action buttons). The three buttons need Task 11's tap-target rows; nothing here styles them.
13. **`saveBytes` is synchronous to the click**: `URL.createObjectURL`, then a detached `<a download=name>`'s `click()` with no `await` and no microtask before it, then `setTimeout` revoking after `DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS`. `downloadDocFile` awaits its loader first (Download needs the bytes); part 2's Export, which has them, keeps the click's activation through the same primitive.

````ts
// Docs W5 part 1, Task 7: the Docs screen's object URLs and saves (spec 2026-10-01 5.4; M5.17's `rasterObjectUrl`,
// `downloadDocFile` and `saveBytes` clauses; refinement (t)). `rasterObjectUrl` makes an object URL of a raster's own
// canonical image type and refuses every other type; every save is an `application/octet-stream` blob clicked
// through a detached `<a download>` inside the call and revoked 30 s later; `downloadDocFile` saves every one of the
// six classes that way. `setup.ts` stubs `URL.createObjectURL` (answering `blob:mock/<n>`) and `URL.revokeObjectURL`;
// the anchor's `click` is spied so jsdom never tries to navigate. Placeholders only (`demo`, `specs/...`).
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  DOCS_API_PREFIX, DOCS_RASTER_TYPES, DOCS_REQUEST_HEADER, DOCS_REQUEST_HEADER_VALUE, contentClass, docsApi,
  type DocContentClass, type DocPin, type RasterMime,
} from '../../shared/docs';
import type { DocsFileAnswer, DocsLoaders, DocsRasterAnswer } from '../src/docs/failures';
import { DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES } from '../src/docs/docsText';
import { DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS, downloadDocFile, rasterObjectUrl, saveBytes, showBytes } from '../src/docs/objectUrls';
import { COMMIT_A, SERVED, failedAnswer, fileResponse } from './docsFixtures';

let clicks: HTMLAnchorElement[] = [];

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.mocked(URL.createObjectURL).mockClear();
  vi.mocked(URL.revokeObjectURL).mockClear();
  clicks = [];
  vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(function record(this: HTMLAnchorElement) {
    clicks.push(this);
  });
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

/** Every Blob handed to `URL.createObjectURL`, in call order. */
const blobs = (): Blob[] => vi.mocked(URL.createObjectURL).mock.calls.map(([b]) => b as Blob);
/** The URL `URL.createObjectURL` answered for its `i`th call. */
const urlOf = (i: number): string => vi.mocked(URL.createObjectURL).mock.results[i]?.value as string;
const bytesOf = async (b: Blob): Promise<number[]> => [...new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer())];

/** The declared type's own magic, built from L0's table (never spelled here), plus two bytes of body. */
const rasterBytes = (t: keyof typeof DOCS_RASTER_TYPES): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> => {
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const run of DOCS_RASTER_TYPES[t].magic[0]!) {
    for (let i = 0; i < run.bytes.length; i += 1) out[run.at + i] = run.bytes[i]!;
  }
  return new Uint8Array([...Array.from(out, (b) => b ?? 0), 0, 255]);
};

const pinAt = (path: string): DocPin =>
  ({ kind: 'committed', commit: COMMIT_A, servedRef: SERVED, section: 'specs', path });

describe('rasterObjectUrl (spec 5.4; M5.17)', () => {
  it.each(Object.entries(DOCS_RASTER_TYPES))('makes a %s object URL typed exactly from the table', async (t, row) => {
    const bytes = rasterBytes(t as keyof typeof DOCS_RASTER_TYPES);
    const url = rasterObjectUrl(bytes, row.mime);
    expect(url).toBe(urlOf(0));
    expect(url.startsWith('blob:')).toBe(true);
    expect(blobs()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(blobs()[0]!.type).toBe(row.mime);
    expect(await bytesOf(blobs()[0]!)).toEqual([...bytes]);
  });

  it.each(['image/svg+xml', 'text/html', 'application/octet-stream', 'IMAGE/PNG', 'image/png ', ''])(
    'throws for %j and makes no object URL', (mime) => {
      expect(() => rasterObjectUrl(rasterBytes('png'), mime as RasterMime)).toThrow(/is not a raster type/);
      expect(URL.createObjectURL).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
});

describe('saveBytes (spec 5.4; M5.17; refinement (t))', () => {
  it('clicks a detached <a download=name> inside the call, typed application/octet-stream, and revokes after 30 s', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const bytes = new Uint8Array([60, 104, 49, 62, 0, 255]);
    saveBytes('a.html', bytes);
    // No await between the call and these lines: the click happened inside it.
    expect(clicks).toHaveLength(1);
    const a = clicks[0]!;
    expect(a.download).toBe('a.html');
    expect(a.getAttribute('href')).toBe(urlOf(0));
    expect(a.isConnected).toBe(false);
    expect(blobs()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(blobs()[0]!.type).toBe('application/octet-stream');
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS - 1);
    expect(URL.revokeObjectURL).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    expect(URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledWith(urlOf(0));
    expect(DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS).toBe(30000);
    vi.useRealTimers();
    expect(await bytesOf(blobs()[0]!)).toEqual([60, 104, 49, 62, 0, 255]);
  });
});

describe('showBytes: a docs-show answer as bytes', () => {
  const show = fileResponse('x').show;
  it('encodes utf8 text as UTF-8', () => {
    expect([...showBytes({ ...show, encoding: 'utf8', text: 'é<' })!]).toEqual([0xc3, 0xa9, 0x3c]);
  });
  it('decodes base64 exactly, high bytes and NUL included', () => {
    expect([...showBytes({ ...show, encoding: 'base64', text: undefined, b64: 'AP88' })!]).toEqual([0, 255, 60]);
  });
  it('answers null when the field its encoding names is missing, or the base64 does not decode', () => {
    expect(showBytes({ ...show, encoding: 'utf8', text: undefined })).toBeNull();
    expect(showBytes({ ...show, encoding: 'base64', text: 'x', b64: undefined })).toBeNull();
    expect(showBytes({ ...show, encoding: 'base64', b64: '%%%' })).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('downloadDocFile (spec 5.4; M5.17): octet-stream for every class', () => {
  const PATHS: readonly (readonly [DocContentClass, string])[] = [
    ['markdown', 'a.md'], ['raster', 'i.png'], ['svg', 'd.svg'], ['html', 'm.html'], ['text', 't.txt'], ['other', 'x.pdf'],
  ];

  function loadersFor(cls: DocContentClass, path: string) {
    const raster = vi.fn<DocsLoaders['raster']>(async (): Promise<DocsRasterAnswer> =>
      ({ s: 'ok', value: { bytes: rasterBytes('png'), mime: 'image/png' } }));
    const file = vi.fn<DocsLoaders['file']>(async (): Promise<DocsFileAnswer> => {
      const r = fileResponse('<x>');
      return {
        s: 'ok',
        value: { ...r, contentClass: cls === 'raster' ? 'other' : cls, show: { ...r.show, path } },
      };
    });
    return { raster, file };
  }

  it('the six paths are the six classes', () => {
    expect(PATHS.map(([, p]) => contentClass(p))).toEqual(PATHS.map(([c]) => c));
    expect(new Set(PATHS.map(([c]) => c)).size).toBe(6);
  });
````

````tsx
// Docs W5 part 1, Task 7: the docs image policy (spec 2026-10-01 4.11, 5.4, 5.5; M4.U1, M4.U2, M4.U5, M4.U6; spec 2
// row 66). `imagePinFor` is the one pin rule; `DocImage` is the only thing that puts an image `src` in the DOM, and
// that `src` is only ever an object URL of verified raster bytes (`rasterObjectUrl`, revoked on unmount and on
// replacement) or an SVG's `data:image/svg+xml;base64,` URL (never a `blob:`), loaded through the page's queue
// (concurrency 2) from an image the pin rule admits. Everything else is a refused span with its reason. Every page is
// a placeholder (`demo`, `main`, `example-org/example-repo`, `https://evil.example`, `https://a.example`).
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { act, cleanup, fireEvent, render, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import type { Root as HastRoot } from 'hast';
import {
  DOCS_CLASS_CAP, DOCS_MAX_IMAGES_PER_PAGE, DOCS_RASTER_TYPES, docsPageUrl,
  type DocPin, type DocsEntry, type DocsPageLocation, type DocsTreeOk,
} from '../../shared/docs';
import { SHARED_COMPONENTS } from '../src/lib/markdown';
import { parseMarkdown } from '../src/lib/markdownParse';
import { renderHast } from '../src/lib/renderHast';
import { DocImage, DocsAssetContext, type DocsAssetContextValue } from '../src/docs/DocImage';
import { DocLink, DocLinkContext, type DocLinkContextValue } from '../src/docs/DocLink';
import { detachUrls, docsLocation, imagePinFor, type ImagePin } from '../src/docs/docsLinks';
import {
  DOC_IMAGE_REFUSED_SENTENCE, DOC_IMAGE_TEXT, DOCS_SHOW_NOT_SVG, failureSentence, fillSentence, kib, slotSentence,
  type DocImageRefusal,
} from '../src/docs/docsText';
import { DOCS_PWA_FETCH_CONCURRENCY, createFetchQueue, type FetchQueue } from '../src/docs/fetchQueue';
import type { DocsFileAnswer, DocsLoaders, DocsRasterAnswer } from '../src/docs/failures';
import { COMMIT_A, COMMIT_B, SERVED, draftOf, entry, failedAnswer, fileResponse, holder, pageAt, treeOk } from './docsFixtures';

const FP_2 = 'e'.repeat(64);

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.mocked(URL.createObjectURL).mockClear();
  vi.mocked(URL.revokeObjectURL).mockClear();
});

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
});

/** A PNG's own magic from L0's table (never spelled here) and two bytes of body. */
const pngBytes = (): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> =>
  new Uint8Array([...DOCS_RASTER_TYPES.png.magic[0][0].bytes, 0, 255]);

const SVG_TEXT = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><script>x()</script></svg>';
const SVG_DATA = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(SVG_TEXT);

function okSvg(text = SVG_TEXT): DocsFileAnswer {
  const r = fileResponse(text);
  return { s: 'ok', value: { ...r, contentClass: 'svg', show: { ...r.show, path: 'd.svg' } } };
}

interface Assets {
  readonly raster: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn<DocsLoaders['raster']>>;
  readonly file: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn<DocsLoaders['file']>>;
  readonly onDraftAsset: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn<(count: number) => void>>;
  readonly queue: FetchQueue;
  readonly value: DocsAssetContextValue;
}

function fakeAssets(): Assets {
  const raster = vi.fn<DocsLoaders['raster']>(async (): Promise<DocsRasterAnswer> =>
    ({ s: 'ok', value: { bytes: pngBytes(), mime: 'image/png' } }));
  const file = vi.fn<DocsLoaders['file']>(async (): Promise<DocsFileAnswer> => okSvg());
  const onDraftAsset = vi.fn<(count: number) => void>();
  const queue = createFetchQueue();
  return { raster, file, onDraftAsset, queue, value: { loaders: { raster, file }, queue, onDraftAsset } };
}

type Leaf = Extract<DocsPageLocation, { kind: 'path' }>;
const leafAt = (url: string): Leaf => {
  const p = pageAt(url);
  if (p.kind !== 'path') throw new Error(`${url} is not a leaf`);
  return p;
};

const treeOf = (src: string): HastRoot => {
  const o = parseMarkdown(src, 'docs');
  if (o.kind !== 'tree') throw new Error(`expected a tree, got ${o.kind}`);
  return o.tree;
};

/** One `<p><img src alt="x"></p>`, the source exactly as given (the parse would rewrite some of these). */
const imgTree = (src: string): HastRoot => ({
  type: 'root',
  children: [{
    type: 'element', tagName: 'p', properties: {},
    children: [{ type: 'element', tagName: 'img', properties: { src, alt: 'x' }, children: [] }],
  }],
});

interface DocOpts {
  readonly url?: string;
  readonly tree?: DocsTreeOk;
  readonly assets?: Assets;
}

/** `src` (Markdown, or a hast tree as is) detached and rendered as a Docs page body with `DocLink` and `DocImage`. */
function docUi(src: string | HastRoot, o: DocOpts = {}) {
  const page = leafAt(o.url ?? '/docs/demo/specs/a.md');
  const tree = o.tree ?? treeOk();
  const d = detachUrls(typeof src === 'string' ? treeOf(src) : src);
  const assets = o.assets ?? fakeAssets();
  const ctx: DocLinkContextValue = {
    project: page.project, pageRef: page.ref, view: page.view, section: page.section, path: page.path, tree,
    pageSource: 'committed', urls: d.urls, onFragment: vi.fn(),
  };
  const ui = (
    <article>
      <DocLinkContext value={ctx}>
        <DocsAssetContext value={assets.value}>
          {renderHast(d.tree, { components: { ...SHARED_COMPONENTS, a: DocLink, img: DocImage } })}
        </DocsAssetContext>
      </DocLinkContext>
    </article>
  );
  return { ui, assets, page, tree };
}

function renderDoc(src: string | HastRoot, o: DocOpts = {}) {
  const u = docUi(src, o);
  return { ...render(u.ui), ...u };
}

const refusedText = (why: DocImageRefusal, fields: Record<string, string> = {}): string =>
  fillSentence(DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.refused, { reason: fillSentence(DOC_IMAGE_REFUSED_SENTENCE[why], fields) });

const committedPin = (path: string, commit = COMMIT_A): DocPin =>
  ({ kind: 'committed', commit, servedRef: SERVED, section: 'specs', path });

/** The page `specs/a.md` and an image `specs/i.png`, with the drafts and per-entry overrides a case needs. */
function withImage(img: Partial<DocsEntry> = {}, pageEntry: Partial<DocsEntry> = {}, drafts = holder()): DocsTreeOk {
  return treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md', pageEntry), entry('specs', 'i.png', img)], drafts });
}

const imgs = (c: HTMLElement): HTMLImageElement[] => [...c.querySelectorAll('img')];
const loadedSrcs = (c: HTMLElement): string[] => imgs(c).map((i) => i.getAttribute('src') ?? '');
const chips = (c: HTMLElement): string[] => [...c.querySelectorAll('.doc-img-chip')].map((s) => s.textContent ?? '');

describe('imagePinFor: the one pin rule (spec 4.11; M4.U2, row 66)', () => {
  const DEFAULT = leafAt('/docs/demo/specs/a.md');
  const REF = leafAt('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main');
  const REF_COMMITTED = leafAt('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main&view=committed');
  const drafted = draftOf('modified', { fp: FP_2 });
  const img = (over: Partial<DocsEntry> = {}): DocsEntry => entry('specs', 'i.png', over);
  const draftPage = (imgOver: Partial<DocsEntry> = {}) =>
    withImage(imgOver, { draft: draftOf('modified') });

  it('no entry at the resolved path is absent, on every page', () => {
    for (const page of [DEFAULT, REF]) expect(imagePinFor(undefined, draftPage(), page)).toEqual({ ok: false, why: 'absent' });
  });

  it('a committed page takes CommittedPin(C, served) for a committed file or exec', () => {
    const t = withImage();
    for (const kind of ['file', 'exec'] as const) {
      expect(imagePinFor(img({ committed: { kind, blob: '1'.repeat(40), size: 10 } }), t, DEFAULT)).toEqual(
        { ok: true, pin: committedPin('i.png'), draft: false, uncommittedNotShown: false });
    }
  });

  it('a committed page refuses a committed symlink, a submodule, and nothing committed as absent', () => {
    const t = withImage();
    for (const committed of [
      { kind: 'symlink', blob: '1'.repeat(40), size: 10 }, { kind: 'submodule', blob: COMMIT_B, size: null }, null,
    ] as const) {
      expect(imagePinFor(img({ committed, draft: null }), t, DEFAULT)).toEqual({ ok: false, why: 'absent' });
    }
  });

  it('the default view never resolves a draft and never says "uncommitted change not shown", even on a drafted leaf', () => {
    const t = draftPage({ draft: drafted });
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, DEFAULT)).toEqual(
      { ok: true, pin: committedPin('i.png'), draft: false, uncommittedNotShown: false });
  });

  it('a ref-view page that opens committed shows committed bytes of a drafted image, and says so', () => {
    const t = withImage({ draft: drafted });
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF)).toEqual(
      { ok: true, pin: committedPin('i.png'), draft: false, uncommittedNotShown: true });
  });

  it('view=committed on a draft leaf is a committed page: committed bytes, and the note', () => {
    const t = draftPage({ draft: drafted });
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF_COMMITTED)).toEqual(
      { ok: true, pin: committedPin('i.png'), draft: false, uncommittedNotShown: true });
  });

  it('a ref view whose holder is not at the served commit overlays nothing: committed, no note', () => {
    const t = withImage({ draft: drafted }, { draft: draftOf('modified') }, holder(COMMIT_B, false));
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF)).toEqual(
      { ok: true, pin: committedPin('i.png'), draft: false, uncommittedNotShown: false });
  });

  it('a draft page takes DraftPin(branch, head, fp) for a drafted regular file, and marks it draft', () => {
    const t = draftPage({ draft: drafted });
    const want: ImagePin = {
      ok: true, draft: true, uncommittedNotShown: false,
      pin: { kind: 'draft', branch: 'main', head: COMMIT_A, section: 'specs', path: 'i.png', fp: FP_2 },
    };
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF)).toEqual(want);
    const fresh = draftPage({ committed: null, draft: draftOf('untracked', { fp: FP_2 }) });
    expect(imagePinFor(fresh.entries[1], fresh, REF)).toEqual(want);
  });

  it('a draft page takes the committed side of an image with no draft, under the same file condition', () => {
    const t = draftPage();
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF)).toEqual(
      { ok: true, pin: committedPin('i.png'), draft: false, uncommittedNotShown: false });
    const link = draftPage({ committed: { kind: 'symlink', blob: '1'.repeat(40), size: 4 } });
    expect(imagePinFor(link.entries[1], link, REF)).toEqual({ ok: false, why: 'absent' });
  });

  it('a draft page refuses a deleted draft as deleted-in-worktree', () => {
    const t = draftPage({ draft: draftOf('deleted', { kind: 'absent', fp: null, size: null }) });
    expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF)).toEqual({ ok: false, why: 'deleted-in-worktree' });
  });

  it('a draft page refuses a withheld or type-changed draft, never falling back to the committed bytes', () => {
    for (const d of [
      draftOf('modified', { fp: null }), draftOf('modified', { kind: 'symlink', fp: null }),
      draftOf('typechange', { kind: 'symlink', fp: null }), draftOf('modified', { kind: 'unreadable', fp: null }),
    ]) {
      const t = draftPage({ draft: d });
      expect(imagePinFor(t.entries[1], t, REF)).toEqual({ ok: false, why: 'draft-withheld' });
    }
  });
});

describe('M4.U1: nothing hostile becomes src, and nothing is fetched for it', () => {
  const CASES: readonly (readonly [string, string, DocImageRefusal])[] = [
    ['a root-relative API path', '/api/example/x', 'root-relative'],
    ['a protocol-relative host', '//evil.example/x.png', 'protocol-relative'],
    ['an https image', 'https://evil.example/x.png', 'external'],
    ['a data: image', 'data:image/png;base64,AAAA', 'data'],
    ['a blob: URL', 'blob:https://a.example/x', 'blob'],
    ['a javascript: URL', 'javascript:alert(1)', 'scheme'],
    ['a leading control character (trimmed as a browser would, then no such entry)', String.fromCharCode(1) + 'x.png', 'absent'],
    ['a backslash form', '\\\\evil.example\\x.png', 'malformed'],
    ['a climb above the repository', '../../../../x.png', 'above-root'],
    ['an in-repo file outside the sections', '../../README.png', 'repo'],
    ['an empty source', '', 'empty'],
    ['a mailto: URL', 'mailto:you@example.com', 'scheme'],
    ['a fragment', '#fn-1', 'fragment'],

  it.each(CASES)('%s (%j): no img, no loader call, one refused span with its reason', async (_name, src, why) => {
    const { container, assets } = renderDoc(imgTree(src));

    expect(refused[0]!.getAttribute('role')).toBe('img');

    const { container } = render(<>{renderHast(imgTree('/api/example/x'), { components: SHARED_COMPONENTS })}</>);
    expect(container.querySelector('img[src="/api/example/x"]')).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('an https image offers "Open image externally", which opens it on tap only', () => {
    const open = vi.spyOn(window, 'open').mockReturnValue(null);

    expect(open).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    fireEvent.click(getByRole('button', { name: DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.openExternal }));
    expect(open).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://evil.example/x.png', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  });

  it('a document that is not an image is refused not-image; an html one offers "Open in viewer" onto its leaf', async () => {
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md'), entry('specs', 'm.html'), entry('specs', 'b.md')] });
    const { container, getByRole, queryAllByRole, assets } = renderDoc('![m](m.html) ![b](b.md)',
      { tree, url: '/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main' });
    await act(async () => {});
    const refused = [...container.querySelectorAll('span.doc-img-refused')].map((s) => s.textContent);
    expect(refused).toEqual([refusedText('not-image'), refusedText('not-image')]);
    expect(queryAllByRole('button', { name: DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.openViewer })).toHaveLength(1);
    fireEvent.click(getByRole('button', { name: DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.openViewer }));
    expect(location.pathname + location.search).toBe('/docs/demo/specs/m.html?ref=main');
    expect(assets.raster).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(assets.file).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('an image listed over its class cap is refused too-large before any fetch; at the cap it loads', async () => {
    const cap = DOCS_CLASS_CAP.raster;
    const big = renderDoc('![i](i.png)', { tree: withImage({ committed: { kind: 'file', blob: '1'.repeat(40), size: cap + 1 } }) });
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(big.container.querySelector('span.doc-img-refused')?.textContent)
      .toBe(refusedText('too-large', { size: kib(cap + 1), cap: kib(cap) }));
    expect(big.assets.raster).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    cleanup();
    const atCap = renderDoc('![i](i.png)', { tree: withImage({ committed: { kind: 'file', blob: '1'.repeat(40), size: cap } }) });
    await waitFor(() => expect(imgs(atCap.container)).toHaveLength(1));
  });

  it('outside a Docs page every image is refused, and nothing is fetched', () => {
    const d = detachUrls(treeOf('![i](i.png)'));
    const bare = render(<>{renderHast(d.tree, { components: { ...SHARED_COMPONENTS, img: DocImage } })}</>);
    expect(bare.container.querySelector('span.doc-img-refused')?.textContent).toBe(refusedText('outside-page'));
    cleanup();
    const page = leafAt('/docs/demo/specs/a.md');
    const ctx: DocLinkContextValue = {
      project: 'demo', pageRef: null, view: 'effective', section: 'specs', path: 'a.md', tree: withImage(),
      pageSource: 'committed', urls: d.urls, onFragment: vi.fn(),

    const noAssets = render(
      <DocLinkContext value={ctx}>{renderHast(d.tree, { components: { ...SHARED_COMPONENTS, img: DocImage } })}</DocLinkContext>);
    expect(page.kind).toBe('path');
    expect(imgs(noAssets.container)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(noAssets.container.querySelector('span.doc-img-refused')?.textContent).toBe(refusedText('outside-page'));
  });
});

    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelector('span.doc-img-failed')).not.toBeNull());
    const want = answer.s === 'failed' ? failureSentence(answer.body) : slotSentence(answer);
    expect(container.querySelector('span.doc-img-failed')!.textContent).toBe(want);
    expect(container.querySelector('span.doc-img-failed')!.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('i');
    expect(imgs(container)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('a loader that rejects is a chip naming the error', async () => {
    const assets = fakeAssets();
    assets.raster.mockRejectedValue(new Error('boom'));
    const { container } = renderDoc('![i](i.png)', { tree: withImage(), assets });
    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelector('span.doc-img-failed')).not.toBeNull());
    expect(container.querySelector('span.doc-img-failed')!.textContent).toBe(
      fillSentence(DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.loaderFailed, { error: 'boom' }));
  });
});

describe('the per-screen fetch queue (spec 4.11: concurrency 2)', () => {
  /** A job that waits until `release(i)`; `started` lists the jobs that began, in order. */
  function gate() {
    const started: number[] = [];
    const releases = new Map<number, () => void>();
    const job = (i: number) => (signal: AbortSignal) => new Promise<number>((resolve, reject) => {
      started.push(i);
      releases.set(i, () => resolve(i));
      signal.addEventListener('abort', () => reject(signal.reason));
    });
    return { started, job, release: (i: number) => releases.get(i)!() };
  }

  it('runs two at a time by default, in order, and starts the next when one settles', async () => {
    expect(DOCS_PWA_FETCH_CONCURRENCY).toBe(2);
    const q = createFetchQueue();
    const g = gate();
    const done = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => q.run(g.job(i)));
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(g.started).toEqual([0, 1]);
    g.release(1);
    await expect(done[1]).resolves.toBe(1);
    expect(g.started).toEqual([0, 1, 2]);
    g.release(0);
    await expect(done[0]).resolves.toBe(0);
    expect(g.started).toEqual([0, 1, 2, 3]);
  });

  it('a failed job frees its slot', async () => {
    const q = createFetchQueue(1);
    const ran: string[] = [];
    const a = q.run(async () => { ran.push('a'); throw new Error('x'); });
    const b = q.run(async () => { ran.push('b'); return 'b'; });
    await expect(a).rejects.toThrow('x');
    await expect(b).resolves.toBe('b');
    expect(ran).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
  });

  it('a waiting job whose signal aborts never runs and rejects with the reason; the next one runs', async () => {
    const q = createFetchQueue(1);
    const g = gate();
    const first = q.run(g.job(0));
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    const second = q.run(g.job(1), ctl.signal);
    const third = q.run(g.job(2));
    ctl.abort(new Error('gone'));
    await expect(second).rejects.toThrow('gone');
    g.release(0);
    await first;
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(g.started).toEqual([0, 2]);
    g.release(2);
    await expect(third).resolves.toBe(2);
  });

  it('a job whose signal is already aborted never starts and rejects with its reason', async () => {
    const q = createFetchQueue();
    const g = gate();
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    ctl.abort(new Error('gone'));
    const p = q.run(g.job(0), ctl.signal);
    expect(g.started).toEqual([]);
    await expect(p).rejects.toThrow('gone');
  });

  it('a running job sees its caller abort through its own signal', async () => {
    const q = createFetchQueue();
    const g = gate();
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    const p = q.run(g.job(0), ctl.signal);
    await act(async () => {});
    ctl.abort(new Error('stop'));
    await expect(p).rejects.toThrow('stop');
  });

  it('dispose aborts what runs, rejects what waits, and refuses later jobs', async () => {
    const q = createFetchQueue(1);
    const g = gate();
    const running = q.run(g.job(0));
    const waiting = q.run(g.job(1));
    await act(async () => {});
    q.dispose();
    await expect(running).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' });
    await expect(waiting).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' });
    await expect(q.run(g.job(2))).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' });
    expect(g.started).toEqual([0]);
  });

  it('refuses a concurrency that is not a positive integer', () => {
    for (const c of [0, -1, 1.5, Number.NaN]) expect(() => createFetchQueue(c)).toThrow(RangeError);
  });

  it('three images with held loaders load two at a time', async () => {
    const assets = fakeAssets();
    const holds: (() => void)[] = [];
    assets.raster.mockImplementation((_project, _pin, signal) => new Promise<DocsRasterAnswer>((resolve) => {
      holds.push(() => resolve({ s: 'ok', value: { bytes: pngBytes(), mime: 'image/png' } }));
      signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => resolve({ s: 'unreachable' }));
    }));
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md'), ...['p.png', 'q.png', 'r.png'].map((p) => entry('specs', p))] });
    const { container } = renderDoc('![p](p.png) ![q](q.png) ![r](r.png)', { tree, assets });
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(assets.raster).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    await act(async () => { holds[0]!(); });
    await waitFor(() => expect(assets.raster).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3));
    await act(async () => { holds[1]!(); holds[2]!(); });
    await waitFor(() => expect(imgs(container)).toHaveLength(3));
  });

  it('unmounting an image aborts its load: the loader\'s signal is aborted, and a waiting image never reaches its loader', async () => {
    const assets = fakeAssets();
    const signals: (AbortSignal | undefined)[] = [];
    assets.raster.mockImplementation((_project, _pin, signal) => new Promise<DocsRasterAnswer>((resolve) => {
      signals.push(signal);
      signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => resolve({ s: 'unreachable' }));
    }));
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md'), ...['p.png', 'q.png', 'r.png'].map((p) => entry('specs', p))] });
    const r = renderDoc('![p](p.png) ![q](q.png) ![r](r.png)', { tree, assets });
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(assets.raster).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    r.unmount();
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(signals.map((s) => s?.aborted)).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(assets.raster).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});

describe('the DOM: no src except a created object URL or an SVG data: URL', () => {
  it('a page mixing every arm puts only blob:mock and data:image/svg+xml URLs in src, and no attribute names /api/', async () => {
    const tree = treeOk({
      entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md'), entry('specs', 'i.png'), entry('specs', 'd.svg'), entry('specs', 'm.html')],

});
````

````ts
/** Which bytes a Markdown image on a Docs page may show (spec 4.11's pin rule). `ok`: `pin` names them; `draft` is
 *  true exactly when `pin` is a `DraftPin` (the image wears the `draft` chip and counts in the page banner);
 *  `uncommittedNotShown` is true exactly when a committed page in a ref view shows the committed bytes of an image
 *  whose draft would overlay there ("uncommitted change not shown"). Not ok, each one reason: `absent` (no entry at
 *  the path, or the side the rule needs is not a committed file or exec), `deleted-in-worktree` (a draft page whose
 *  image the worktree deletes), `draft-withheld` (a draft page whose image's draft is withheld or a type change: the
 *  committed bytes are never shown in its place). */
export type ImagePin =
  | { ok: true; pin: DocPin; draft: boolean; uncommittedNotShown: boolean }
  | { ok: false; why: 'absent' | 'deleted-in-worktree' | 'draft-withheld' };

/** THE pin rule for a page's images (spec 4.11; the ONE derivation: `DocImage` now, Export in part 2, the W6 mockup
 *  planner). `e` is the tree entry at the image's resolved path; `undefined` means there is none. The page is a DRAFT
 *  page exactly when its own leaf opens a draft (`pinFor` answers a `DraftPin`); every other page is committed (the
 *  default view, `view=committed`, a ref-view leaf that opens committed, and a page whose leaf is not in the tree).
 *  - committed page: a committed file or exec gives `CommittedPin(ref.commit, ref.served)`, else `absent`; in a ref
 *    view an image whose draft `admitDraft` admits is marked `uncommittedNotShown`. A draft is never resolved.
 *  - draft page (an admitted holder at the served commit): no draft on the image gives the committed side under the
 *    same condition; a deleted draft is `deleted-in-worktree`; a draft `entryView` opens gives
 *    `DraftPin(drafts.branch, worktree head, fp)`; any other draft is `draft-withheld`. */
export function imagePinFor(
  e: DocsEntry | undefined, tree: DocsTreeOk, page: DocsPageLocation & { kind: 'path' },
): ImagePin {
  if (e === undefined) return { ok: false, why: 'absent' };
  const drafts = tree.drafts;
  const committed = (uncommittedNotShown: boolean): ImagePin => {
    const kind = e.committed?.kind;
    if (kind !== 'file' && kind !== 'exec') return { ok: false, why: 'absent' };
    const pin: DocPin = {
      kind: 'committed', commit: tree.ref.commit, servedRef: tree.ref.served, section: e.section, path: e.path,
    };
    return { ok: true, pin, draft: false, uncommittedNotShown };
  };
  if (pinFor(tree, page)?.kind !== 'draft') return committed(page.ref !== null && admitDraft(e, drafts));
  const draft = e.draft;
  if (draft === null) return committed(false);
  if (draft.state === 'deleted') return { ok: false, why: 'deleted-in-worktree' };
  if (entryView(e, drafts, 'ref').opens !== 'draft' || drafts.state !== 'holder' || draft.fp === null) {
    return { ok: false, why: 'draft-withheld' };
  }
  const pin: DocPin = {
    kind: 'draft', branch: drafts.branch, head: drafts.worktree.head, section: e.section, path: e.path, fp: draft.fp,
  };
  return { ok: true, pin, draft: true, uncommittedNotShown: false };
}
````

- [ ] **Step 6: The queue.** Create `pwa/src/docs/fetchQueue.ts` with exactly:

````ts
// The Docs screen's per-screen fetch queue (spec 2026-10-01 4.11 "Loading"; W5 part 1 Task 7). Every image a page
// loads, and from W6 every mockup asset, runs through one queue a `DocsScreen` owns, at most
// `DOCS_PWA_FETCH_CONCURRENCY` at a time, first come first served. The real bound is the server's (spec 6); this one
// keeps one page from opening thirty requests at once. No module state: each screen makes its own.

/** Requests one Docs screen runs at once (spec 4.11: "concurrency 2"). */
export const DOCS_PWA_FETCH_CONCURRENCY = 2;

/** One screen's queue.
 *  - `run(job, signal)`: `job` starts when a slot is free and receives a signal of its own, which aborts when the
 *    caller's `signal` aborts or the queue is disposed; the promise follows the job. A job whose caller aborts while
 *    it is still waiting never starts, and the promise rejects with the signal's reason. `signal` absent means the
 *    caller never aborts it (dispose still can).
 *  - `dispose()`: aborts every running job's signal, rejects every waiting job with an `AbortError`, and makes every
 *    later `run` reject with one. A slot frees only when its job settles, so a job that ignores its signal keeps its
 *    slot until it does. */
export interface FetchQueue {
  run<T>(job: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T>;
  dispose(): void;
}

const disposedError = (): DOMException => new DOMException('The Docs fetch queue was disposed.', 'AbortError');

/** A queue running at most `concurrency` jobs at once (a positive integer; anything else throws a RangeError). */
export function createFetchQueue(concurrency: number = DOCS_PWA_FETCH_CONCURRENCY): FetchQueue {
  if (!Number.isInteger(concurrency) || concurrency < 1) {
    throw new RangeError(`createFetchQueue: concurrency must be a positive integer, not ${String(concurrency)}`);
  }
  let running = 0;
  let disposed = false;
  const waiting: { start: () => void; drop: (reason: unknown) => void }[] = [];
  const live = new Set<AbortController>();

  const pump = (): void => {
    while (running < concurrency && waiting.length > 0) waiting.shift()!.start();
  };

  return {
    run<T>(job: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
      return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
        if (disposed) {
          reject(disposedError());
          return;
        }
        if (signal?.aborted === true) {
          reject(signal.reason);
          return;
        }
        const ctl = new AbortController();
        const onAbort = (): void => {
          const at = waiting.indexOf(entry);
          if (at >= 0) {
            waiting.splice(at, 1);
            reject(signal!.reason);
          } else {
            ctl.abort(signal!.reason);
          }
        };
        const entry = {
          start: (): void => {
            running += 1;
            live.add(ctl);
            let p: Promise<T>;
            try {
              p = job(ctl.signal);
            } catch (err) {
              p = Promise.reject(err);
            }
            void p.then(resolve, reject).finally(() => {
              running -= 1;
              live.delete(ctl);
              signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
              pump();
            });
          },
          drop: (reason: unknown): void => {
            signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
            reject(reason);
          },
        };
        signal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
        waiting.push(entry);
        pump();
      });
    },
    dispose(): void {
      disposed = true;
      for (const w of waiting.splice(0)) w.drop(disposedError());
      for (const ctl of live) ctl.abort(disposedError());
    },
  };
}
````

- [ ] **Step 7: Object URLs and saves.** Create `pwa/src/docs/objectUrls.ts` with exactly:

````ts
// The Docs screen's object URLs and saves (spec 2026-10-01 5.4; W5 part 1 Task 7; refinement (t)). This file is the
// ONLY place under `pwa/src/docs` and `pwa/src/lib/markdown*` that calls `URL.createObjectURL` or builds a `Blob`. A
// raster gets an object URL typed exactly as L0's raster table says; every save is an `application/octet-stream` blob,
// clicked through a detached `<a download>` inside the call and revoked 30 s later. It never makes a `blob:` URL of
// SVG, HTML or any other active type: opened top-level, such a URL is a same-origin document carrying the session
// (spec 5.4, E6). An SVG on a page is a `data:` URL instead (`DocImage`, spec 5.5).
import { DOCS_RASTER_TYPES, contentClass, type DocPin, type DocsShowOk, type RasterMime } from '../../../shared/docs';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES } from './docsText';
import type { DocsAnswer, DocsLoaders } from './failures';

/** The four raster MIME types, from the table and nowhere else. */
const RASTER_MIMES: readonly RasterMime[] = Object.values(DOCS_RASTER_TYPES).map((t) => t.mime);

/** The one type every save is built with (spec 5.4: an octet-stream blob downloads; it never renders). */
const OCTET_STREAM = 'application/octet-stream';

/** How long a save's object URL lives after its click (spec 5.4: "revokes the URL after 30 s"). */
export const DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS = 30000;

/** An object URL for verified raster bytes (spec 5.4). The Blob's type is the table's own string for `mime`, and any
 *  `mime` that is not one of the four table values, by exact comparison, THROWS: a programming error, never an image.
 *  The caller revokes the URL when the image goes. */
export function rasterObjectUrl(bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>, mime: RasterMime): string {
  const type = RASTER_MIMES.find((m) => m === mime);
  if (type === undefined) throw new Error(`rasterObjectUrl: '${String(mime)}' is not a raster type`);
  return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type }));
}

/** THE save primitive (spec 5.4, amended 2026-10-13): `bytes` as an `application/octet-stream` blob, clicked through a
 *  detached `<a download=name>` synchronously inside this call (no `await` anywhere before the click, so a click
 *  handler that calls it keeps its user activation), the URL revoked `DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS` later. */
export function saveBytes(name: string, bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: OCTET_STREAM }));
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), DOCS_SAVE_REVOKE_MS);
}

/** A docs-show answer's bytes: `utf8` text encoded as UTF-8, `base64` decoded. `null` has ONE meaning: the answer
 *  holds no bytes in the field its encoding names (the field is missing, or the base64 does not decode). */
export function showBytes(show: DocsShowOk): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> | null {
  if (show.encoding === 'base64') {
    if (typeof show.b64 !== 'string') return null;
    let binary: string;
    try {
      binary = atob(show.b64);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    const out = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i += 1) out[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return out;
  }
  return typeof show.text === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(show.text) : null;
}

/** Download (spec 5.4): a file's original bytes, saved through `saveBytes` as `basename`, octet-stream for EVERY class.
 *  A raster path reads through `loaders.raster`, every other through `loaders.file`; `loaders` absent means `api.docs`.
 *  Answers `{s: 'ok'}` once the click is made, the loader's own failure as is (nothing saved), or a client-built
 *  `malformed-answer` when a docs-show answer holds no bytes. */
export async function downloadDocFile(project: string, pin: DocPin, basename: string,
  loaders: Pick<DocsLoaders, 'file' | 'raster'> = api.docs): Promise<DocsAnswer<void>> {
  let bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
  if (contentClass(pin.path) === 'raster') {
    const answer = await loaders.raster(project, pin);
    if (answer.s !== 'ok') return answer;
    bytes = answer.value.bytes;
  } else {
    const answer = await loaders.file(project, pin);
    if (answer.s !== 'ok') return answer;
    const shown = showBytes(answer.value.show);
    if (shown === null) {
      return { s: 'failed', body: { ok: false, failure: 'malformed-answer', why: DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES } };
    }
    bytes = shown;
  }
  saveBytes(basename, bytes);
  return { s: 'ok', value: undefined };
}
````

- [ ] **Step 8: The image.** Create `pwa/src/docs/DocImage.tsx` with exactly:

````tsx
// The Markdown `img` of a Docs page (spec 2026-10-01 4.11, 5.4, 5.5; W5 part 1 Task 7) and the context it loads
// through. `DocImage` is, with `DocLink`, the only way a URL reaches the DOM from a document: `detachUrls` took the
// image's `src` into the map, and `DocImage` reads it back through its `node`, resolves it with L0 `resolveDocRef`,
// asks `imagePinFor` which bytes the page may show, and loads them through the screen's queue. The only `src` it ever
// writes is an object URL of verified raster bytes (`rasterObjectUrl`, revoked on unmount and on replacement) or an
// SVG's `data:image/svg+xml;base64,` URL (never a `blob:`); everything else is a refused span with its reason.
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ComponentProps, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Element as HastElement } from 'hast';
import {
  DOCS_CLASS_CAP, DOCS_MAX_IMAGES_PER_PAGE, contentClass, docsApi, docsPageUrl, resolveDocRef,
  type DocPin, type DocsPageLocation, type RasterMime,
} from '../../../shared/docs';
import { openExternal } from '../lib/markdown';
import { navigate } from '../lib/router';
import { DocLinkContext, type DocLinkContextValue } from './DocLink';
import { docsLocation, imagePinFor } from './docsLinks';
import {
  DOC_IMAGE_REFUSED_SENTENCE, DOC_IMAGE_TEXT, DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES, DOCS_SHOW_NOT_SVG, failureSentence, fillSentence,
  kib, slotSentence, type DocImageRefusal,
} from './docsText';
import type { FetchQueue } from './fetchQueue';
import type { DocsLoaders, DocsNotOk } from './failures';
import { rasterObjectUrl, showBytes } from './objectUrls';

/** What a Docs page gives its images (refinement (p)): the loaders, the screen's one queue, and the banner's counter.
 *  `onDraftAsset(delta)` is called with `+1` when an image starts resolving to a `DraftPin` and `-1` when it stops
 *  (unmount, or a new pin), so the sum is the number of drafted embeds on screen ("This draft page embeds {k}
 *  uncommitted asset{s}"). The provider keeps `loaders`, `queue` and `onDraftAsset` stable across renders: a new
 *  `loaders` or `queue` loads every image again. */
export interface DocsAssetContextValue {
  readonly loaders: Pick<DocsLoaders, 'file' | 'raster'>;
  readonly queue: FetchQueue;
  readonly onDraftAsset: (count: number) => void;
}

/** `null`, the default, has ONE meaning: `DocImage` is rendered outside a Docs page, and refuses every image. */
export const DocsAssetContext = createContext<DocsAssetContextValue | null>(null);

type Leaf = Extract<DocsPageLocation, { kind: 'path' }>;

/** What one image is. `refused`: its reason, the fields its sentence takes, and the one action it offers (`external`
 *  opens the URL on tap; `viewer` opens the document's own leaf in-app; `null`, none). `pinned`: the bytes the pin rule
 *  gives, the class that says how to load them, the chips, the image's own leaf, and whether it waits for Load image
 *  (its index at or past `DOCS_MAX_IMAGES_PER_PAGE`, or no index recorded). */
type ImagePlan =
  | { kind: 'refused'; why: DocImageRefusal; fields: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
      action: { kind: 'external' | 'viewer'; href: string } | null }
  | { kind: 'pinned'; pin: DocPin; cls: 'raster' | 'svg'; draft: boolean; uncommittedNotShown: boolean;
      leafHref: string; deferred: boolean };

const refused = (why: DocImageRefusal, action: Extract<ImagePlan, { kind: 'refused' }>['action'] = null,
  fields: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {}): ImagePlan => ({ kind: 'refused', why, fields, action });

/** The page the image sits on, as the leaf location `imagePinFor` reads (its project, ref and view). */
function leafOf(ctx: DocLinkContextValue): Leaf {
  const loc = docsLocation({ kind: 'project', project: ctx.project, ref: ctx.pageRef },
    { kind: 'path', section: ctx.section, path: ctx.path, dirSlash: false, view: ctx.view });
  if (loc.kind !== 'path') throw new Error('DocImage: a path target built a page that is not a leaf');
  return loc;
}

/** The one decision for an image (spec 4.11, "Markdown `img`"), from the `src` `detachUrls` moved off it. */
function planImage(ctx: DocLinkContextValue, node: HastElement | undefined): ImagePlan {
  const recorded = node === undefined ? undefined : ctx.urls.get(node);
  const r = resolveDocRef({ section: ctx.section, path: ctx.path }, recorded?.attrs['src'] ?? '');
  switch (r.kind) {
    case 'doc':
      break;
    case 'external':
      return r.scheme === 'mailto' ? refused('scheme') : refused('external', { kind: 'external', href: r.url });
    case 'fragment':
      return refused('fragment');
    case 'repo':
      return refused('repo');
    case 'self-contained':
      return refused(r.scheme);
    case 'refused':
      return refused(r.why);
  }
  const page = leafOf(ctx);
  // The image's own leaf at the page's ref, `view` dropped, exactly as `DocLink` links a document.
  const leafHref = docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, { kind: 'path', section: r.section, path: r.path, dirSlash: false }));
  const cls = contentClass(r.path);
  if (cls !== 'raster' && cls !== 'svg') {
    return refused('not-image', cls === 'html' ? { kind: 'viewer', href: leafHref } : null);
  }
  const e = ctx.tree.entries.find((x) => x.section === r.section && x.path === r.path);
  const ip = imagePinFor(e, ctx.tree, page);
  if (!ip.ok) return refused(ip.why);
  const size = ip.pin.kind === 'draft' ? e?.draft?.size : e?.committed?.size;
  const cap = DOCS_CLASS_CAP[cls];
  if (typeof size === 'number' && size > cap) return refused('too-large', null, { size: kib(size), cap: kib(cap) });
  const index = recorded?.imageIndex ?? null;
  return {
    kind: 'pinned', pin: ip.pin, cls, draft: ip.draft, uncommittedNotShown: ip.uncommittedNotShown, leafHref,
    deferred: index === null || index >= DOCS_MAX_IMAGES_PER_PAGE,
  };
}

/** One load: `key` is the bytes' own API URL (`docsApi.file`), unique per project and pin. */
interface LoadJob {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly project: string;
  readonly pin: DocPin;
  readonly cls: 'raster' | 'svg';
  readonly loaders: Pick<DocsLoaders, 'file' | 'raster'>;
  readonly queue: FetchQueue;
}

type Fetched =
  | { s: 'raster'; bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>; mime: RasterMime }
  | { s: 'svg'; src: string }
  | { s: 'failed'; sentence: string };

type Shown = { s: 'loading' } | { s: 'loaded'; src: string } | { s: 'failed'; sentence: string };

const SVG_DATA_PREFIX = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,';

function notOkSentence(a: DocsNotOk): string {
  return a.s === 'failed' ? failureSentence(a.body) : slotSentence(a);
}

/** Bytes as base64, in chunks small enough to spread into `String.fromCharCode`. */
function base64Of(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
  return btoa(binary);
}

/** The bytes for one job, read through its loader with the queue's signal: a raster's verified bytes and table MIME,
 *  an SVG as its `data:` URL, or the sentence of why not. */
async function fetchImage(job: LoadJob, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Fetched> {
  if (job.cls === 'raster') {
    const a = await job.loaders.raster(job.project, job.pin, signal);
    return a.s === 'ok'
      ? { s: 'raster', bytes: a.value.bytes, mime: a.value.mime }
      : { s: 'failed', sentence: notOkSentence(a) };
  }
  const a = await job.loaders.file(job.project, job.pin, signal);
  if (a.s !== 'ok') return { s: 'failed', sentence: notOkSentence(a) };
  const bytes = a.value.contentClass === 'svg' ? showBytes(a.value.show) : null;
  if (bytes === null) {
    const why = a.value.contentClass === 'svg' ? DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES : DOCS_SHOW_NOT_SVG;
    return { s: 'failed', sentence: failureSentence({ ok: false, failure: 'malformed-answer', why }) };
  }
  return { s: 'svg', src: SVG_DATA_PREFIX + base64Of(bytes) };
}

/** Runs `job` through its queue while its key stands. A new key (a replaced image) or an unmount aborts the load and
 *  revokes the object URL this run created; a result for an older key is never shown. `job: null` loads nothing. */
function useImageSrc(job: LoadJob | null): Shown {
  const [done, setDone] = useState<{ key: string; shown: Shown } | null>(null);
  const key = job === null ? null : job.key;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (job === null || key === null) return undefined;
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    let live = true;
    let created: string | null = null;
    job.queue.run((signal) => fetchImage(job, signal), ctl.signal).then((f) => {
      if (!live) return;
      if (f.s === 'raster') {
        created = rasterObjectUrl(f.bytes, f.mime);
        setDone({ key, shown: { s: 'loaded', src: created } });
      } else if (f.s === 'svg') {
        setDone({ key, shown: { s: 'loaded', src: f.src } });
      } else {
        setDone({ key, shown: f });
      }
    }, (err: unknown) => {
      if (!live) return;
      const error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      setDone({ key, shown: { s: 'failed', sentence: fillSentence(DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.loaderFailed, { error }) } });
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
      ctl.abort();
      if (created !== null) URL.revokeObjectURL(created);
    };
    // The job's other fields are fixed by its key (`docsApi.file(project, pin)` and the class its path gives).
  }, [key, job?.loaders, job?.queue]);
  return done !== null && done.key === key ? done.shown : { s: 'loading' };
}

/** The Markdown `img` of a Docs page (spec 4.11). Its source comes only from the detached map, through `node`; of the
 *  tree's own props only `alt` and `title` are passed on.
 *  - refused: `<span className="doc-img-refused" role="img" aria-label={alt}>` "Image not loaded: {reason}", plus
 *    **Open image externally** (an http or https image, opened on tap only) or **Open in viewer** (an html document's
 *    own leaf, in-app).
 *  - pinned, at or past image `DOCS_MAX_IMAGES_PER_PAGE` (index 30 and on): **Load image** until tapped.
 *  - loading, then `<button className="doc-img-link"><img src alt className="msg-img" /></button>`, whose tap opens
 *    the image's own leaf in-app, or a failure chip with its sentence; with the `draft` and "uncommitted change not
 *    shown" chips the pin rule gives. */
export function DocImage(p: ComponentProps<'img'> & { node?: HastElement }): ReactNode {
  const { node, alt, title } = p;
  const ctx = useContext(DocLinkContext);
  const assets = useContext(DocsAssetContext);
  const [asked, setAsked] = useState(false);
  const outside = ctx === null || assets === null;
  const plan = useMemo(
    () => (ctx === null || outside ? refused('outside-page') : planImage(ctx, node)), [ctx, outside, node]);
  const pinned = plan.kind === 'pinned' ? plan : null;
  const job: LoadJob | null = pinned !== null && ctx !== null && assets !== null && (!pinned.deferred || asked)
    ? {
      key: docsApi.file(ctx.project, pinned.pin), project: ctx.project, pin: pinned.pin, cls: pinned.cls,
      loaders: assets.loaders, queue: assets.queue,
    }
    : null;
  const shown = useImageSrc(job);
  const draftKey = pinned !== null && pinned.draft && ctx !== null ? docsApi.file(ctx.project, pinned.pin) : null;
  const onDraftAsset = assets?.onDraftAsset;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (draftKey === null || onDraftAsset === undefined) return undefined;
    onDraftAsset(1);
    return () => onDraftAsset(-1);
  }, [draftKey, onDraftAsset]);

  const label = alt ?? '';
  if (plan.kind === 'refused') {
    const reason = fillSentence(DOC_IMAGE_REFUSED_SENTENCE[plan.why], plan.fields);
    const action = plan.action;
    return (
      <>
        <span className="doc-img-refused" role="img" aria-label={label}>
          {fillSentence(DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.refused, { reason })}
        </span>
        {action?.kind === 'external' && (
          <>{' '}<button type="button" className="doc-img-action" onClick={(e) => openExternal(e, action.href)}>
            {DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.openExternal}
          </button></>
        )}
        {action?.kind === 'viewer' && (
          <>{' '}<button type="button" className="doc-img-action" onClick={() => navigate(action.href)}>
            {DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.openViewer}
          </button></>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }
  const chips = (
    <>
      {plan.draft && <>{' '}<span className="doc-img-chip">{DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.draft}</span></>}
      {plan.uncommittedNotShown && <>{' '}<span className="doc-img-chip">{DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.uncommittedNotShown}</span></>}
    </>
  );
  if (job === null) {
    return (
      <>
        <button type="button" className="doc-img-load" onClick={() => setAsked(true)}>{DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.load}</button>
        {chips}
      </>
    );
  }
  if (shown.s === 'loading') {
    return <><span className="doc-img-loading" role="img" aria-label={label}>{DOC_IMAGE_TEXT.loading}</span>{chips}</>;
  }
  if (shown.s === 'failed') {
    return <><span className="doc-img-failed" role="img" aria-label={label}>{shown.sentence}</span>{chips}</>;
  }
  const leafHref = plan.leafHref;
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" className="doc-img-link" onClick={() => navigate(leafHref)}>
        <img src={shown.src} alt={label} title={title} className="msg-img" />
      </button>
      {chips}
    </>
  );
}
````

```bash
git commit -m "pwa: the docs image policy, imagePinFor, DocImage, the fetch queue, raster object URLs and saveBytes (docs W5.1)" \
  -m "imagePinFor is the one pin rule for a page's images: a committed page (the default view, view=committed, a ref-view leaf that opens committed) takes CommittedPin(C, served) for a committed file or exec and never resolves a draft, marking an admitted drafted image 'uncommitted change not shown' in a ref view; a draft page (its own leaf opens a DraftPin, by pinFor) takes DraftPin(branch, head, fp) for a draft entryView opens, refuses a deleted draft as deleted-in-worktree and a withheld or type-changed one as draft-withheld, never the committed bytes in its place, and takes the committed side of an image with no draft (M4.U2, row 66)." \
  -m "DocImage reads its source only from detachUrls' map, resolves it with resolveDocRef, refuses everything but a pinned raster or SVG with 'Image not loaded: <reason>' (an https image offers Open image externally, an html document Open in viewer), checks the listed size against its class cap, defers images from index 30 behind Load image (M4.U5), and loads through the screen's FIFO queue at concurrency 2: a raster as an object URL of its table type, revoked on unmount and on replacement (M4.U6), an SVG as a data:image/svg+xml;base64 URL, never blob: (spec 5.5). Its src is never anything else (M4.U1); a tap opens the image's own leaf in-app." \
  -m "objectUrls.ts is the one createObjectURL and Blob site under pwa/src/docs: rasterObjectUrl throws for any type not in the raster table, saveBytes clicks a detached <a download> inside the call with an application/octet-stream blob and revokes it after 30 s, and downloadDocFile saves every class through it (M5.17's part 1 clauses; refinements (p), (t))." \
  -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
```

### Task 8: DocMarkdown: the render gate, the parse on docsRunner at DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_MS, the in-thread fallback, the notes and DocPlain, the doc-body boundary keyed by the pin, DOC_COMPONENTS
**Model routing:** implementer `sonnet`, effort `high`; per-task reviewer `opus` (lens 1 of "How this wave runs": untrusted documents through the shared pipeline, here the gate, the budget, the notes and the doc-body boundary; and lens 5 for mutation-table discipline). No subagent inherits a model.
**Spec rows:** M4.P9; M4.B2; the W5 halves of M4.P1 (`DocMarkdown`'s note), M4.P6 ("Format anyway posts a 30 000 job"), M4.P7 (`DocMarkdown`'s in-thread 4 KiB and its 5 KiB note) and M4.P12 (the `renderHast` spy has 0 calls, a real 500 KiB prose doc still renders, and the spec's mutation "count only after render", which W4 carried here); spec 4.10's "DocMarkdown" steps 1-6 and `DOC_COMPONENTS`; spec 4.12's doc-body mount. Refinements (d) (the element count is the parse's, so nothing here counts), (h) (the page highlight budget reaches `CodeBlock` through `PreHighlightContext`), (n) (`detachUrls` returns a copy, memoised per outcome), (p) (`DOC_COMPONENTS` lives in `docs/DocMarkdown.tsx`). The settled-outcome context of spec 4.10 (amended 2026-10-13) is part 2's (refinement (a)): nothing here publishes the outcome; the per-tree detach memo is the seam part 2 reads. Mounting `DocMarkdown` in a leaf (its header, its truth line, the base64 branch of `docMarkdownSource`) is Task 9's.
**Files:**
- Create: `pwa/src/docs/DocMarkdown.tsx` (`DOC_COMPONENTS`, `docsPlainNote`, `DocPlain`, `DocMarkdown`, `DocMarkdownProps`, `docMarkdownSource`, `DocMarkdownSource`, `docGateSentence`, `docShownAsTextNote`, `mib`, and the five sentence constants `DOC_BODY_FALLBACK_NOTE`, `DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE`, `DOC_FORMATTING`, `DOC_MARKDOWN_ACTION`).
- Test: `pwa/test/docs-markdown.test.tsx` (new: 45 cases; `vi.mock` wraps `lib/renderHast` with a spy that a case can make throw).
- Modify: nothing. Every file this task reads (`lib/markdown.tsx`, `lib/markdownParse.ts`, `lib/markdownRunner.ts`, `lib/useParsedMarkdown.ts`, `lib/renderHast.tsx`, `components/RenderBoundary.tsx`, `docs/DocLink.tsx`, `docs/DocImage.tsx`, `docs/docsLinks.ts`, `docs/objectUrls.ts`) is left exactly as Tasks 3-7 left it.

Produces (`pwa/src/docs/DocMarkdown.tsx`):

```ts
export const DOC_COMPONENTS: Components = { ...SHARED_COMPONENTS, a: DocLink, img: DocImage };
export const DOC_BODY_FALLBACK_NOTE = 'This document could not be displayed; shown as plain text.';
export const DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE = 'Not valid UTF-8.';
export const DOC_FORMATTING = 'Formatting…';
export const DOC_MARKDOWN_ACTION: { readonly formatAnyway: 'Format anyway'; readonly showAsText: 'Show as text'; readonly retry: 'Retry' };
export function mib(bytes: number): string;                        // 614 400 -> '0.6 MiB'
export function docGateSentence(bytes: number): string;            // 'This document is 0.6 MiB. Formatting it may take a while.'
export function docShownAsTextNote(bytes: number): string;         // 'This document is 0.6 MiB; shown as plain text, as asked.'
export function docsPlainNote(o: Exclude<ParseOutcome, { kind: 'tree' }>): string;   // exhaustive switch, one note per kind
export function DocPlain(p: { readonly text: string; readonly note: string; readonly action?: ReactNode }): ReactNode;
//   <p className="doc-plain-note">{note}</p>, then `action` (absent = no action), then <pre className="doc-plain">{text}</pre>
export type DocMarkdownSource =
  | { readonly kind: 'markdown'; readonly text: string }   // utf8 as sent, or base64 that decodes as strict UTF-8
  | { readonly kind: 'not-utf8'; readonly text: string }   // base64 that is not UTF-8, decoded non-fatally (U+FFFD)
  | { readonly kind: 'no-bytes' };                         // the field the encoding names is missing, or bad base64
export function docMarkdownSource(show: DocsShowOk): DocMarkdownSource;
export interface DocMarkdownProps {
  readonly text: string;
  readonly pinKey: string;                                  // the doc-body boundary's resetKey; the caller ALSO keys DocMarkdown by it
  readonly parser: MarkdownParser;
  readonly link: Omit<DocLinkContextValue, 'urls'>;        // DocMarkdown adds the detached `urls`
}
export function DocMarkdown(p: DocMarkdownProps): ReactNode;
```

No `null` crosses this file's seams: `DocPlain`'s `action` is optional with one meaning (absent: no action), and every other field is required. The one internal `null` (`inThread`, inside `DocParse`) means "no in-thread parse was made", and never leaves the component.

**Decisions this task makes** (each pinned by a case below; refinements, not deviations, except Decision 6, which departs from spec 4.10 step 6's text: it is refinement (x), the plan's fifth deviation, which Task 12's last step defines (coordinator ruling during planning, 2026-10-13)):

1. **The gate holds the parser by not mounting the hook.** `useParsedMarkdown` starts a job in its mount effect, so `DocMarkdown` is two components: the gate's choice state above (`'ask' | 'format' | 'large' | 'text'`, initially `'ask'` exactly when the UTF-8 size is OVER `DOCS_RENDER_GATE_BYTES`), and the module-private `DocParse` below it, the only caller of the hook. While the gate is up nothing is parsed (M4.P9, 0 calls); **Format anyway** mounts `DocParse` at `DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_LARGE_MS` (M4.P6's W5 half, measured through a real runner whose budget timer is the spy); **Show as text** never mounts it. A document of exactly `DOCS_RENDER_GATE_BYTES` is not gated (spec: "over").
2. **The normal budget is `DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_MS(utf8ByteLength(text))`**, measured once per text; the case includes 32 Ki two-byte characters (64 KiB, 3 s), so a length-based budget (2 s) is red.
3. **The doc-body boundary wraps the article only**: the module-private `DocTree` (which detaches and calls `renderHast`) sits inside `<RenderBoundary where="doc body" resetKey={pinKey} fallback={() => <DocPlain text note={DOC_BODY_FALLBACK_NOTE} />}>`, and the parse hook sits above it, so a renderer throw keeps the parse and its outcome; the same pin keeps the fallback, a new pin resets it (M4.B2). The caller keys `DocMarkdown` by the pin too (Task 9), so a new pin also aborts a stale job; the boundary's own key is what the case proves.
4. **One note per outcome**, from `docsPlainNote`, exhaustive over the seven non-tree kinds: the spec's sentences verbatim (refused container-depth, `too-wide`), and its fragments (`threw` "could not be formatted ({error})", `timeout` "Formatting took longer than {s} s") completed in the same form, every note ending "; shown as plain text.". Numbers are grouped by three with a space, as the spec writes its limits ("limit 20 000"), so M4.P1's note reads `Line 1 nests 10 000 levels deep (limit 32); shown as plain text.` (the architecture's outline spelled the depth unspaced; the grouped form is one formatter for every number). The limits are interpolated from `markdownLimits.ts`.
5. **The two note actions**: a `timeout` offers **Format anyway** exactly when its own `budgetMs` is under `DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_LARGE_MS` ("only after the normal budget"), and it re-parses at the large budget; a `worker-failed` offers **Retry**, which bumps the hook's `attempt` (a new request with the same text, so the runner respawns). No other outcome offers an action.
6. **A base64 `.md` is not, by itself, invalid UTF-8.** Spec 4.10 step 6 decodes a base64 `.md` non-fatally and shows it as plain text, "Not valid UTF-8.". But ccd's encoding rule (spec 2 (f)'s "Encoding", as 6.1's "Encoding rule (amends 2 (f))" restates it) also sends VALID UTF-8 as base64 when it holds a NUL or when the framed base64 line is shorter (a quote-heavy file). So `docMarkdownSource` first decodes with `{fatal: true}`: strict UTF-8 is `markdown` (formatted like any other); anything else is decoded with a non-fatal `TextDecoder('utf-8')` (each bad sequence a U+FFFD) as `not-utf8`, which the leaf shows as `DocPlain` with `DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE`. A base64 `.md` that is invalid UTF-8 gets exactly the spec's behaviour; a valid one is never labelled "Not valid UTF-8." (goal 4: a page says exactly what it served). The coordinator ruled during planning (2026-10-13) that this departs from step 6's TEXT: it is refinement (x), the plan's fifth deviation, defined by Task 12's last step after (a)-(d); rows M14, M15 and M20 hold it (M20 reverts to the spec's literal reading).
7. **`DocPlain` gains an optional `action`** (absent: no action), rendered between the note and the `<pre>`, so the two note actions sit under their note. The architecture's two-field signature is otherwise unchanged.
8. **Show as text has a note too**: `docShownAsTextNote(bytes)`, "This document is {MiB}; shown as plain text, as asked.", because `DocPlain` always draws a note line (the spec names the choice, not its note).
9. **New class names, registered by Task 11**: `doc-plain` and `doc-plain-note` (spec 4.14's list), and five this task names for the parts spec 4.10 describes without one: `doc-gate` (the gate's box), `doc-gate-copy` (its sentence), `doc-gate-btn` (**Format anyway** and **Show as text** at the gate), `doc-plain-action` (**Format anyway** and **Retry** under a note), `doc-formatting` ("Formatting…"). The three button roles need Task 11's tap-target rows; nothing here styles them.
10. **The tree renders exactly once per outcome's tree through `detachUrls`' copy**: `DocTree` memoises `detachUrls(tree)` by the tree object (so a re-render with a new `link` object renders the same copy, and part 2 can read it), provides `DocLinkContext` (`{...link, urls}`) and `PreHighlightContext` (`(pre) => urls.get(pre)?.highlight !== false`, refinement (h)), and calls `renderHast(copy, {components: DOC_COMPONENTS})` with no `urlTransform` inside `<article className="doc-body msg-assist">`. The in-thread fallback is `parseMarkdown(text, 'docs')`, memoised per outcome, for a `worker-unavailable` text of at most `CHAT_SYNC_MAX_BYTES` (4 096 included).
11. **"count only after render" (M4.P12's spec mutation) is row M8.** Nothing in `DocMarkdown` counts elements: the one count is the parse's (refinement (d)), so `too-wide` arrives before anything renders. Any after-render count first needs the parse to stop refusing; M8 deletes that refusal, and the spy assertions ("0 calls") are what turn red, whatever a later count would have said. W4's "delete the count" row on the same line (`markdown-parse.test.ts`) stays W4's; this row runs this task's suite.
12. **The real 500 KiB prose doc is a fixed path, read at test time**: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-06-ccrc-history-w1-b2-recall.md` (2 860 801 bytes at planning), cut at its last newline before 512 000 bytes: 511 876 bytes, under the gate, a tree 8 deep with 4 296 elements (measured at planning in a scratch copy). Step 0 checks the file is there and over 512 000 bytes.

```tsx
    const text = doc(5 * KIB); // over CHAT_SYNC_MAX_BYTES, so worker-unavailable is not parsed in-thread
    const { container } = render(<DocMarkdown text={text} pinKey="p" parser={answering(o)} link={LINK} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelector('.doc-plain-note')?.textContent).toBe(note));
    expect(container.querySelector('pre.doc-plain')?.textContent).toBe(text);
    expect(container.querySelector('article')).toBeNull();
    expect(renderSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('M4.P9: the render gate (spec 4.10 step 1)', () => {
  const big = doc(600 * KIB);

  it('a 600 KiB doc shows the gate with Format anyway and Show as text, and the parser has 0 calls', async () => {
    const parser = realParser();
    const { container, getByRole } = render(<DocMarkdown text={big} pinKey="p" parser={parser} link={LINK} />);
    await act(async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20)); });
    expect(container.querySelector('.doc-gate-copy')?.textContent).toBe('This document is 0.6 MiB. Formatting it may take a while.');
    expect(docGateSentence(utf8ByteLength(big))).toBe('This document is 0.6 MiB. Formatting it may take a while.');
    expect(getByRole('button', { name: DOC_MARKDOWN_ACTION.formatAnyway })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(getByRole('button', { name: DOC_MARKDOWN_ACTION.showAsText })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(parser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0);
    expect(container.querySelector('pre')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Show as text gives pre.doc-plain with the whole text, and still no parse', async () => {
    const parser = realParser();
    const { container, getByRole } = render(<DocMarkdown text={big} pinKey="p" parser={parser} link={LINK} />);
    fireEvent.click(getByRole('button', { name: DOC_MARKDOWN_ACTION.showAsText }));
    expect(container.querySelector('pre.doc-plain')?.textContent).toBe(big);
    expect(container.querySelector('.doc-plain-note')?.textContent).toBe(docShownAsTextNote(utf8ByteLength(big)));
    await act(async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20)); });
    expect(parser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0);
  });

  it('M4.P6 (W5 half): Format anyway posts one docs job whose budget timer is DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_LARGE_MS', async () => {
    const posts: unknown[] = [];
    const timers: number[] = [];
    const worker: WorkerLike = {
      postMessage: (job) => { posts.push(job); }, terminate: () => {}, onmessage: null, onerror: null, onmessageerror: null,
    };
    const runner = createMarkdownRunner({ spawn: () => worker, setTimer: (_fn, ms) => { timers.push(ms); return 0; }, clearTimer: () => {} });
    const { container, getByRole } = render(<DocMarkdown text={big} pinKey="p" parser={runner.parse} link={LINK} />);
    expect(posts).toEqual([]);
    fireEvent.click(getByRole('button', { name: DOC_MARKDOWN_ACTION.formatAnyway }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(posts).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(posts[0]).toMatchObject({ src: big, profile: 'docs' });
    expect(timers).toEqual([DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_LARGE_MS]);
    expect(container.querySelector('.doc-formatting')?.textContent).toBe(DOC_FORMATTING);
    runner.dispose();
  });

  it('a doc of exactly DOCS_RENDER_GATE_BYTES is not gated: it parses at once at the normal budget', async () => {
    const parser = vi.fn<MarkdownParser>(() => new Promise<ParseOutcome>(() => {}));
    const text = doc(DOCS_RENDER_GATE_BYTES);
    const { container } = render(<DocMarkdown text={text} pinKey="p" parser={parser} link={LINK} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(parser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(parser.mock.calls[0]![1]).toMatchObject({ profile: 'docs', budgetMs: DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_MS(DOCS_RENDER_GATE_BYTES) });
    expect(container.querySelector('.doc-gate')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('the parse budget (spec 4.10 step 2)', () => {
  it('the normal job\'s budget is DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_MS of the UTF-8 bytes, per document', async () => {
    const cases = [doc(KIB), doc(128 * KIB), 'é'.repeat(32 * KIB)];
    const got: number[] = [];
    for (const text of cases) {
      const parser = vi.fn<MarkdownParser>(() => new Promise<ParseOutcome>(() => {}));
      render(<DocMarkdown text={text} pinKey={text.slice(0, 4)} parser={parser} link={LINK} />);
      await waitFor(() => expect(parser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
      expect(parser.mock.calls[0]![0]).toBe(text);
      got.push(parser.mock.calls[0]![1].budgetMs);
      cleanup();
    }
    expect(got).toEqual(cases.map((t) => DOCS_PARSE_BUDGET_MS(utf8ByteLength(t))));
    // 1 KiB and 128 KiB differ, and 32 Ki two-byte characters are budgeted by their 64 KiB, not their length.
    expect(new Set(got).size).toBe(3);
  });

  it('the body says Formatting… until the outcome for this text lands', async () => {
    let answer: (o: ParseOutcome) => void = () => {};
    const parser = vi.fn<MarkdownParser>(() => new Promise<ParseOutcome>((r) => { answer = r; }));
    const { container } = render(<DocMarkdown text="# Title" pinKey="p" parser={parser} link={LINK} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(parser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(container.querySelector('.doc-formatting')?.textContent).toBe(DOC_FORMATTING);
    expect(container.querySelector('article')).toBeNull();
    await act(async () => { answer(parseMarkdown('# Title', 'docs')); });
    expect(container.querySelector('article.doc-body.msg-assist h1')?.textContent).toBe('Title');
    expect(container.querySelector('.doc-formatting')).toBeNull();
  });
});

});

    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelector('.doc-plain-note')?.textContent)
      .toBe('This document would draw 90 000 elements (limit 20 000); shown as plain text.'), { timeout: 60000 });
    expect(renderSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0);
    expect(container.querySelector('hr')).toBeNull();
  }, 90000);

  it('22 000 autolinks under 512 KiB: the too-wide note, and the renderHast spy has 0 calls', async () => {
    const text = '<https://a.example>\n'.repeat(22000);
    expect(utf8ByteLength(text)).toBeLessThan(512 * KIB);
```
