- [ ] **Step 6: The leaf.** Create `pwa/src/docs/DocsLeaf.tsx` with exactly:

```tsx
// A Docs leaf (spec 2026-10-01 4.4's leaf row, 5.4, 5.5, 6.1; refinement (b); W5 part 1 Task 9): the body by
// `contentClass(path)`. `markdown` is `DocMarkdown`; `raster` is ONE `DocImage` (its bytes through `loaders.raster`,
// an object URL); `svg` is the same `data:` image Markdown gets, with Source and Download; `html` is the stand-in
// until W6's mockup viewer (no frame of any kind); `text` is the file in `<pre class="doc-plain">`, or `CodeBlock`
// when a registered grammar matches its extension; `other` is "No preview" and Download. A listed size over its
// class cap is the `too-large` sentence, and nothing was requested (the visit's `too-large` slot). The header and
// banners are Task 10's.
import { useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from 'react';
import type { Element as HastElement } from 'hast';
import hljs from 'highlight.js/lib/core';
import { contentClass, docsApi, entryView, type DocPin, type DocsPageLocation, type DocsShowOk, type DocsTreeOk } from '../../../shared/docs';
import { CodeBlock } from '../lib/markdown';
import type { MarkdownParser } from '../lib/markdownRunner';
import { DocImage, DocsAssetContext, svgDataUrl } from './DocImage';
import { DocLinkContext, fragmentTarget, type DocLinkContextValue } from './DocLink';
import { DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE, DocMarkdown, DocPlain, docMarkdownSource } from './DocMarkdown';
import { DocsFailureView } from './DocsFailureView';
import type { DetachedUrls } from './docsLinks';
import { DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES, DOCS_SHOW_NOT_SVG, DOCS_VIEW_TEXT, failureSentence, fillSentence, kib, slotSentence } from './docsText';
import { leafName } from './docsTree';
import type { DocsNotOk } from './failures';
import { downloadDocFile, showBytes } from './objectUrls';
import { pinFor, type DocsVisit, type FileSlot } from './useDocsVisit';

type Leaf = DocsPageLocation & { kind: 'path' };
type LinkBase = Omit<DocLinkContextValue, 'urls'>;

/** A client-built `malformed-answer` for a file answer that does not hold what its class needs. */
function malformed(why: string): DocsNotOk {
  return { s: 'failed', body: { ok: false, failure: 'malformed-answer', why } };
}

/** A failed or client file slot as the failure view's answer (its pin dropped). */
function notOkOf(file: Extract<FileSlot, { s: 'failed' | 'auth' | 'unreachable' | 'no-docs-route' | 'unexpected-response' }>): DocsNotOk {
  switch (file.s) {
    case 'failed':
      return { s: 'failed', body: file.body };
    case 'unexpected-response':
      return { s: 'unexpected-response', status: file.status, contentType: file.contentType };
    default:
      return { s: file.s };
  }
}

/** Scrolls the visit's pending fragment into view once the body under `root` holds it (refinement (o)): a cross-doc
 *  link's fragment, or a direct load's `location.hash`. Looked up inside the leaf's `<article>` by `DocLink`'s own id
 *  rule, then cleared, so it scrolls once. The body renders after the parse settles, so it watches for it. */
function useFragmentScroll(root: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, fragment: string | null, clear: (f: null) => void): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = root.current;
    if (fragment === null || el === null) return undefined;
    const found = (): boolean => {
      const article = el.querySelector('article');
      const target = article === null ? null : fragmentTarget(article, fragment);
      if (target === null) return false;
      target.scrollIntoView();
      clear(null);
      return true;
    };
    if (found()) return undefined;
    const watch = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (found()) watch.disconnect();
    });
    watch.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    return () => watch.disconnect();
  }, [root, fragment, clear]);
}

/** Download (spec 5.4): the file's original bytes through `downloadDocFile` and the page's loaders, octet-stream for
 *  every class; a failure is said under the button. */
function DownloadButton(p: { readonly project: string; readonly pin: DocPin; readonly name: string }): ReactNode {
  const assets = useContext(DocsAssetContext);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const onClick = (): void => {
    setFailed(null);
    void downloadDocFile(p.project, p.pin, p.name, assets?.loaders).then((a) => {
      if (a.s !== 'ok') setFailed(a.s === 'failed' ? failureSentence(a.body) : slotSentence(a));
    });
  };
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" className="docs-leaf-action" onClick={onClick}>{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.download}</button>
      {failed !== null && (
        <p className="docs-note" role="alert">{fillSentence(DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.downloadFailed, { sentence: failed })}</p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function SourceButton(p: { readonly shown: boolean; readonly onToggle: () => void }): ReactNode {
  return (
    <button type="button" className="docs-leaf-action" aria-pressed={p.shown} onClick={p.onToggle}>
      {DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.source}
    </button>
  );
}

/** A file's text as Source shows it: plain, in `<pre class="doc-plain">`; bytes that are not UTF-8 as `DocPlain`. */
function SourceText(p: { readonly show: DocsShowOk }): ReactNode {
  const src = docMarkdownSource(p.show);
  if (src.kind === 'no-bytes') return <DocsFailureView answer={malformed(DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES)} />;
  if (src.kind === 'not-utf8') return <DocPlain text={src.text} note={DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE} />;
  return <pre className="doc-plain">{src.text}</pre>;
}

/** A `text` leaf (spec 4.4): highlighted through the shared `CodeBlock` (and its size and word bounds) when a
 *  registered grammar knows the extension, else plain. */
function TextBody(p: { readonly show: DocsShowOk; readonly path: string }): ReactNode {
  const src = docMarkdownSource(p.show);
  if (src.kind === 'no-bytes') return <DocsFailureView answer={malformed(DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES)} />;
  if (src.kind === 'not-utf8') return <DocPlain text={src.text} note={DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE} />;
  const name = leafName(p.path);
  // contentClass said `text`, so the extension is ASCII `a-z0-9` once lowered: `toLowerCase` lowers it the same way.
  const ext = name.slice(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase();
  if (hljs.getLanguage(ext) === undefined) return <pre className="doc-plain">{src.text}</pre>;
  return <CodeBlock><code className={'language-' + ext}>{src.text}</code></CodeBlock>;
}

/** An `svg` leaf (spec 5.5): the bytes as the same `data:` image Markdown gets (never a `blob:`, never `/api/`),
 *  with Source and Download. */
function SvgBody(p: { readonly show: DocsShowOk; readonly answered: string; readonly download: ReactNode; readonly name: string }): ReactNode {
  const [source, setSource] = useState(false);
  const bytes = p.answered === 'svg' ? showBytes(p.show) : null;
  if (bytes === null) return <DocsFailureView answer={malformed(p.answered === 'svg' ? DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES : DOCS_SHOW_NOT_SVG)} />;
  return (
    <div className="docs-svg">
      <div className="docs-leaf-actions"><SourceButton shown={source} onToggle={() => setSource((s) => !s)} />{p.download}</div>
      {source ? <SourceText show={p.show} /> : <img className="docs-svg-img" src={svgDataUrl(bytes)} alt={p.name} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The `html` stand-in until W6 (refinement (b)): the sentence, the size, Source and Download. It draws no frame of
 *  any kind and gives the HTML to nothing but the text renderer; `?frame=full` renders the same. */
function HtmlStandIn(p: { readonly show: DocsShowOk; readonly download: ReactNode }): ReactNode {
  const [source, setSource] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="docs-standin">
      <p className="docs-note">{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.htmlStandIn}</p>
      <p className="docs-note">{fillSentence(DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.size, { size: kib(p.show.size) })}</p>
      <div className="docs-leaf-actions"><SourceButton shown={source} onToggle={() => setSource((s) => !s)} />{p.download}</div>
      {source && <SourceText show={p.show} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/** A `raster` leaf (spec 4.4: "one `DocImage`"): the leaf's own file as the only image of a one-image page, so the
 *  pin rule, the cap, the queue, the raster checks and the object URL are all `DocImage`'s. */
function RasterBody(p: { readonly link: LinkBase; readonly name: string }): ReactNode {
  const node = useMemo<HastElement>(() => ({ type: 'element', tagName: 'img', properties: {}, children: [] }), []);
  const ctx = useMemo<DocLinkContextValue>(() => {
    const urls = new WeakMap<HastElement, DetachedUrls>();
    urls.set(node, { attrs: { src: './' + encodeURIComponent(p.name) }, imageIndex: 0, highlight: null });
    return { ...p.link, urls };
  }, [p.link, p.name, node]);
  return <div className="docs-raster"><DocLinkContext value={ctx}><DocImage node={node} alt={p.name} /></DocLinkContext></div>;
}

/** A Markdown leaf's body: `DocMarkdown` keyed by the pin, under the page's link context. */
function MarkdownBody(p: { readonly show: DocsShowOk; readonly pinKey: string; readonly link: LinkBase; readonly parser: MarkdownParser }): ReactNode {
  const src = useMemo(() => docMarkdownSource(p.show), [p.show]);
  if (src.kind === 'no-bytes') return <DocsFailureView answer={malformed(DOCS_SHOW_NO_BYTES)} />;
  if (src.kind === 'not-utf8') return <DocPlain text={src.text} note={DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE} />;
  return <DocMarkdown key={p.pinKey} text={src.text} pinKey={p.pinKey} parser={p.parser} link={p.link} />;
}

/** One leaf page's body (spec 4.4). `page` is a leaf of `tree` (`docsPathKind` said so); given anything else it
 *  renders nothing. */
export function DocsLeaf(p: {
  readonly visit: DocsVisit; readonly tree: DocsTreeOk; readonly page: Leaf; readonly parser: MarkdownParser;
}): ReactNode {
  const { visit, tree, page, parser } = p;
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  useFragmentScroll(root, visit.pendingFragment, visit.setFragment);
  const pin = pinFor(tree, page);
  const link = useMemo<LinkBase>(() => ({
    project: page.project, pageRef: page.ref, view: page.view, section: page.section, path: page.path, tree,
    pageSource: pin?.kind === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'committed', onFragment: visit.setFragment,
  }), [page, tree, pin?.kind, visit.setFragment]);
  const entry = tree.entries.find((e) => e.section === page.section && e.path === page.path);
  if (entry === undefined) return null;
  const view = entryView(entry, tree.drafts, page.ref === null ? 'default' : 'ref');
  const cls = contentClass(page.path);
  const name = leafName(page.path);
  let body: ReactNode;
  if (view.opens === 'none' || pin === null) {
    const why = view.committedKind === 'symlink' ? DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.symlink
      : view.committedKind === 'submodule' ? DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.submodule : DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.nothingToShow;
    body = <p className="docs-note">{why}</p>;
  } else {
    const download = <DownloadButton project={page.project} pin={pin} name={name} />;
    const file = visit.file;
    if (cls === 'raster') {
      body = <><RasterBody link={link} name={name} /><div className="docs-leaf-actions">{download}</div></>;
    } else if (file.s === 'too-large') {
      body = <DocsFailureView answer={{ s: 'failed', body: { ok: false, failure: 'too-large', size: file.size, cap: file.cap } }} />;
    } else if (cls === 'other') {
      const size = pin.kind === 'draft' ? entry.draft?.size : entry.committed?.size;
      body = (
        <>
          <p className="docs-note">{fillSentence(DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.noPreview, typeof size === 'number' ? { size: kib(size) } : {})}</p>
          <div className="docs-leaf-actions">{download}</div>
        </>
      );
    } else if (file.s === 'none') {
      body = <p className="docs-note">{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.nothingToShow}</p>;
    } else if (file.s === 'loading') {
      body = <p className="docs-loading">{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.loading}</p>;
    } else if (file.s === 'changing') {
      body = (
        <div className="docs-changing" role="alert">
          <p className="docs-note">{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.changing}</p>
          <button type="button" className="btn-ghost docs-fail-action" onClick={visit.retryFile}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      );
    } else if (file.s !== 'ok') {
      body = <DocsFailureView answer={notOkOf(file)} onRetry={visit.retryFile} />;
    } else {
      const show = file.answer.show;
      const pinKey = docsApi.file(page.project, file.pin);
      switch (cls) {
        case 'markdown':
          body = <MarkdownBody show={show} pinKey={pinKey} link={link} parser={parser} />;
          break;
        case 'text':
          body = <TextBody show={show} path={page.path} />;
          break;
        case 'svg':
          body = <SvgBody key={pinKey} show={show} answered={file.answer.contentClass} download={download} name={name} />;
          break;
        case 'html':
          body = <HtmlStandIn key={pinKey} show={show} download={download} />;
          break;
      }
    }
  }
  return <div className="docs-leaf" data-class={cls} ref={root}>{body}</div>;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The screen.** Create `pwa/src/screens/DocsScreen.tsx` with exactly:

```tsx
// The Docs screen (spec 2026-10-01 3.1, 4.2-4.4, 4.7; W5 part 1 Task 9): the route component the app's `docs` arm
// mounts, unkeyed, so one mount is one visit. It parses the URL (a parse failure is its sentence and a link to the
// index), fixes a non-canonical URL by replace, loads the index or the visit's tree, follows a linked worktree to the
// repository that owns it by replace, and hands the page to its view: the index, a project, section or directory
// page, or a leaf. It owns the page's image queue and the drafted-asset count, and gives both to the images through
// `DocsAssetContext`. The header, banners and freshness chip are Task 10's.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  DOCS_PAGE_PREFIX, docsPageUrl, parseDocsPage, parseDocsRef,
  type DocsPageLocation, type DocsProjectsResponse, type DocsRefSpec, type DocsTreeOk,
} from '../../../shared/docs';
import { DocsAssetContext, type DocsAssetContextValue } from '../docs/DocImage';
import { DocsFailureView } from '../docs/DocsFailureView';
import { DocsIndexView } from '../docs/DocsIndexView';
import { DocsLeaf } from '../docs/DocsLeaf';
import { DocsPageLink, DocsTreeView } from '../docs/DocsTreeView';
import { createFetchQueue } from '../docs/fetchQueue';
import type { DocsLoaders, DocsNotOk } from '../docs/failures';
import { docsLocation } from '../docs/docsLinks';
import { DOCS_PAGE_INVALID_SENTENCE, DOCS_VIEW_TEXT, fillSentence } from '../docs/docsText';
import { docsPathKind } from '../docs/docsTree';
import { useDocsVisit, type TreeSlot } from '../docs/useDocsVisit';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { onAuthRegained } from '../lib/auth';
import { docsRunner, type MarkdownParser } from '../lib/markdownRunner';
import { navigate } from '../lib/router';

/** The defaults are module-scope constants (spec 4.3, the `MailScreen` idiom), so their identities are stable across
 *  renders: a new `loaders` would reload every image on the page (`DocsAssetContext`'s contract). */
const DEFAULT_DOCS_LOADERS: DocsLoaders = api.docs;
const DEFAULT_DOCS_PARSER: MarkdownParser = (src, o) => docsRunner.parse(src, o);

/** The index's answer this visit. `null` has one meaning: no index request has been made in this visit yet. */
type IndexSlot = { s: 'loading' } | { s: 'ok'; answer: DocsProjectsResponse } | DocsNotOk;

/** A replace-navigation the screen owes, and the note the page it lands on shows (`null`: none). */
interface Redirect { readonly href: string; readonly note: string | null }

/** The words that send a page to the repository that owns it (spec 4.7). */
function isOwnedElsewhere(slot: TreeSlot | null): slot is Extract<TreeSlot, { s: 'failed' }> {
  return slot?.s === 'failed' && (slot.body.failure === 'linked-worktree' || slot.body.failure === 'shared-repo');
}

/** The owner redirect (spec 4.7, refinement (c)): the same page in the owner's project. `branch` a ref Docs can
 *  address: that ref. `branch: null` (a detached HEAD, or a branch ccd could not read): the owner's default view,
 *  with refinement (c)'s sentence. A `branch` string Docs cannot address: the default view, saying so. `branch`
 *  ABSENT (a `shared-repo` answer names only its owner): the page's own ref, since it is the same repository. An
 *  owner that is not a string (`null`, or absent): no redirect; the page renders the word's sentence. */
function ownerRedirect(page: DocsPageLocation, slot: TreeSlot | null): Redirect | null {
  if (!isOwnedElsewhere(slot) || page.kind === 'index') return null;
  const { owner, branch } = slot.body;
  if (typeof owner !== 'string') return null;
  let ref: DocsRefSpec | null = page.ref;
  let note: string | null = null;
  if (branch === null) {
    ref = null;
    note = fillSentence(DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.redirectNullBranch, { owner });
  } else if (typeof branch === 'string') {
    ref = parseDocsRef(branch);
    if (ref === null) note = fillSentence(DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.redirectBadBranch, { owner, branch });
  }
  return { href: docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, { kind: 'same-page', project: owner, ref })), note };
}

/** A path page whose slash the tree contradicts (spec 3.1): a directory reached without its slash goes to the slash
 *  form, and a leaf reached with one goes to the slash-less form. */
function slashRedirect(page: DocsPageLocation, tree: DocsTreeOk): Redirect | null {
  if (page.kind !== 'path') return null;
  const kind = docsPathKind(tree, page.section, page.path, page.ref === null ? 'default' : 'ref').kind;
  if (kind === 'dir' && !page.dirSlash) {
    return { href: docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, { kind: 'path', section: page.section, path: page.path, dirSlash: true })), note: null };
  }
  if (kind === 'leaf' && page.dirSlash) {
    const to = { kind: 'path', section: page.section, path: page.path, dirSlash: false, view: page.view } as const;
    return { href: docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, to)), note: null };
  }
  return null;
}

function treeOf(slot: TreeSlot | null): DocsTreeOk | null {
  return slot?.s === 'ok' ? slot.answer.tree : null;
}

export function DocsScreen(p: {
  path: string; search: string; loaders?: DocsLoaders; parser?: MarkdownParser;
}): ReactNode {
  const { path, search, loaders = DEFAULT_DOCS_LOADERS, parser = DEFAULT_DOCS_PARSER } = p;
  const here = path + search;
  const parsed = useMemo(() => parseDocsPage(path, search), [path, search]);
  const page = parsed.ok ? parsed.loc : null;
  const visit = useDocsVisit(page, loaders);

  // The image queue and the drafted-asset count, one each per visit, stable across renders (DocsAssetContext).
  const [queue] = useState(createFetchQueue);
  const [draftAssets, setDraftAssets] = useState(0);
  const onDraftAsset = useCallback((delta: number) => setDraftAssets((n) => n + delta), []);
  const assets = useMemo<DocsAssetContextValue>(() => ({ loaders, queue, onDraftAsset }), [loaders, queue, onDraftAsset]);

  // The default parser's worker is started on mount, so the first leaf does not wait for it (spec 4.3).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (parser === DEFAULT_DOCS_PARSER) docsRunner.prewarm();
  }, [parser]);

  // A direct load's `#fragment` is honoured once, like a cross-doc link's (refinement (o)).
  const setFragment = visit.setFragment;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.hash.length > 1) setFragment(location.hash.slice(1));
  }, [setFragment]);

  // The index: one GET per visit, re-made after a sign-in when it answered `auth`.
  const [index, setIndex] = useState<IndexSlot | null>(null);
  const indexInflight = useRef(false);
  const loadIndex = useCallback(() => {
    if (indexInflight.current) return;
    indexInflight.current = true;
    setIndex((s) => (s?.s === 'ok' ? s : { s: 'loading' }));
    void loaders.projects().then((a) => {
      indexInflight.current = false;
      setIndex(a.s === 'ok' ? { s: 'ok', answer: a.value } : a);
    });
  }, [loaders]);
  const isIndex = page?.kind === 'index';
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isIndex && index === null) loadIndex();
  }, [isIndex, index, loadIndex]);
  useEffect(() => onAuthRegained(() => setIndex((s) => (s?.s === 'auth' ? null : s))), []);

  // Every redirect is a replace (M4.R4): canonicalisation, the slash the tree decides, the owner of a worktree.
  const tree = treeOf(visit.tree);
  let redirect: Redirect | null = null;
  if (parsed.ok && parsed.canonical !== here) redirect = { href: parsed.canonical, note: null };
  else if (page !== null && tree !== null) redirect = slashRedirect(page, tree);
  else if (page !== null) redirect = ownerRedirect(page, visit.tree);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<{ readonly at: string; readonly text: string } | null>(null);
  const target = redirect?.href ?? null;
  const targetNote = redirect?.note ?? null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (target === null || target === here) return;
    if (targetNote !== null) setNote({ at: target, text: targetNote });
    navigate(target, { replace: true });
  }, [target, targetNote, here]);

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (!parsed.ok) {
    body = (
      <div className="docs-invalid" role="alert">
        <p className="docs-note">{DOCS_PAGE_INVALID_SENTENCE[parsed.why]}</p>
        <DocsPageLink className="docs-hint-link" href={DOCS_PAGE_PREFIX}>{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.indexLink}</DocsPageLink>
      </div>
    );
  } else if (page === null || page.kind === 'index') {
    if (index === null || index.s === 'loading') body = <p className="docs-loading">{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.loading}</p>;
    else if (index.s === 'ok') body = <DocsIndexView answer={index.answer} />;
    else body = <DocsFailureView answer={index} onRetry={() => { setIndex(null); }} />;
  } else {
    const slot = visit.tree;
    if (slot === null || slot.s === 'loading') {
      body = <p className="docs-loading">{DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.loading}</p>;
    } else if (slot.s === 'ok') {
      const t = slot.answer.tree;
      const leaf = page.kind === 'path' && !page.dirSlash
        && docsPathKind(t, page.section, page.path, page.ref === null ? 'default' : 'ref').kind === 'leaf';
      body = leaf && page.kind === 'path'
        ? <DocsLeaf visit={visit} tree={t} page={page} parser={parser} />
        : <DocsTreeView tree={t} page={page} />;
    } else if (isOwnedElsewhere(slot) && typeof slot.body.owner === 'string') {
      body = <p className="docs-loading">{fillSentence(DOCS_VIEW_TEXT.redirecting, { owner: slot.body.owner })}</p>;
    } else {
      const suggestHref = (name: string): string => {
        const ref = parseDocsRef(name);
        return ref === null ? here : docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, { kind: 'same-page', project: page.project, ref }));
      };
      body = (
        <DocsFailureView
          answer={slot} onRetry={visit.retryTree} onFetchFromOrigin={visit.fetchFromOrigin} suggestHref={suggestHref}
        />
      );
    }
  }
  return (
    <DocsAssetContext value={assets}>
      <div className="docs-screen" data-draft-assets={draftAssets}>
        {note !== null && note.at === here && <p className="docs-note docs-redirect-note" role="status">{note.text}</p>}
        {body}
      </div>
    </DocsAssetContext>
  );
}
```

### Task 10: DocsHead and DocsBanners: back and crumbs, the truth line, the freshness chip, the banners, View on GitHub (root for the project), Open committed version, copy commit through copyText, Updated to; and the one-badge scan

**Model routing:** implementer `sonnet`, effort `high`; per-task reviewer `opus` (lens 4 of "How this wave runs": what each page says, here the truth line, the chip's every state, the banners' sentences, the GitHub builders' refusals and the one badge function; lens 3 for the chip's reading of the visit's refresh state and "Updated to"; lens 5 for mutation-table discipline). No subagent inherits a model.
**Spec rows:** M4.T1; M4.T2; M4.T3; M4.T4; M4.T5; M4.T6; M4.T7's base form (row and leaf badge text equal for every draft fixture; a parser-backed scan finds no `.draft.state` read in `pwa/src/docs/**`, nor in `DocsScreen.tsx`); M4.F4; spec 2 rows 54 and 67; spec 4.5's truth line, freshness chip, banners and actions (Share and Export excluded, refinement (a)); spec 4.4's layout (back is up one level; phone crumbs); spec 4.7's placement. Refinements (q) (every page URL is `docsPageUrl(docsLocation(page, to))`), (s) (short commit is 8 hex), (t) (`copyText` arrives in part 1). This task writes no deviation number anywhere.

Produces:

```ts
// pwa/src/docs/share.ts
export function copyText(text: string): Promise<void>;
//   the one clipboard writer under pwa/src/docs; resolves once written; rejects when the clipboard refuses or the page
//   has none ('The clipboard is not available here.')

// pwa/src/docs/DocsHead.tsx
export function DocsHead(p: { readonly page: DocsPageLocation; readonly visit: DocsVisit; readonly tree: DocsTreeOk | null }): ReactNode;
//   tree null = the tree slot is not ok (loading, failed, or the page names no project): back and the crumbs only
export function docsUpHref(page: DocsPageLocation): string;          // up one level; the index goes to '/'
export interface DocsCrumb { readonly label: string; readonly href: string }
export function docsCrumbs(page: DocsPageLocation): DocsCrumb[];     // index down to the page, each keeping the page's ref
export function githubTargetFor(page: DocsPageLocation, tree: DocsTreeOk): GithubTarget | null;
//   null = the page has no GitHub counterpart: the index, or a path this listing does not hold
export function truthSource(tree: DocsTreeOk, page: DocsPageLocation & { kind: 'path' }, opened: DocPin | null): string;
//   opened null = nothing opened (yet, or at all): 'nothing opened'
export type FreshChipState = 'none' | 'never' | 'ok' | 'local' | 'failed' | 'fetching' | 'soon';
export function freshnessChip(tree: DocsTreeOk, receivedAt: number, freshness: Freshness, now: number):
  { readonly state: FreshChipState; readonly text: string };

// pwa/src/docs/DocsBanners.tsx
export function DocsBanners(p: {
  readonly page: DocsPageLocation; readonly tree: DocsTreeOk; readonly file: FileSlot; readonly draftAssets: number;
  readonly onRelist: () => void;
}): ReactNode;   // null for the index and when no banner applies

// pwa/src/docs/docsText.ts (appended)
export const DOCS_HEAD_TEXT: { readonly back: 'Up one level'; ... };            // as const, every header word
export const GITHUB_REFUSAL_TEXT: Record<Extract<GithubLink, { ok: false }>['why'], string>;
export const DOCS_BANNER_TEXT: { readonly defaultHint: '{n} uncommitted doc{s} in {label} on {branch}'; ... };  // as const
export function servedRefText(ref: DocsTreeOk['ref']): string;   // 'origin/<name>' for the origin side, '<name> (local)' for the local side
export function worktreeLabel(w: { readonly path: string; readonly class: 'main' | 'workspace' | 'other' }): string;
//   'main checkout', 'workspace <last segment>', or the path's last two segments
```

Every `null` here has one meaning, stated beside it. Two departures from the architecture's Produces list, each a refinement (they fill a silence, not the spec's text): `DocsBanners` takes `onRelist` (the spec's `unsettled` Retry and `not-contained` Re-list need an action, and the banners start no request themselves: the screen passes `visit.retryTree`), and `githubTargetFor`'s `null` also covers a path the listing does not hold (the architecture said "null = the index"; a missing path has no GitHub counterpart either, and offering View on GitHub there would point at nothing this page shows).

**Decisions this task makes** (each pinned by a case below; refinements, not deviations):

1. **The header is mounted by `DocsScreen`, above the view, on every page that parsed; the banners on every page with an `ok` tree but the index.** So a tree failure keeps back and the crumbs and replaces the listing, a file failure keeps the header and the truth line and replaces only the leaf's body, and a fetch failure reaches only the chip (spec 4.7's placement, M4.F4). The views (`DocsTreeView`, `DocsLeaf`) stay pure renderers of their body; only their header comments change. A URL that did not parse keeps Task 9's sentence and index link, with no header.
2. **Truth line (spec 4.5), facts inline joined by ` · `:** the served ref through `servedRefText` (`origin/<name>` when the origin side is served, `<name> (local)` when the local side is; `ref.served`, the full refname, in `title`); the commit's first 8 hex in a `<code>` with the full id in `title`, and **copy commit**; `VIA_SENTENCE[via]` filled with `requested`; for `local`, `origin` and `qualified` only, `RELATION_SENTENCE[relation]` filled with the counterpart's `ahead`/`behind` (a `null` count renders `?`), in `data-tone="warn"` for `diverged` and `info` otherwise; "origin/HEAD points at a missing branch" when `tried[0].result` is `dangling` (rung 1's target is `tried[0]`); on a leaf, the source, the badge and the size; last, the freshness chip.
3. **A leaf's source is the OPENED pin's** (`visit.file.pin`; for a file slot `none`, which a raster or an `other` leaf has, `pinFor`'s pin, which `DocImage` and Download use): `committed`, `committed (view=committed)`, or `{ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT[badge]} in {worktree label}` for a draft, with the full worktree path in `title`. The draft's badge is drawn as the same `.docs-badge` the rows draw, inside the source. A leaf whose `entryView` badges it but opens the committed side (withheld, deleted, type changed) shows `committed` and the badge beside it. `truthSource` returns the same string the source span's text is. A draft pin that outlived a re-list (its entry no longer badged) reads `draft in <label>`; a draft pin with no holder in the tree names its branch.
4. **The worktree label (spec 4.5):** "main checkout" (class `main`), "workspace <last segment>" (class `workspace`), else the path's last two segments; `worktreeLabel` in `docsText.ts`, shared by the truth line and the banners.
5. **The freshness chip (spec 4.5's table), first match wins:** no origin (static `<span>`, `data-state="none"`, "no origin"); a POST in flight (`fetching`, "fetching…", the button disabled); `soon` ("fetched moments ago; again in {n}s", `n` the whole seconds to `retryAt`, at least 0); `stale-lock` (`failed`, "stale lock on {ref}", or "stale lock (the answer named no ref)" when the answer named none); `relist-failed` (`failed`, "re-list failed: {sentence} ↻", spec 4.3's words); `refresh-failed` (`failed`, "refresh failed: {sentence} ↻", the POST got no route answer); an `answered` fetch `skipped: local-ref` (`local`, "local ref; fetch does not change it"); an `answered` fetch failure (`failed`, "fetch failed {age}: {sentence} · last good {okAge or never} ↻", `age` from when the answer landed, the tree's stamp unchanged); then the tree's own stamp: none (`never`, "never fetched ↻"), `ok` (`ok`, "fetched {age} ↻"), `remote-branch-absent` (`local`, "local only ↻"), any other outcome (`failed`, "fetch failed {age}: {sentence} · last good {okAge or never} ↻"). Ages are `attemptAgeMs + (now - receivedAt)` (and `okAgeMs` likewise), `now` from `useNow(30_000)` (inactive while there is no tree), through `formatAge` in seconds. Every state but `none` is a `<button>` whose tap is `visit.refreshManual` (one manual POST; the visit refuses a second while one runs). An `answered` fetch that ran shows the new stamp.
6. **Back is up one level (spec 4.4):** a leaf or a directory to its parent directory (with its slash) or its section; a section to its project; a project to the index; the index to the fleet (`/`). It keeps the page's ref, drops `view`, and navigates with a history entry (a deep link has no history, so it is never `history.back()`).
7. **Crumbs:** Docs › project › section label › each path segment, each a `DocsPageLink` built by `docsLocation` (so the page's ref is kept), the last one the page itself (`aria-current="page"`, not a link). On a phone (`useMediaQuery('(min-width: 900px)')` false, which is also what tests and SSR get) the last two behind a leading `…` button ("Show the whole path") that shows them all; on a desktop, every crumb. The crumbs reset when the page changes (keyed by the last crumb's URL).
8. **View on GitHub (spec 3.11, 4.4):** `githubTargetFor` gives `root` on a project page (the amended row), `section`, `dir`, and `leaf` with `uncommitted` exactly when the entry has no committed side; `githubBlobUrl` builds or refuses. A link opens with `openExternal` on tap (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"` for a modifier click), with "GitHub's copy may differ from this view" for `may-differ`. A refusal is "View on GitHub: {reason}" in words from `GITHUB_REFUSAL_TEXT`, not a link.
9. **Open committed version (spec 4.5, M4.T6)** is a `DocsPageLink` to the same leaf at `view=committed`, offered iff `entryView(...).offersCommitted` and the page is not already at `view=committed` (whose banner offers **Back to the draft**). It navigates with a history entry, so Back returns to the draft; the commit never enters the URL; the visit resolves the committed pin from its tree.
10. **"Updated to <short>"** is the header's `role="status"` line whenever `visit.updatedTo` is set (Task 5 sets it per leaf when a re-list moved the leaf's pin and the new read answered).
11. **The banners (spec 4.5's table, verbatim), each `role="status"` with `data-tone` and a `data-banner` id**, in this order: the holder's hints and caveats, or the one sentence of a drafts state that shows no drafts (`ambiguous` with its candidates listed, `untrusted`, `unreadable`, `unsettled` with Retry, `too-many`, `none` with `skipped`: `{why list}` is the distinct reasons joined by `, `, in first-seen order); then a leaf's own: withheld (`WITHHELD_SENTENCE`), deleted, type changed, conflicted (warn), `onRef === 'not-contained'` (warn, with Re-list), drafted images ("This draft page embeds {k} uncommitted asset{s}.", from `DocsScreen`'s count), and `view=committed` with Back to the draft. `n` counts the entries with a draft at all (`e.draft !== null`), or the drafts' own `count` for `too-many`.
12. **The default-view hint and the base hint link the QUALIFIED `refs/heads/<branch>`** (rows 67, M4.T2, M4.T3), built once by `parseDocsRef('refs/heads/' + branch)` and `docsLocation`'s `same-page` target. The default-view hint shows only in the default view; the base hint only in a ref view whose holder's HEAD is not the served commit; neither when `n` is 0. When the branch name is not one Docs can address, the sentence shows with no link.
13. **The default-view hint is ONE banner.** Task 9's missing page drew its own hint ("It may be an uncommitted draft on {branch}." with **Open the draft view**); spec 4.4 calls that hint "the default-view hint", which is this task's banner, and two copies would put two identical links on one page. So `MissingPage` keeps "Not in this listing at <short>." and the hint is the banner's (Task 9's case re-pointed; `missingDraftHint` leaves `DOCS_VIEW_TEXT`). That also removes the one `.draft.state` read under `pwa/src/docs` (`MissingPage` skipped deleted drafts by reading it): the banner counts every draft, as spec 4.5 says.
14. **"Showing the committed version." is said only when the page shows one.** Spec 4.5 appends it to the withheld, deleted and type-changed banners; a withheld NEW file has no committed side (`entryView` opens nothing), and saying it there would be false (goal 4), so the banner gives the reason alone.
15. **One badge function (M4.T7, base form).** Every draft word on a page is `entryView`'s, through `ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT` and `WITHHELD_SENTENCE`; the row (`DocsTreeView`) and the leaf header draw the same `.docs-badge` text, pinned for nine draft fixtures. `imagePinFor`'s deleted rule (Task 7) now reads `entryView(e, drafts, 'ref').badge === 'deleted'` instead of the draft's state through a variable: on a draft page the holder is admitted and the image's entry has a draft, so the two are the same test, and the only way left to a draft's state is a form the scan's header names as an evasion. Task 7's row M5 is re-anchored below.
16. **The scan (`docs-scans.test.ts`, clause 1) is parser-backed:** `ts.createSourceFile` and a walk of every node, finding a `state` member read off a `draft` member (`.`, `?.`, `['…']`, through parentheses, `!`, `as`, `satisfies`, `<T>`) and the two destructuring forms; comments and strings are not reads. Its header lists what it does not see ("NOT EXHAUSTIVE"), and three cases pin those evasions as unseen. Its control plants a file in a copy of `pwa/src/docs` (made under `os.tmpdir()` and removed after) and asserts the one hit by file, line and column.
```tsx
// Docs W5 part 1, Task 10: the Docs header (spec 2026-10-01 4.4's layout, 4.5, 4.7's placement; M4.T1, M4.T6, the
// base form of M4.T7 (row and leaf badge text equal), M4.F4; spec 2 row 54). The truth line on every page with a
// listing, every state of the freshness chip, View on GitHub per page kind (the project page through `root`), Open
// committed version (the commit never enters the URL), copy commit through `copyText`, "Updated to", back as up one
// level, and the phone crumbs. Unit cases render `DocsHead` over a hand-built visit; the rest mount `DocsScreen` with
// injected loaders. Placeholders only: project `demo`, branches `main` and `ws/a`, `/repo/...`,
// `example-org/example-repo`.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { act, cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import {
  entryView,
  type DocPin, type DocsEntry, type DocsPageLocation, type DocsRefreshFetch, type DocsTreeOk, type DraftsFacts,
} from '../../shared/docs';
import { DocsHead, githubTargetFor, truthSource } from '../src/docs/DocsHead';
import { DocsTreeView } from '../src/docs/DocsTreeView';
import { ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT } from '../src/docs/docsText';
import type { DocsLoaders } from '../src/docs/failures';
import { copyText } from '../src/docs/share';
import type { DocsVisit, Freshness } from '../src/docs/useDocsVisit';
import { parseMarkdown } from '../src/lib/markdownParse';
import type { MarkdownParser } from '../src/lib/markdownRunner';
import { navigate, useLocation } from '../src/lib/router';
import { DocsScreen } from '../src/screens/DocsScreen';
import {
  BLOB_2, COMMIT_A, COMMIT_B, FP_1, RAN, SERVED, draftOf, entry, failedAnswer, fakeLoaders, fetchFailed, holder,
  okRefresh, okTree, pageAt, treeOk, treeResponse, type FakeLoaders,
} from './docsFixtures';

const parser: MarkdownParser = async (src) => parseMarkdown(src, 'docs');

function Routed(p: { readonly loaders: DocsLoaders }): ReactNode {
  const { path, search } = useLocation();
  return <DocsScreen path={path} search={search} loaders={p.loaders} parser={parser} />;
}

function open(url: string, f: FakeLoaders): ReturnType<typeof render> {
  navigate(url);
  return render(<Routed loaders={f.loaders} />);
}

const here = (): string => location.pathname + location.search;
const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 13, 12, 0, 0);
const MIN = 60_000;

/** A visit whose tree slot is `ok` for `tree`, received at `receivedAt`; every action a spy. */
function visitOf(tree: DocsTreeOk, over: Partial<DocsVisit> = {}, receivedAt = NOW): DocsVisit {
  return {
    tree: { s: 'ok', answer: treeResponse(tree), receivedAt },
    file: { s: 'none' }, freshness: { s: 'idle' }, updatedTo: null, pendingFragment: null,
    retryTree: vi.fn(), retryFile: vi.fn(), refreshManual: vi.fn(), fetchFromOrigin: vi.fn(), setFragment: vi.fn(),
    ...over,
  };
}

function head(url: string, tree: DocsTreeOk | null, over: Partial<DocsVisit> = {}): ReturnType<typeof render> {
  const visit = tree === null
    ? { ...visitOf(treeOk(), over), tree: null }
    : visitOf(tree, over);
  return render(<DocsHead page={pageAt(url)} visit={visit} tree={tree} />);
}

const q = (sel: string): HTMLElement => {
  const el = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(sel);
  if (el === null) throw new Error(`no ${sel}`);
  return el;
};

/** A holder in a linked workspace, its HEAD the served commit. */
function workspaceHolder(path = '/repo/wt/a', cls: 'main' | 'workspace' | 'other' = 'workspace'): DraftsFacts {
  return {
    state: 'holder', branch: 'main', worktree: { path, head: COMMIT_A, class: cls }, baseEqual: true, base: null,
    caveats: [], opaque: [],
  };
}

function withRef(over: Partial<DocsTreeOk['ref']>, tree: DocsTreeOk = treeOk()): DocsTreeOk {
  return { ...tree, ref: { ...tree.ref, ...over } };
}

function withStamp(stamp: DocsTreeOk['freshness']['stamp'], remote: 'origin' | null = 'origin'): DocsTreeOk {
  const t = treeOk();
  return { ...t, freshness: { ...t.freshness, remote, stamp } };
}

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.useRealTimers();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  Reflect.deleteProperty(navigator, 'clipboard');
  history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
});

describe('the truth line on every page with a listing (M4.T1)', () => {
  it.each(['/docs/demo', '/docs/demo/specs', '/docs/demo/specs/d/', '/docs/demo/specs/d/x.md'])(
    '%s shows the served ref, the 8-hex commit, how it was chosen and the chip', async (url) => {
      open(url, fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'd/x.md')] })) }));
      await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth')).not.toBeNull());
      expect(q('.docs-truth-ref')).toHaveTextContent(/^origin\/main$/);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-ref')).toHaveAttribute('title', SERVED);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-commit')).toHaveTextContent(/^aaaaaaaa$/);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-commit')).toHaveAttribute('title', COMMIT_A);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-via')).toHaveTextContent(/^default branch \(origin\/HEAD\)$/);
      expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth-relation')).toBeNull();
      expect(q('.docs-fresh')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'never');
      expect(q('.docs-fresh')).toHaveTextContent(/^never fetched ↻$/);
    });

  it('a local side reads `<b> (local)`, with the full refname in its title', () => {
    const tree = withRef({
      requested: 'ws/a', served: 'refs/heads/ws/a', name: 'ws/a', side: 'local', via: 'local', relation: 'local-ahead',
      counterpart: { ref: 'refs/remotes/origin/ws/a', commit: COMMIT_B, ahead: 2, behind: 0, count: 'measured' },
    });
    head('/docs/demo?ref=ws/a', tree);
    expect(q('.docs-truth-ref')).toHaveTextContent(/^ws\/a \(local\)$/);
    expect(q('.docs-truth-ref')).toHaveAttribute('title', 'refs/heads/ws/a');
    expect(q('.docs-truth-via')).toHaveTextContent(/^you asked for ws\/a, showing local$/);
    expect(q('.docs-truth-relation')).toHaveTextContent(/^local is 2 ahead of origin$/);
    expect(q('.docs-truth-relation')).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', 'info');
  });

  it.each([
    ['qualified', 'diverged', 'exactly the ref you asked for', 'local and origin have diverged (2 vs 3), showing local', 'warn'],
    ['origin', 'equal', "you asked for ws/a, showing origin's", 'local and origin agree', 'info'],
    ['local', 'local-behind', 'you asked for ws/a, showing local', 'origin is 3 ahead of local', 'info'],
    ['origin', 'origin-only', "you asked for ws/a, showing origin's", 'only on origin', 'info'],
    ['local', 'unmeasured', 'you asked for ws/a, showing local', 'local vs origin not measured', 'info'],
  ] as const)('via %s with relation %s: the via sentence, then the relation (%s; %s; tone %s)',
    (via, relation, viaText, relationText, tone) => {
      const tree = withRef({
        requested: 'ws/a', via, relation, side: via === 'origin' ? 'origin' : 'local',
        counterpart: { ref: 'refs/remotes/origin/ws/a', commit: COMMIT_B, ahead: 2, behind: 3, count: 'measured' },
      });
      head('/docs/demo?ref=ws/a', tree);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-via').textContent).toBe(viaText);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-relation').textContent).toBe(relationText);
      expect(q('.docs-truth-relation')).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', tone);
    });

  it('a default the server chose shows no relation sentence', () => {
    head('/docs/demo', withRef({ via: 'default:local-main', side: 'local', relation: 'local-only' }));
    expect(q('.docs-truth-via').textContent).toBe('default branch (local main; no origin branch)');
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth-relation')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a dangling origin/HEAD in tried[0] adds its sentence', () => {
    head('/docs/demo', withRef({ via: 'default:origin-main', tried: [{ ref: 'refs/remotes/origin/feat', result: 'dangling' }] }));
    expect(q('.docs-truth-via').textContent).toBe('default branch (origin/main; origin/HEAD unset)');
    expect(q('.docs-truth-dangling').textContent).toBe('origin/HEAD points at a missing branch');
  });

  it('no dangling sentence when tried[0] resolved', () => {
    head('/docs/demo', withRef({ tried: [{ ref: 'refs/remotes/origin/main', result: 'resolved' }] }));
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth-dangling')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a tree failure keeps the crumbs and replaces the listing; there is no truth line (M4.F4)', async () => {
    open('/docs/demo/specs', fakeLoaders({ tree: failedAnswer('repo-unreadable') }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('The repository could not be read on the fleet box.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Docs path' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth')).toBeNull();
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-listing')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('the index has crumbs and back, and no truth line', () => {
    head('/docs', null);
    expect(within(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Docs path' })).getByText('Docs')).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth')).toBeNull();
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-actions')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("the leaf's source, badge and size (spec 2 row 54)", () => {
  it('a committed leaf: source `committed` and its size in KiB', async () => {
    open('/docs/demo/specs/a.md', fakeLoaders());
    await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('.docs-truth-size')).not.toBeNull());
    expect(q('.docs-truth-source').textContent).toBe('committed');
    expect(q('.docs-truth-size').textContent).toBe('1 KiB');
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-head .docs-badge')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a draft leaf in a ref view: `draft · modified in workspace a`, the worktree path in its title', async () => {
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md', { draft: draftOf('modified') })], drafts: workspaceHolder() });
    const f = fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(tree) });
    open('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main', f);
    await waitFor(() => expect(f.file).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await waitFor(() => expect(q('.docs-truth-source').textContent).toBe('draft · modified in workspace a'));
    expect(q('.docs-truth-source')).toHaveAttribute('title', '/repo/wt/a');
    expect(within(q('.docs-truth-source')).getByText('draft · modified')).toHaveClass('docs-badge');
    expect(f.file.mock.calls[0]?.[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'draft', fp: FP_1 });
  });

  it('view=committed: source `committed (view=committed)`', async () => {
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md', { draft: draftOf('modified') })], drafts: holder() });
    open('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main&view=committed', fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(tree) }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(q('.docs-truth-source').textContent).toBe('committed (view=committed)'));
  });

  it.each([
    ['/repo/demo', 'main', 'main checkout'],
    ['/repo/wt/a', 'workspace', 'workspace a'],
    ['/repo/x/y/z', 'other', 'y/z'],
  ] as const)('truthSource names the worktree at %s (%s) as %s', (path, cls, label) => {
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md', { draft: draftOf('conflicted') })], drafts: workspaceHolder(path, cls) });
    const page = pageAt('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main') as DocsPageLocation & { kind: 'path' };
    const pin: DocPin = { kind: 'draft', branch: 'main', head: COMMIT_A, section: 'specs', path: 'a.md', fp: FP_1 };
    expect(truthSource(tree, page, pin)).toBe(`draft · conflicted in ${label}`);
  });

  it('truthSource: a committed pin, a committed view, and nothing opened', () => {
    const tree = treeOk();
    const pin: DocPin = { kind: 'committed', commit: COMMIT_A, servedRef: SERVED, section: 'specs', path: 'a.md' };
    const leaf = (url: string): DocsPageLocation & { kind: 'path' } => pageAt(url) as DocsPageLocation & { kind: 'path' };
    expect(truthSource(tree, leaf('/docs/demo/specs/a.md'), pin)).toBe('committed');
    expect(truthSource(tree, leaf('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main&view=committed'), pin)).toBe('committed (view=committed)');
    expect(truthSource(tree, leaf('/docs/demo/specs/a.md'), null)).toBe('nothing opened');
  });

  it('a withheld draft opens committed: source `committed` and the badge beside it', () => {
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md', { draft: draftOf('modified', { fp: null }) })], drafts: holder() });
    head('/docs/demo/specs/a.md?ref=main', tree);
    expect(q('.docs-truth-source').textContent).toBe('committed');
    expect(q('.docs-head .docs-badge').textContent).toBe('draft · withheld');
  });
});

describe('one badge function: the row and the leaf say the same (M4.T7, base form)', () => {
  const COMMITTED = { kind: 'file', blob: BLOB_2, size: 100 } as const;
  it.each([
    ['modified', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('modified') }],
    ['conflicted', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('conflicted') }],
    ['added (new)', { committed: null, draft: draftOf('added') }],
    ['untracked (new)', { committed: null, draft: draftOf('untracked') }],
    ['deleted', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('deleted', { kind: 'absent', fp: null, size: null }) }],
    ['typechange', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('typechange', { kind: 'symlink', fp: null }) }],
    ['withheld, too large', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('modified', { fp: null }) }],
    ['withheld, unreadable', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('modified', { kind: 'unreadable', fp: null }) }],
    ['withheld, not a file', { committed: COMMITTED, draft: draftOf('modified', { kind: 'special', fp: null }) }],
  ] as const)('%s: the row badge equals the leaf badge, both ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT[entryView(...).badge]', (_name, over) => {
    const e: DocsEntry = { section: 'specs', path: 'x.md', ...over };
    const tree = treeOk({ entries: [e], drafts: holder() });
    const badge = entryView(e, tree.drafts, 'ref').badge;
    expect(badge).not.toBeNull();
    const want = ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT[badge ?? 'modified'];
    const row = render(<DocsTreeView tree={tree} page={pageAt('/docs/demo/specs?ref=main')} />);
    const rowText = row.container.querySelector('.docs-badge')?.textContent;
    row.unmount();
    const leaf = head('/docs/demo/specs/x.md?ref=main', tree);
    const leafText = leaf.container.querySelector('.docs-head .docs-badge')?.textContent;
    expect(rowText).toBe(want);
    expect(leafText).toBe(rowText);
  });
});

describe('the freshness chip (spec 4.5)', () => {
  const stamp = (over: Partial<NonNullable<DocsTreeOk['freshness']['stamp']>>): NonNullable<DocsTreeOk['freshness']['stamp']> =>
    ({ okAgeMs: 4 * MIN, attemptAgeMs: 4 * MIN, lastOutcome: 'ok', okCommit: COMMIT_A, ...over });
  const skipped: DocsRefreshFetch = { state: 'skipped', why: 'local-ref' };
  const cases: readonly [string, DocsTreeOk, Freshness, string, string][] = [
    ['no origin', withStamp(null, null), { s: 'idle' }, 'none', 'no origin'],
    ['never fetched', withStamp(null), { s: 'idle' }, 'never', 'never fetched ↻'],
    ['fetched, aged by now - receivedAt', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'idle' }, 'ok', 'fetched 5m ago ↻'],
    ['remote branch absent', withStamp(stamp({ lastOutcome: 'remote-branch-absent' })), { s: 'idle' }, 'local', 'local only ↻'],
    ['a failed stamp', withStamp(stamp({ lastOutcome: 'fetch-transport', okAgeMs: 179 * MIN })), { s: 'idle' }, 'failed',
      'fetch failed 5m ago: Fetching from origin failed: the connection to origin did not work. · last good 3h ago ↻'],
    ['a failed stamp that never succeeded', withStamp(stamp({ lastOutcome: 'fetch-timeout', okAgeMs: null })), { s: 'idle' },
      'failed', 'fetch failed 5m ago: Fetching from origin took too long and was stopped. · last good never ↻'],
    ['in flight', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'fetching', reason: 'manual' }, 'fetching', 'fetching…'],
    ['fetch-too-soon', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'soon', retryAt: NOW + 4000 }, 'soon', 'fetched moments ago; again in 4s'],
    ['a stale lock', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'stale-lock', ref: 'refs/remotes/origin/main' }, 'failed',
      'stale lock on refs/remotes/origin/main'],
    ['a stale lock whose answer named no ref', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'stale-lock', ref: null }, 'failed',
      'stale lock (the answer named no ref)'],
    ['skipped: a local ref', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'answered', fetch: skipped, at: NOW }, 'local',
      'local ref; fetch does not change it'],
    ['a fetch failure answered now, beside the last good stamp', withStamp(stamp({})),
      { s: 'answered', fetch: fetchFailed('fetch-auth-failed'), at: NOW }, 'failed',
      "fetch failed just now: Fetching from origin was refused: the fleet box's credentials were not accepted. · last good 5m ago ↻"],
    ['a fetch that ran: the new stamp', withStamp(stamp({ attemptAgeMs: 0 })), { s: 'answered', fetch: RAN, at: NOW }, 'ok',
      'fetched just now ↻'],
    ['a re-list that failed', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'relist-failed', answer: { s: 'unreachable' } }, 'failed',
      're-list failed: The server could not be reached; Docs needs a connection. ↻'],
    ['a refresh with no route answer', withStamp(stamp({})), { s: 'refresh-failed', answer: failedAnswer('docs-busy') },
      'failed', 'refresh failed: Docs is busy with other reads right now. ↻'],
  ];

  it.each(cases)('%s', (_name, tree, freshness, state, text) => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({ now: NOW });
    render(<DocsHead page={pageAt('/docs/demo')} visit={visitOf(tree, { freshness }, NOW - MIN)} tree={tree} />);
    expect(q('.docs-fresh')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', state);
    expect(q('.docs-fresh').textContent).toBe(text);
  });

  it('no origin is static text, not a button', () => {
    head('/docs/demo', withStamp(null, null));
    expect(q('.docs-fresh').tagName).toBe('SPAN');
  });

  it('a tap is one manual refresh; in flight the chip is disabled', () => {
    const refreshManual = vi.fn();
    const tree = withStamp(null);
    const { rerender } = render(<DocsHead page={pageAt('/docs/demo')} visit={visitOf(tree, { refreshManual })} tree={tree} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'never fetched ↻' }));
    expect(refreshManual).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    rerender(<DocsHead page={pageAt('/docs/demo')} visit={visitOf(tree, { refreshManual, freshness: { s: 'fetching', reason: 'manual' } })} tree={tree} />);
    const chip = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'fetching…' });
    expect(chip).toBeDisabled();
    fireEvent.click(chip);
    expect(refreshManual).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('the age follows useNow(30 000): two minutes later it reads two minutes older', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({ now: NOW });
    const tree = withStamp(stamp({}));
    render(<DocsHead page={pageAt('/docs/demo')} visit={visitOf(tree, {}, NOW - MIN)} tree={tree} />);
    expect(q('.docs-fresh').textContent).toBe('fetched 5m ago ↻');
    act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(2 * MIN); });
    expect(q('.docs-fresh').textContent).toBe('fetched 7m ago ↻');
  });
});

describe('View on GitHub (spec 3.11, 4.5)', () => {

describe('copy commit through copyText (spec 4.5, refinement (t))', () => {
  const clipboard = (writeText: (s: string) => Promise<void>): void => {
    Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', { value: { writeText }, configurable: true });

  it('copyText writes through the clipboard, and rejects when there is none', async () => {
    const writeText = vi.fn(async () => {});
    clipboard(writeText);
    await expect(copyText('x')).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('x');

    await expect(copyText('x')).rejects.toThrow('The clipboard is not available here.');

  });
});
```

```tsx
// Docs W5 part 1, Task 10: the banners (spec 2026-10-01 4.5's table; M4.T2, M4.T3, M4.T4, M4.T5; spec 2 rows 54 and
// 67). The default view never overlays and its hint links the QUALIFIED `refs/heads/<branch>`; a ref view overlays
// only when the holder's HEAD is the served commit, and otherwise says what the drafts are based on; each drafts
// state that shows no drafts says why; a leaf's withheld, deleted, type-changed and conflicted drafts, a commit the
// branch no longer contains, a page's drafted images and `view=committed` each have their banner. Unit cases render
// `DocsBanners`; rows 67 and M4.T2-T3 mount `DocsScreen` with injected loaders. Placeholders only: project `demo`,
// branches `main` and `ws/a`, `/repo/...`.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import type { DocsEntry, DocsTreeOk, DraftsFacts } from '../../shared/docs';
import { DocsBanners } from '../src/docs/DocsBanners';
import type { DocsLoaders } from '../src/docs/failures';
import type { FileSlot } from '../src/docs/useDocsVisit';
import { parseMarkdown } from '../src/lib/markdownParse';
import type { MarkdownParser } from '../src/lib/markdownRunner';
import { navigate, useLocation } from '../src/lib/router';
import { DocsScreen } from '../src/screens/DocsScreen';
import { COMMIT_A, COMMIT_B, SERVED, draftOf, entry, fakeLoaders, fileResponse, holder, okTree, pageAt, treeOk } from './docsFixtures';

const parser: MarkdownParser = async (src) => parseMarkdown(src, 'docs');

function Routed(p: { readonly loaders: DocsLoaders }): ReactNode {
  const { path, search } = useLocation();
  return <DocsScreen path={path} search={search} loaders={p.loaders} parser={parser} />;
}

const banner = (id: string): HTMLElement | null => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-banner="${id}"]`);
const bannerIds = (): string[] => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-banner]')].map((n) => n.getAttribute('data-banner') ?? '');
const textOf = (id: string): string => banner(id)?.querySelector('.docs-banner-text')?.textContent ?? '';

const NONE: FileSlot = { s: 'none' };

function banners(url: string, tree: DocsTreeOk, file: FileSlot = NONE, draftAssets = 0, onRelist = vi.fn()): ReturnType<typeof render> {
  return render(<DocsBanners page={pageAt(url)} tree={tree} file={file} draftAssets={draftAssets} onRelist={onRelist} />);
}

/** Three drafts in the holder's worktree: a modified committed doc and two new ones. */
const THREE: DocsEntry[] = [
  entry('specs', 'a.md', { draft: draftOf('modified') }),
  { section: 'specs', path: 'n1.md', committed: null, draft: draftOf('untracked') },
  { section: 'specs', path: 'n2.md', committed: null, draft: draftOf('added') },
];

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
});

describe('the default view never overlays; its hint is qualified (M4.T2, row 67)', () => {
  it('a holder on local main with 3 dirty docs: zero draft rows, and a hint (n = 3) linking ?ref=refs/heads/main', async () => {
    const f = fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(treeOk({ entries: THREE, drafts: holder() })) });
    navigate('/docs/demo/specs');
    render(<Routed loaders={f.loaders} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText('3 uncommitted docs in main checkout on main')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open the draft view' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/docs/demo/specs?ref=refs/heads/main');
    expect([...document.querySelectorAll('.docs-listing .docs-row-name')].map((n) => n.textContent)).toEqual(['a.md']);
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-badge')).toBeNull();
    expect(banner('default-hint')).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', 'info');
    expect(banner('default-hint')).toHaveAttribute('role', 'status');
  });

  it('a default-view leaf reads the committed pin; loaders.file never receives a DraftPin', async () => {
    const f = fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(treeOk({ entries: THREE, drafts: holder() })) });
    navigate('/docs/demo/specs/a.md');
    render(<Routed loaders={f.loaders} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(f.file).toHaveBeenCalled());
    expect(f.file.mock.calls.every((c) => c[1].kind === 'committed')).toBe(true);
    expect(await screen.findByText('3 uncommitted docs in main checkout on main')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('one draft says doc, not docs; no drafts, no hint', () => {
    banners('/docs/demo/specs', treeOk({ entries: [THREE[0] as DocsEntry], drafts: holder() }));
    expect(textOf('default-hint')).toBe('1 uncommitted doc in main checkout on main');
    cleanup();
    banners('/docs/demo/specs', treeOk({ entries: [entry('specs', 'a.md')], drafts: holder() }));
    expect(banner('default-hint')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('a ref view overlays only when the base is equal (M4.T3, row 67)', () => {
  it('baseEqual false: the base hint linking refs/heads/<b>, and no overlay', async () => {
    const drafts = holder(COMMIT_B, false);
    const f = fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(treeOk({ entries: THREE, drafts })) });
    navigate('/docs/demo/specs?ref=main');
    render(<Routed loaders={f.loaders} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(
      '3 uncommitted docs in main checkout are based on local main at bbbbbbbb; this page shows origin/main')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open the local view' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/docs/demo/specs?ref=refs/heads/main');
    expect([...document.querySelectorAll('.docs-listing .docs-row-name')].map((n) => n.textContent)).toEqual(['a.md']);
    expect(document.querySelector('.docs-badge')).toBeNull();
    expect(banner('default-hint')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('baseEqual true: the overlay appears, and neither hint', async () => {
    const f = fakeLoaders({ tree: okTree(treeOk({ entries: THREE, drafts: holder() })) });
    navigate('/docs/demo/specs?ref=main');
    render(<Routed loaders={f.loaders} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelectorAll('.docs-listing .docs-badge')).toHaveLength(3));
    expect([...document.querySelectorAll('.docs-listing .docs-badge')].map((n) => n.textContent).sort())
      .toEqual(['draft · modified', 'draft · new', 'draft · new']);
    expect(banner('default-hint')).toBeNull();
    expect(banner('base-hint')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('each drafts state that shows no drafts says why (M4.T4)', () => {
  const cases: readonly [string, DraftsFacts, string, 'info' | 'warn'][] = [
    ['ambiguous', { state: 'ambiguous', branch: 'main', candidates: ['/repo/wt/a', '/repo/wt/b'] },
      'Two or more worktrees hold main, so drafts are not shown:', 'warn'],
    ['untrusted', { state: 'untrusted', branch: 'main', worktree: '/repo/wt/a', why: 'foreign-owner' },
      'The worktree holding main failed the ownership check (foreign-owner); drafts are not shown.', 'warn'],
    ['unreadable', { state: 'unreadable', branch: 'main', worktree: '/repo/wt/a', step: 'status', detail: 'x' },
      'Drafts could not be read (status); showing committed only.', 'warn'],
    ['unsettled', { state: 'unsettled', branch: 'main', worktree: '/repo/wt/a' },
      'The worktree changed while Docs read it; showing committed only.', 'info'],
    ['too-many', { state: 'too-many', branch: 'main', worktree: '/repo/wt/a', count: 1200, bytes: 9 },
      '1200 uncommitted files is over the limit; showing committed only.', 'info'],
    ['skipped', { state: 'none', branch: 'main', skipped: [
      { path: '/repo/wt/a', why: 'prunable' }, { path: '/repo/wt/b', why: 'missing-dir' }, { path: '/repo/wt/c', why: 'prunable' },
    ] }, '3 worktree records for main were skipped (prunable, missing-dir).', 'info'],
  ];

  it.each(cases)('%s', (id, drafts, text, tone) => {
    banners('/docs/demo/specs?ref=main', treeOk({ drafts }));
    expect(textOf(id)).toBe(text);
    expect(banner(id)).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', tone);
    expect(bannerIds()).toEqual([id]);
  });

  it('ambiguous lists its candidates', () => {
    banners('/docs/demo', treeOk({ drafts: { state: 'ambiguous', branch: 'main', candidates: ['/repo/wt/a', '/repo/wt/b'] } }));
    expect([...(banner('ambiguous')?.querySelectorAll('li') ?? [])].map((n) => n.textContent)).toEqual(['/repo/wt/a', '/repo/wt/b']);
  });

  it('unsettled offers Retry, which re-lists', () => {
    const onRelist = vi.fn();
    banners('/docs/demo', treeOk({ drafts: { state: 'unsettled', branch: 'main', worktree: '/repo/wt/a' } }), NONE, 0, onRelist);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    expect(onRelist).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('none with nothing skipped says nothing', () => {
    banners('/docs/demo', treeOk());
    expect(bannerIds()).toEqual([]);
  });

  const CAVEAT_TEXT: Readonly<Record<'caveat-hash' | 'caveat-filters', string>> = {
    'caveat-hash': 'Some drafts were found by content hash.',
    'caveat-filters': 'Clean/smudge filters were bypassed; drafts show raw working-tree bytes.',
  };

  it.each([
    [['assume-unchanged'], ['caveat-hash']],
    [['skip-worktree', 'assume-unchanged'], ['caveat-hash']],
    [['filters-bypassed'], ['caveat-filters']],
    [['skip-worktree', 'filters-bypassed'], ['caveat-hash', 'caveat-filters']],
  ] as const)('a holder with caveats %j says %j', (caveats, ids) => {
    const h = holder() as Extract<DraftsFacts, { state: 'holder' }>;
    banners('/docs/demo?ref=main', treeOk({ drafts: { ...h, caveats: [...caveats] } }));
    expect(bannerIds()).toEqual(ids);
    expect(ids.map(textOf)).toEqual(ids.map((id) => CAVEAT_TEXT[id]));
  });

  it('the index has no banners', () => {
    const { container } = banners('/docs', treeOk({ drafts: { state: 'unsettled', branch: 'main', worktree: '/repo/wt/a' } }));
    expect(container.innerHTML).toBe('');
  });
});
```

```ts
// Source scans over the Docs screen's own code (native Docs reader, W5; spec 2026-10-01 4.15). Each clause reads
// files with TypeScript's full parser (`ts.createSourceFile` and a walk of its syntax tree), never a regular
// expression, so a comment, a string or a template that merely spells a form is not a read (lesson 8).
//
// Clause 1, M4.T7's base form ("one badge function"; W5 part 1 Task 10): no file under `pwa/src/docs`, nor
// `pwa/src/screens/DocsScreen.tsx`, reads a draft's `state`. Every draft word a page shows comes from L0's
// `entryView` (its `opens`, `badge` and `withheld`) through `ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT` and `WITHHELD_SENTENCE`, so the row and
// the leaf cannot disagree. The walk finds a `state` member read off a `draft` member: `x.draft.state`,
// `x?.draft?.state`, `x['draft'].state`, `x.draft['state']`, through parentheses, `!`, `as` and `satisfies`; and the
// destructuring forms `const { state } = x.draft` and `const { draft: { state } } = x`.
// NOT EXHAUSTIVE. Known evasions it does not see: a draft held in a variable first (`const d = x.draft; d.state`), a
// key held in a variable (`x.draft[key]`), a parameter typed as the draft (`(d: Draft) => d.state`), assignment
// destructuring (`({ state } = x.draft)`), `Object.entries` / `Object.values` / a spread over a draft, and anything
// reached through `any`. Review lens 4 reads for those, and docs-truth.test.tsx's row/leaf equality case catches a
// second badge whatever its spelling.
//
// W5 part 2 appends its clauses (M4.SH7, M4.EX2, M4.EX11, M4.EX16) below this one.
import { cpSync, mkdtempSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import ts from 'typescript';
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const PWA = path.join(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const DOCS_DIR = path.join(PWA, 'src', 'docs');
const DOCS_SCREEN = path.join(PWA, 'src', 'screens', 'DocsScreen.tsx');

/** Every `.ts` and `.tsx` file at `root` (a file) or under it (a directory), sorted. */
function sourceFiles(root: string): string[] {
  if (statSync(root).isFile()) return [root];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const name of readdirSync(root).sort()) {
    const p = path.join(root, name);
    if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) out.push(...sourceFiles(p));
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(name)) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

/** An expression with its parentheses, `!`, `as`, `satisfies` and `<T>` casts taken off. */
function unwrap(n: ts.Expression): ts.Expression {
  let e = n;
  while (ts.isParenthesizedExpression(e) || ts.isNonNullExpression(e) || ts.isAsExpression(e)
    || ts.isSatisfiesExpression(e) || ts.isTypeAssertionExpression(e)) e = e.expression;
  return e;
}

/** The member an access reads (`x.name`, `x?.name`, `x['name']`); undefined for a key the parser cannot name. */
function memberName(n: ts.Node): string | undefined {
  if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n)) return n.name.text;
  if (ts.isElementAccessExpression(n)) {
    const a = n.argumentExpression;
    if (ts.isStringLiteral(a) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(a)) return a.text;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The property a binding element takes (`{ state }`, `{ state: s }`, `{ 'state': s }`). */
function bindingKey(el: ts.BindingElement): string | undefined {
  const key = el.propertyName ?? el.name;
  if (ts.isIdentifier(key) || ts.isStringLiteral(key)) return key.text;
  return undefined;
}

/** Whether an object binding pattern destructures a draft: `= x.draft`, or nested under a `draft` key. */
function bindsDraft(pattern: ts.ObjectBindingPattern): boolean {
  const parent = pattern.parent;
  if (ts.isVariableDeclaration(parent)) {
    return parent.initializer !== undefined && memberName(unwrap(parent.initializer)) === 'draft';
  }
  return ts.isBindingElement(parent) && bindingKey(parent) === 'draft';
}

/** Every read of a draft's `state` in one module, as `<file>:<line>:<column>`. */
function draftStateReads(source: string, fileName: string): string[] {
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(fileName, source, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true,
    fileName.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS);
  const hits: string[] = [];
  const at = (n: ts.Node): void => {
    const { line, character } = sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(n.getStart(sf));
    hits.push(`${fileName}:${line + 1}:${character + 1}`);
  };
  const visit = (n: ts.Node): void => {
    if ((ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n) || ts.isElementAccessExpression(n)) && memberName(n) === 'state'
      && memberName(unwrap(n.expression)) === 'draft') at(n);
    if (ts.isObjectBindingPattern(n) && bindsDraft(n)) {
      for (const el of n.elements) if (bindingKey(el) === 'state') at(el);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return hits;
}

/** The scan over a tree: every hit in every source file under `roots`, named relative to `base`. */
function scanTree(roots: readonly string[], base: string): { files: string[]; hits: string[] } {
  const files = roots.flatMap(sourceFiles);
  const hits = files.flatMap((f) => draftStateReads(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'), path.relative(base, f)));
  return { files: files.map((f) => path.relative(base, f)), hits };
}

describe("clause 1: no Docs file reads a draft's state (M4.T7, base form)", () => {
  it.each([
    ['e.draft.state', "export const f = (e: E) => e.draft.state;"],
    ['e.draft?.state', "export const f = (e: E) => e.draft?.state;"],
    ['e?.draft?.state', "export const f = (e?: E) => e?.draft?.state;"],
    ["e['draft'].state", "export const f = (e: E) => e['draft'].state;"],
    ["e.draft['state']", "export const f = (e: E) => e.draft['state'];"],
    ["e['draft']['state']", "export const f = (e: E) => e['draft']['state'];"],
    ['(e.draft).state', "export const f = (e: E) => (e.draft).state;"],
    ['e.draft!.state', "export const f = (e: E) => e.draft!.state;"],
    ['(e.draft as D).state', "export const f = (e: E) => (e.draft as D).state;"],
    ['const { state } = e.draft', "export function f(e: E) { const { state } = e.draft; return state; }"],
    ['const { state: s } = e.draft!', "export function f(e: E) { const { state: s } = e.draft!; return s; }"],
    ['const { draft: { state } } = e', "export function f(e: E) { const { draft: { state } } = e; return state; }"],
    ['a JSX expression', "export const F = (p: P) => <span>{p.e.draft.state === 'deleted' ? 'x' : 'y'}</span>;"],
  ])('finds %s', (_name, source) => {
    expect(draftStateReads(source, 'planted.tsx')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it.each([
    ['a DraftsFacts state', 'export const f = (t: T) => t.drafts.state;'],
    ["a draft's other field", 'export const f = (e: E) => e.draft?.size;'],
    ['a state off something else', "export const f = (r: R) => r.state === 'ready';"],
    ['a comment', '// e.draft.state is never read\nexport const x = 1;'],
    ['a string', "export const x = 'e.draft.state';"],
  ])('does not count %s', (_name, source) => {
    expect(draftStateReads(source, 'planted.ts')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each([
    ['a variable holding the draft', 'export function f(e: E) { const d = e.draft; return d?.state; }'],
    ['a computed key', 'export const f = (e: E, k: K) => e.draft[k];'],
    ['a parameter typed as the draft', 'export const f = (d: Draft) => d.state;'],
  ])('known evasion, not seen (the header says not exhaustive): %s', (_name, source) => {
    expect(draftStateReads(source, 'planted.ts')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('the Docs screen code reads no draft state', () => {
    const { files, hits } = scanTree([DOCS_DIR, DOCS_SCREEN], PWA);
    expect(files).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
      'src/docs/DocsHead.tsx', 'src/docs/DocsBanners.tsx', 'src/docs/DocsTreeView.tsx', 'src/docs/docsLinks.ts',
      'src/screens/DocsScreen.tsx',
    ]));
    expect(hits).toEqual([]);

  describe('a planted control in a copy of the tree', () => {
```

```ts
/** The header's words (spec 4.4's layout; spec 4.5's truth line, freshness chip and actions; W5 part 1 Task 10). The
 *  chip's texts are spec 4.5's table, verbatim; the rest fill its silences in the same register. `{age}` and `{okAge}`
 *  are `formatAge`'s, `{n}` a count of whole seconds, `{sentence}` a failure's or a client slot's sentence, and
 *  `{badge}` is `ENTRY_BADGE_TEXT`'s (or `sourceDraftUnbadged`). */
export const DOCS_HEAD_TEXT = {
  back: 'Up one level',
  crumbs: 'Docs path',
  crumbsMore: 'Show the whole path',
  index: 'Docs',
  servedOrigin: 'origin/{name}',
  servedLocal: '{name} (local)',

  copyFailed: 'copy failed',
  sourceCommitted: 'committed',

  github: 'View on GitHub',
  githubMayDiffer: "GitHub's copy may differ from this view",
  githubOff: 'View on GitHub: {reason}',
  openCommitted: 'Open committed version',
  freshNone: 'no origin',
  freshNever: 'never fetched ↻',
  freshOk: 'fetched {age} ↻',
  freshLocalOnly: 'local only ↻',
  freshFailed: 'fetch failed {age}: {sentence} · last good {okAge} ↻',
  freshNeverGood: 'never',
  freshFetching: 'fetching…',
  freshSoon: 'fetched moments ago; again in {n}s',
  freshStaleLock: 'stale lock on {ref}',
  freshStaleLockUnnamed: 'stale lock (the answer named no ref)',
  freshLocalRef: 'local ref; fetch does not change it',
  freshRelistFailed: 're-list failed: {sentence} ↻',
  freshRefreshFailed: 'refresh failed: {sentence} ↻',
  worktreeMain: 'main checkout',
  worktreeWorkspace: 'workspace {name}',
} as const;

/** Why View on GitHub gives no link (spec 3.11's refusals), as "View on GitHub: {reason}". */
export const GITHUB_REFUSAL_TEXT: Record<Extract<GithubLink, { ok: false }>['why'], string> = {
  'no-github-origin': 'no GitHub origin',
  'not-on-origin': 'not pushed',
  'uncommitted': 'not committed',
  'bad-slug': "the repository's GitHub name cannot be linked",
  'bad-target': 'this branch or path cannot be linked',
};

/** The banners' words (spec 4.5's table, verbatim; W5 part 1 Task 10). `{s}` is `pluralS`'s; `{label}` is
 *  `worktreeLabel`'s; `{served}` is `servedRefText`'s; `{why}` in `skipped` is the distinct reasons joined by `, `. */
export const DOCS_BANNER_TEXT = {
  defaultHint: '{n} uncommitted doc{s} in {label} on {branch}',
  baseHint: '{n} uncommitted doc{s} in {label} are based on local {branch} at {short}; this page shows {served}',
  openLocalView: 'Open the local view',
  ambiguous: 'Two or more worktrees hold {branch}, so drafts are not shown:',
  untrusted: 'The worktree holding {branch} failed the ownership check ({why}); drafts are not shown.',
  unreadable: 'Drafts could not be read ({step}); showing committed only.',
  unsettled: 'The worktree changed while Docs read it; showing committed only.',
  retry: 'Retry',
  tooMany: '{count} uncommitted files is over the limit; showing committed only.',
  skipped: '{k} worktree records for {branch} were skipped ({why}).',
  caveatHash: 'Some drafts were found by content hash.',
  caveatFilters: 'Clean/smudge filters were bypassed; drafts show raw working-tree bytes.',
  showingCommitted: 'Showing the committed version.',
  deleted: 'Deleted in {label} (uncommitted).',
  typechange: 'Its type changed in {label}; the draft is not read.',
  conflicted: 'Contains unresolved merge-conflict markers.',
  notContained: 'Commit {short} is no longer on {served} (the branch was rewritten).',
  relist: 'Re-list',
  draftAssets: 'This draft page embeds {k} uncommitted asset{s}.',
  viewCommitted: 'Showing the committed version at {short}.',
  backToDraft: 'Back to the draft',
} as const;

/** The served ref as the truth line and the banners name it (spec 4.5): `origin/<b>` when the origin side is served,
 *  `<b> (local)` when the local side is; the full refname (`ref.served`) goes in a `title` beside it. */
export function servedRefText(ref: DocsTreeOk['ref']): string {
  return fillSentence(ref.side === 'origin' ? DOCS_HEAD_TEXT.servedOrigin : DOCS_HEAD_TEXT.servedLocal, { name: ref.name });
}

/** A worktree as the truth line and the banners name it (spec 4.5): "main checkout", "workspace <last segment>", or
 *  the path's last two segments; the full path goes in a `title` beside it. */
export function worktreeLabel(w: { readonly path: string; readonly class: 'main' | 'workspace' | 'other' }): string {
  const parts = w.path.split('/').filter((s) => s !== '');
  switch (w.class) {
    case 'main':
      return DOCS_HEAD_TEXT.worktreeMain;
    case 'workspace':
      return fillSentence(DOCS_HEAD_TEXT.worktreeWorkspace, { name: parts.at(-1) ?? w.path });
    case 'other':
      return parts.slice(-2).join('/');
  }
}
```

```ts
// The Docs screen's clipboard writer (spec 2026-10-01 4.5's "One clipboard writer"; refinement (t); W5 part 1 Task
// 10). `copyText` is the ONE place under `pwa/src/docs` that writes the clipboard: the truth line's "copy commit" in
// part 1, and part 2's share sheet ("Copy link") beside it, which adds `shareTargetFor` here (`downloadExport` goes
// beside `saveBytes` in `docs/objectUrls.ts`, spec 4.1 and 5.4).

/** Writes `text` to the clipboard. Resolves once it is written; rejects when the clipboard refuses, or when the page
 *  has none (`navigator.clipboard` is absent outside a secure context, whatever the DOM types say). */
export async function copyText(text: string): Promise<void> {
  const clipboard: Clipboard | undefined = navigator.clipboard;
  if (clipboard === undefined) throw new Error('The clipboard is not available here.');
  await clipboard.writeText(text);
}
```
