Create `pwa/browser/harness.ts` with exactly:

```ts
// The real-browser leg's harness (native Docs reader spec 2026-10-01 5.7; W5 part 1 Task 12). Three things only:
// which Chrome to drive, three loopback origins that record every request they receive, and fixture bytes built from
// the L0 tables rather than typed. It runs in the browser config's vitest process (`vitest.browser.config.ts`), never
// in the hermetic run, which excludes `browser/**`; `test/browser-leg.test.ts` imports `resolveChrome` alone.
//
// Origins: A and B are `127.0.0.1` on two ephemeral ports (same site, two origins), C is `localhost` (another site).
// Every origin serves every route, over plain `node:http`, so a docs fixture carries exactly the headers its route
// answers with (`DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS` from `shared/docs.ts`, or a control's subset) and no Fastify is involved.
import { accessSync, constants, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server, type ServerResponse } from 'node:http';
import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net';
import { crc32, deflateSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { DOCS_RASTER_TYPES } from '../../shared/docs';

/** Where Chrome lives on a GitHub `ubuntu-latest` runner, the leg's CI home. */
export const DEFAULT_CHROME = '/usr/bin/google-chrome';

function isExecutableFile(p: string): boolean {
  try {
    if (!statSync(p).isFile()) return false;
    accessSync(p, constants.X_OK);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** The Chrome the leg drives: `CCRC_CHROME` when it names an executable file, else `fallback` (`DEFAULT_CHROME`)
 *  when that is one. With neither it THROWS, naming both: the browser test calls it in `beforeAll`, so a box with no
 *  Chrome gives a red leg, never a skipped one (spec 5.7). An empty `CCRC_CHROME` counts as unset. `fallback` is a
 *  parameter only so the hermetic test can name a path that does not exist on a box that has Chrome. */
export function resolveChrome(
  env: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>> = process.env,
  fallback: string = DEFAULT_CHROME,
): string {
  const named = env['CCRC_CHROME'];
  if (named !== undefined && named !== '' && isExecutableFile(named)) return named;
  if (isExecutableFile(fallback)) return fallback;
  const said = named === undefined || named === '' ? 'unset' : `${JSON.stringify(named)}, which is not an executable file`;
  throw new Error(`no Chrome for the browser leg: CCRC_CHROME is ${said}, and ${fallback} is not an executable file. `
    + 'Set CCRC_CHROME to a Chrome or Chromium binary; this leg never skips.');
}

export type OriginName = 'a' | 'b' | 'c';

/** One request an origin received, recorded before it is answered. `cookie` is null when the request carried no
 *  `Cookie` header. `path` is the pathname with its query. */
export interface OriginHit {
  readonly origin: OriginName;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly path: string;
  readonly cookie: string | null;
}

/** A route's answer. `status` absent means 200. `headers` are sent exactly as given, nothing added. */
export interface OriginAnswer {
  readonly status?: number;
  readonly headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  readonly body: string | Uint8Array;
}

/** A fixture route, keyed by pathname in `startOrigins`' table and served by every origin. */
export type OriginRoute = (hit: OriginHit) => OriginAnswer;

export interface Origins {
  readonly a: string;
  readonly b: string;
  readonly c: string;
  /** Every request any origin received, in arrival order, unknown paths included (they answer 404). */
  readonly hits: readonly OriginHit[];
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

const NOT_FOUND: OriginAnswer = { status: 404, headers: { 'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' }, body: 'no such fixture' };

/** Start A, B and C on ephemeral ports, each serving `routes`. */
export async function startOrigins(routes: Readonly<Record<string, OriginRoute>>): Promise<Origins> {
  const hits: OriginHit[] = [];
  const handler = (origin: OriginName) => (req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): void => {
    const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://fixture.invalid');
    const hit: OriginHit = { origin, method: req.method ?? '', path: url.pathname + url.search, cookie: req.headers.cookie ?? null };
    hits.push(hit);
    const route = Object.hasOwn(routes, url.pathname) ? routes[url.pathname] : undefined;
    const answer = route === undefined ? NOT_FOUND : route(hit);
    res.writeHead(answer.status ?? 200, { ...answer.headers });
    res.end(answer.body);
  };
  const listen = (origin: OriginName): Promise<Server> => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const server = createServer(handler(origin));
    server.once('error', reject);
    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve(server));
  });
  const [sa, sb, sc] = await Promise.all([listen('a'), listen('b'), listen('c')]);
  const port = (s: Server): number => (s.address() as AddressInfo).port;
  const close = (s: Server): Promise<void> => new Promise((resolve) => {
    s.closeAllConnections();
    s.close(() => resolve());
  });
  return {
    a: `http://127.0.0.1:${port(sa)}`,
    b: `http://127.0.0.1:${port(sb)}`,
    c: `http://localhost:${port(sc)}`,
    hits,
    close: async () => { await Promise.all([close(sa), close(sb), close(sc)]); },
  };
}

/** The first hit from index `from` on that `pred` accepts, polled every 50 ms for at most `ms`; null when none came. */
export async function waitForHit(o: Origins, from: number, pred: (h: OriginHit) => boolean, ms: number): Promise<OriginHit | null> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + ms;
  for (;;) {
    const found = o.hits.slice(from).find(pred);
    if (found !== undefined) return found;
    if (Date.now() >= deadline) return null;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50));
  }
}

function pngChunk(type: string, data: Uint8Array): Buffer {
  const head = Buffer.alloc(4);
  head.writeUInt32BE(data.length);
  const typed = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(type, 'latin1'), data]);
  const crc = Buffer.alloc(4);
  crc.writeUInt32BE(crc32(typed));
  return Buffer.concat([head, typed, crc]);
}

/** A 1x1 RGBA PNG: the table's own magic (never typed here), then IHDR, one deflated row and IEND. */
export function onePixelPng(): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(1, 0); // width
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(1, 4); // height
  ihdr.set([8, 6, 0, 0, 0], 8); // bit depth 8, colour type 6 (RGBA), deflate, no filter method, no interlace
  const row = Buffer.from([0, 0x2f, 0x6f, 0x9f, 0xff]); // filter byte 0, then one opaque pixel
  return Uint8Array.from(Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from(DOCS_RASTER_TYPES.png.magic[0][0].bytes),
    pngChunk('IHDR', ihdr),
    pngChunk('IDAT', deflateSync(row)),
    pngChunk('IEND', new Uint8Array(0)),
  ]));
}

Create `pwa/browser/docs-headers.browser.test.ts` with exactly:

```ts
// The real-browser rows of native Docs reader spec 2026-10-01 5.8 that W5 owns: M5.B5 (an SVG drawn as Docs draws one,
// a `data:` image, runs nothing and fetches nothing) and M5.B6 (`DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS` keep a docs raster out of
// another origin's page, an SVG labelled as a raster inert, and a JSON docs response from executing as a script).
// These are claims about what Chrome DOES with the production values, which jsdom cannot show, so each row drives a
// real Chrome through `playwright-core` (spec 5.7) over the production header values (`shared/docs.ts`), the
// production SVG URL builder (`svgDataUrl`, `docs/DocImage.tsx`) and fixture bytes built from the L0 raster table.
// Every property has a control that inverts it, run in the same Chrome against the same origins, so a property that
// holds only because the fixture never loaded, or because the detector is blind, is red.
//
// Chrome comes from `resolveChrome()` in `beforeAll`, which THROWS when neither `CCRC_CHROME` nor
// `/usr/bin/google-chrome` is an executable file: a box without Chrome gives a red leg, never a skipped one.
// Run: `( cd pwa && CCRC_CHROME=<a Chrome or Chromium binary> ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts )`.
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { chromium, type Browser, type BrowserContext, type Page } from 'playwright-core';
import { DOCS_RASTER_TYPES, DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS, sniffRaster } from '../../shared/docs';
import { svgDataUrl } from '../src/docs/DocImage';
import { onePixelPng, resolveChrome, startOrigins, waitForHit, type OriginAnswer, type OriginHit, type OriginRoute, type Origins } from './harness';

/** How long a property waits, after the page's `load`, for a script or a request that should never come. Each
 *  property's control waits for the same thing to come and sees it well inside this window. */
const SETTLE_MS = 1500;
/** How long a control waits for the thing it proves can happen. */
const CONTROL_MS = 20_000;
const MARK = 'ccrc-marker';
const JSON_TYPE = 'application/json; charset=utf-8';
const COOKIE = { name: 'ccrc_demo', value: 'a' } as const;

type DocsHeader = keyof typeof DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS;

/** `DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS` less the named ones: a control's headers. Never a hand-typed copy of the values. */
function docsHeadersWithout(...names: DocsHeader[]): Record<string, string> {
  const h: Record<string, string> = { ...DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS };
  for (const n of names) delete h[n];
  return h;
}

const PNG = onePixelPng();

let o: Origins;
let browser: Browser;
let ctx: BrowserContext;
let page: Page;
let consoleLines: string[];

/** An SVG that, if anything in it runs, says so twice (an `onload` and a `<script>`, each a console line and a
 *  request to A naming `tag`), and that asks B for an external image. Built from `o`, so only after the origins start. */
function hostileSvg(tag: string): string {
  const mark = (how: string): string => `fetch('${o.a}/marker/${tag}-${how}');console.log('${MARK} ${tag}-${how}')`;
  return '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1" height="1" '
    + `onload="${mark('onload')}">`
    + `<script>${mark('script')}</script>`
    + `<image href="${o.b}/external/${tag}.png" width="1" height="1"/>`
    + '<rect width="1" height="1" fill="#2f6f9f"/></svg>';
}

const utf8 = (s: string): Uint8Array => new TextEncoder().encode(s);

/** A plain page (no CSP of its own; no favicon request). */
function htmlPage(body: string): OriginAnswer {
  return {
    headers: { 'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' },
    body: `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><link rel="icon" href="data:,"><title>fixture</title></head><body>${body}</body></html>`,
  };
}

/** A script element whose outcome lands in `document.title`: `load` once it ran, `error` when it was refused. */
const scriptPage = (src: string): OriginAnswer =>
  htmlPage(`<script src="${src}" onload="document.title='load'" onerror="document.title='error'"></script>`);

const JSON_BODY = JSON.stringify(['ccrc-docs', 'demo']);

const ROUTES: Readonly<Record<string, OriginRoute>> = {
  // M5.B5: the SVG exactly as Docs draws one, an <img> whose src is svgDataUrl's data: URL.
  '/b5/data-img': () => htmlPage(`<img id="i" alt="d" src="${svgDataUrl(utf8(hostileSvg('b5')))}">`),
  // M5.B5's control: the same SVG as a top-level blob:image/svg+xml document, opened by a page on A.
  '/b5/blob-top': () => htmlPage('<script>'
    + `const t = ${JSON.stringify(hostileSvg('b5c')).replaceAll('<', '\\u003c')};`
    + "location.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([t], { type: 'image/svg+xml' }));</script>"),
  // M5.B6: a docs raster on A, with the production headers and with CORP removed (the control).
  '/docs/raster.png': () => ({ headers: { ...DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS, 'content-type': DOCS_RASTER_TYPES.png.mime }, body: PNG }),
  '/control/raster-no-corp.png': () => ({
    headers: { ...docsHeadersWithout('cross-origin-resource-policy'), 'content-type': DOCS_RASTER_TYPES.png.mime }, body: PNG,
  }),
  '/b6/img-docs': () => htmlPage(`<img id="i" alt="r" src="${o.a}/docs/raster.png">`),
  '/b6/img-no-corp': () => htmlPage(`<img id="i" alt="r" src="${o.a}/control/raster-no-corp.png">`),
  // M5.B6: an SVG body labelled as a raster, opened top-level; its control is the same body labelled as SVG, bare.
  '/docs/svg-as.png': () => ({ headers: { ...DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS, 'content-type': DOCS_RASTER_TYPES.png.mime }, body: hostileSvg('b6svg') }),
  '/control/svg.svg': () => ({ headers: { 'content-type': 'image/svg+xml' }, body: hostileSvg('b6svgc') }),
  // M5.B6: a JSON docs response as B's <script src>, with every header, with nosniff alone (no CORP), and bare.
  '/docs/doc.json': () => ({ headers: { ...DOCS_RESPONSE_HEADERS, 'content-type': JSON_TYPE }, body: JSON_BODY }),
  '/control/doc-nosniff-only.json': () => ({ headers: { ...docsHeadersWithout('cross-origin-resource-policy'), 'content-type': JSON_TYPE }, body: JSON_BODY }),
  '/control/doc-bare.json': () => ({
    headers: { ...docsHeadersWithout('cross-origin-resource-policy', 'x-content-type-options'), 'content-type': JSON_TYPE }, body: JSON_BODY,
  }),
  '/b6/script-docs': () => scriptPage(`${o.a}/docs/doc.json`),
  '/b6/script-nosniff-only': () => scriptPage(`${o.a}/control/doc-nosniff-only.json`),
  '/b6/script-bare': () => scriptPage(`${o.a}/control/doc-bare.json`),
};

beforeAll(async () => {
  const executablePath = resolveChrome(); // throws on a box with no Chrome: red, never skipped
  o = await startOrigins(ROUTES);
  browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath, headless: true });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await browser?.close();
  await o?.close();
});

beforeEach(async () => {
  ctx = await browser.newContext();
  await ctx.addCookies([{ ...COOKIE, url: o.a }]);
  page = await ctx.newPage();
  consoleLines = [];
  page.on('console', (m) => { consoleLines.push(m.text()); });
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await ctx.close();
});

const marks = (): string[] => consoleLines.filter((l) => l.includes(MARK));
const since = (from: number): OriginHit[] => o.hits.slice(from);
const where = (h: OriginHit): string => `${h.origin} ${h.path}`;

/** The `#i` image's naturalWidth once it has loaded or failed. */
function imageWidth(p: Page): Promise<number> {
  return p.evaluate(() => new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
    const i = document.getElementById('i') as HTMLImageElement;
    const done = (): void => resolve(i.naturalWidth);
    if (i.complete) done();
    else { i.addEventListener('load', done); i.addEventListener('error', done); }
  }));
}

/** What a `scriptPage` script did: `load` (it ran) or `error` (it was refused). */
async function scriptOutcome(p: Page): Promise<string> {
  await p.waitForFunction(() => document.title === 'load' || document.title === 'error', undefined, { timeout: CONTROL_MS });
  return p.title();
}

describe('the fixtures are what they claim', () => {
  it('the raster is a real PNG by the L0 table, and A draws it for itself (width 1)', async () => {
    expect(sniffRaster('png', PNG)).toBe('match');
    await page.goto(`${o.a}/b6/img-docs`);
    expect(await imageWidth(page)).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('M5.B5: an SVG drawn as Docs draws it, a data: image, runs nothing and requests nothing', () => {
  it('the page on A draws the SVG; no script runs (no marker request, no console line) and no request leaves the page', async () => {
    const from = o.hits.length;
    await page.goto(`${o.a}/b5/data-img`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
    await page.waitForTimeout(SETTLE_MS);
    expect(since(from).map(where), 'the only request is the page itself').toEqual(['a /b5/data-img']);
    expect(marks(), 'a script in the SVG ran').toEqual([]);
    expect(await imageWidth(page), 'the SVG was drawn, so nothing ran because nothing may').toBe(1);
  });

  it('control: the same SVG as a top-level blob:image/svg+xml runs as A, and its fetch carries A\'s cookie', async () => {
    const from = o.hits.length;
    await page.goto(`${o.a}/b5/blob-top`);
    const hit = await waitForHit(o, from, (h) => h.origin === 'a' && h.path === '/marker/b5c-script', CONTROL_MS);
    expect(hit, 'the blob document\'s script never ran').not.toBeNull();
    expect(hit?.cookie ?? '').toContain(`${COOKIE.name}=${COOKIE.value}`);
    expect(await waitForHit(o, from, (h) => h.origin === 'b' && h.path === '/external/b5c.png', CONTROL_MS)).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('M5.B6: the docs response headers', () => {
  it('pages on B (same site) and C (another site) <img> a docs raster: naturalWidth 0 on both, though the request arrives', async () => {
    for (const at of [o.b, o.c]) {
      const from = o.hits.length;
      await page.goto(`${at}/b6/img-docs`);
      expect(await imageWidth(page), `${at} drew A's docs raster`).toBe(0);
      expect(since(from).filter((h) => h.origin === 'a').map(where)).toEqual(['a /docs/raster.png']);
    }
  });

  it('control: without CORP the same raster is drawn on both, width 1', async () => {
    for (const at of [o.b, o.c]) {
      await page.goto(`${at}/b6/img-no-corp`);
      expect(await imageWidth(page), `${at} did not draw the raster without CORP`).toBe(1);
    }
  });

  it('an SVG body labelled image/png, opened top-level, runs no script', async () => {
    const from = o.hits.length;
    await page.goto(`${o.a}/docs/svg-as.png`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
    await page.waitForTimeout(SETTLE_MS);
    expect(since(from).map(where)).toEqual(['a /docs/svg-as.png']);
    expect(marks()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('control: the same body labelled image/svg+xml with no docs headers runs its script', async () => {
    const from = o.hits.length;
    await page.goto(`${o.a}/control/svg.svg`);
    expect(await waitForHit(o, from, (h) => h.origin === 'a' && h.path === '/marker/b6svgc-script', CONTROL_MS)).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("B's <script src> of a JSON docs response does not execute, with every header and with nosniff alone; the request arrives", async () => {
    for (const [pagePath, docPath] of [['/b6/script-docs', '/docs/doc.json'], ['/b6/script-nosniff-only', '/control/doc-nosniff-only.json']]) {
      const from = o.hits.length;
      await page.goto(`${o.b}${pagePath}`);
      expect(await scriptOutcome(page), `${docPath} executed on B`).toBe('error');
      expect(since(from).filter((h) => h.origin === 'a').map(where)).toEqual([`a ${docPath}`]);
    }
  });

  it('control: without nosniff (and CORP) the same JSON executes as B\'s script', async () => {
    await page.goto(`${o.b}/b6/script-bare`);
    expect(await scriptOutcome(page)).toBe('load');
  });
});
```

```markdown

## Deviations found

- **D-<n1> (<date>)** — W5 is two sequential runs on one plan family, not one run (spec §7.7's wave preamble, "one run row, with one worker and one reviewer run", and its W5 row; operator ruling 2026-10-13). W5's row ships about twenty right-sized tasks, which do not fit one context with a held-out review and a close. Part 1 (this plan, run 413) ships the L0 widening, the Docs screen, `DocMarkdown` with the r10, r11 and 2-2 bounds, the docs `<br>`, the doors, `docs.css` and the browser leg with M5.B5 and M5.B6, and the seams part 2 consumes (`pinFor`, `imagePinFor`, `detachUrls`' copy, `copyText`, `saveBytes`, `docs-scans.test.ts`, the browser harness); part 2 (its own plan, run, pull request and review, dispatched after part 1 merges, from a `main` that holds it) ships Share, Markdown, text and image Export, `ExportAssets`, the settled-outcome context, the Markdown CSS move and M5.B9. The three rows the spec amended in place split on the same line: M4.T7's base form (row and leaf badge equal, the scan over `pwa/src/docs`) is part 1's and its amended clause (share, provenance, export) part 2's; M4.S1's docs-chrome registrations are part 1's and its re-keying and Share and Export chrome part 2's; M5.17's `rasterObjectUrl`, `downloadDocFile` and `saveBytes` clauses are part 1's and its `downloadExport` clause part 2's. The merge gate splits by what each part ships: R1 and R2 gate part 1's merge (part 1 issues all of W5's docs traffic); §4.17's measurements, M5.B9 and the Export-time finding gate part 2's. Part 2's plan cites this entry. Refinement (a); every task of this plan.
- **D-<n2> (<date>)** — the `html` leaf renders a stand-in until W6, not `MockupView` (spec §4.4's leaf row: class `html` "gives §5's `MockupView`", which is W6's). Part 1 renders the leaf's header and truth line, the sentence "HTML mockups open in a later release; Source shows the file and Download saves it.", the size, **Source** (the text renderer over `docs.file`) and **Download** (`downloadDocFile`): no `iframe`, no `srcDoc`, no frame of any kind, and `?frame=full` renders the same stand-in. W6 replaces the stand-in with `MockupView` in `DocsLeaf.tsx`'s `html` arm; part 2's Share notes an `html` leaf as source, and Export is not offered for `html` in W5. Refinement (b); Task 9, row W5P1-T9-M19.
- **D-<n3> (<date>)** — a linked worktree whose `branch` is `null` is not called detached (spec §4.7's redirect sentence, "that checkout is detached; showing <owner>'s default branch"). `branch: null` covers both a detached HEAD and an unmeasured read (the W2 adapter's carried constraint), so the page says "That checkout is not on a named branch, or its branch could not be read; showing <owner>'s default branch." and redirects to the owner's default view (`ref: null`), by replace, as §4.7 says. Goal 4 ("a page says exactly what it served") outranks the quoted sentence. Refinement (c); Task 9, rows W5P1-T9-M5 and W5P1-T9-M6.
- **D-<n4> (<date>)** — the 2-2 bound lives in the parse's own element count, not in the shared Markdown components (spec §4.10's bounds on the shared components and the coordinator's ruling of 2026-10-13, which put all three bounds "in the shared Markdown components"). 2-2 is a count problem: `measure` counted an inline `code` as one element while `SHARED_COMPONENTS.code` draws a chord as chips, so `DOCS_MAX_RENDER_ELEMENTS` did not bound the DOM; a budget kept inside the components would be render-time mutable state (StrictMode's double render and React's render order would make it nondeterministic) and would cut a document mid-render. `markdownParse.ts`'s `measure` instead adds, for every inline `code` element (not under `pre`), `inlineCodeExtraElements` of its text, exactly what the component draws (2N-1 for a chord of N parts) beyond the one `code` the walk already counts: one `span.kbd-combo`, N `kbd` and N - 1 `span.kbd-plus` in its place, and 0 for a span that is not a chord. `keystrokeParts` moved into `markdownGuard.ts`, which both the parse and the components already import, so the count and the component answer through one predicate and no import or file joins the worker closure. So `too-wide` fires before anything renders, in the worker, for docs, chat's worker path and part 2's Export alike; chat's synchronous path (at most 4 096 bytes) is bounded by its size. The components keep r10's word bound and r11's length bound (`MD_KEYSTROKE_MAX_CHARS` = 64, which caps one span at 32 parts). Task 3 Step 0 measured the exact count moving no real document under `docs/superpowers` across `DOCS_MAX_RENDER_ELEMENTS`, where the upper bound first planned (`2 x (its '+' count) + 1` for every short span) moved four (recorded in the SDD ledger). Refinement (d); Task 3, rows W5P1-T3-M8 to W5P1-T3-M11.
- **D-<n5> (<date>)** — a Markdown leaf whose bytes arrived as base64 is formatted when they are strict UTF-8; only bytes that are not valid UTF-8 get the non-fatal decode, plain text and "Not valid UTF-8." (spec §4.10 step 6: a `.md` that arrived as base64 "decodes through a non-fatal `TextDecoder('utf-8')` and shows as plain text: 'Not valid UTF-8.'"). ccd's encoding rule (spec §2 (f)'s "Encoding", as §6.1 restates it) also sends VALID UTF-8 as base64, when the text holds a NUL or when base64 frames shorter (a quote-heavy file), so the literal reading would label a valid file "Not valid UTF-8." and decline to format it; goal 4 ("a page says exactly what it served") decides. `docMarkdownSource` decodes with `{fatal: true}` first: strict UTF-8 is Markdown; anything else is decoded non-fatally (each bad sequence a U+FFFD) and shown as `DocPlain` with `DOC_NOT_UTF8_NOTE`, which is the spec's behaviour for invalid bytes (coordinator ruling during planning, 2026-10-13). Refinement (x); Task 8's decision 6, rows W5P1-T8-M14, W5P1-T8-M15 and W5P1-T8-M20 (M20 reverts to the spec's literal reading).
```

Then write the three tools. `<SCRATCH>/tools/w5rows.py` is the one reader of the plan's rows blocks. It decodes each block with `raw_decode` from the character after the opening fence and never searches for the closing fence (a row whose `old` or `new` spells a code fence would cut the array short), and it refuses any id that is not this plan's shape:

```python
import json, re
# The rows marker and the code fence are built from parts, so this file never spells either one whole and no
# reader of the plan can mistake this file's text for a task's rows.
MARK = '**Mutation rows' + ' this task contributes**'
FENCE = '`' * 3


def read_rows(plan_path, tasks):
    """The rows blocks of the given task numbers, in task order; a repeated id keeps its LAST occurrence.

    Each array is read with raw_decode from the first character after its opening fence, never by searching for
    the closing fence: a row whose old or new text spells a code fence would cut the array short.
    """
    wanted = set(tasks)
    text = open(plan_path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    heads = [(m.start(), int(m.group(1))) for m in re.finditer(r'^### Task (\d+): ', text, re.M)]
    rows = {}
    for i, (start, n) in enumerate(heads):
        if n not in wanted:
            continue
        section = text[start:heads[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(heads) else len(text)]
        if MARK not in section:
            continue
        marker = section.index(MARK)
        body = section.index(FENCE + 'json', marker) + len(FENCE + 'json')
        decoded, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(section[body:].lstrip())
        for row in decoded:
            if not re.fullmatch(r'W5P1-T\d+-M\d+', row['id']):
                raise SystemExit(f'Task {n}: row id {row["id"]!r} is not W5P1-T<n>-M<k>')
            rows[row['id']] = row
    return rows
```

# usage: anchors.py <plan> <root>. Tasks 1-13 only: Task 14 adds no guard, and its prose is not read.

    count = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read().count(row['old']) if os.path.exists(path) and row['old'] else -1
    if count != 1:
        bad += 1
        print(f'{rid} {row["file"]} count={count} old={row["old"][:100]!r}')
print(f'{len(rows)} rows; {bad} not exactly once')

`<SCRATCH>/tools/rows.py` runs rows of one task alone in a copy and restores each file byte for byte, its mode included:

```python
import os, re, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from w5rows import read_rows
# usage: rows.py <plan> <copy> <task-number> [id ...]   (no ids: every row of that task's block)
# A browser-leg row (tests '--config vitest.browser.config.ts') needs CCRC_CHROME in the caller's environment.
plan, copy, task = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3])
only = set(sys.argv[4:])
for rid, row in read_rows(plan, [task]).items():
    if only and rid not in only:
        continue
    target = os.path.join(copy, row['file'])
    original = open(target, encoding='utf-8', newline='').read()
    if original.count(row['old']) != 1:
        print(rid, 'ANCHOR', original.count(row['old']))
        continue
    mode = os.stat(target).st_mode
    open(target, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(original.replace(row['old'], row['new']))
    # CI=1 for the PWA only: the golden test writes a MISSING snapshot file outside CI, and a row must never
    # write one into the copy. The server suites read CI for other things, so they run with the caller's env.
    env = dict(os.environ, CI='1') if row['pkg'] == 'pwa' else dict(os.environ)
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(['./node_modules/.bin/vitest', 'run', *row['tests']], cwd=os.path.join(copy, row['pkg']),
                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=540, env=env).stdout
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        out = 'TIMEOUT after 540 s'
    finally:
        open(target, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(original)
        os.chmod(target, mode)
    out = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', out)
    summary = [l.strip() for l in out.splitlines() if re.match(r'\s+Tests\s', l)] or [l for l in [out] if l.startswith('TIMEOUT')]
    failed = [l.strip() for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('×')]
    print(rid, summary, *failed, sep='\n    ')
```

Run at most one server row per Bash call, except rows on `docs-shared.test.ts` and `ci-pipeline.test.ts`, which take seconds. A `TIMEOUT` row is re-run alone once; if it repeats, it is a finding.

**Model routing:** `sonnet`, effort `high`, in the main loop; no subagent (every step is a command and a read of what it prints). The eight scratch tools are complete below. Any red that is not a measured load flake or a measured environment red, any `FAIL` invariant or gate check, and any mutation row that does not come back `red` is a FINDING: it is reported to the coordinator (Step 4's `finding` mail, or an ask when it needs the operator), never fixed silently and never weakened. The merge is not this task's: part 1 waits for R1 and R2 (How this wave runs, "Merge gate").

This task adds no guard and edits no source or test file, so it has no red-first step of its own: what it proves red is Tasks 1-13's guards (Step 4 runs every row at the wave's end state), and each of its own tools was proved able to fail while this plan was written (Measured while planning, items 3-6). Its one commit is Step 5's, the results section alone.

**Spec rows:** none of its own. Section 7.9's every-wave and W5 suites (Step 1); section 7.7's W5 gate, part 1's share (Step 5's `### Merge gate` placeholder for R1 and R2, the four bounds measured and stated with their bases, and every bound's case and row green through Step 4); every row of Tasks 1-13 through the mutation table (Step 4); lesson 10's built-artefact gate (Step 3: the worker chunk loads with no `document` and answers the docs `<br>` and the chord flood, the docs chrome is in the built stylesheet, the precache count and the main chunk's size against `BASE`).

- [ ] **Step 1: The suites (section 7.9).** Write the suite runner to `<SCRATCH>/tools/w5p1-suites.py`:

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The W5 part 1 suites (the plan's Task 14, Steps 1 and 5). Scratch only: never committed.

  python3 w5p1-suites.py SCRATCH --list          print the table: every suite and its command
  python3 w5p1-suites.py SCRATCH --next          run the next suites that have no log yet (the closing one excepted)
  python3 w5p1-suites.py SCRATCH ID [ID ...]     run those suites, in the foreground, one after another
  python3 w5p1-suites.py SCRATCH --rerun ID      run a red suite again, ALONE, into its .rerun.log

Run from the worktree root. The whole hermetic PWA suite runs as three `--shard` pieces, each of which fits one
600 s call; once every suite has run, `--next` writes SCRATCH/w5p1-shards.txt, which says whether the three
pieces' `Test Files` totals add up to the hermetic file count `vitest list --filesOnly` prints (no file lost, none
run twice). The browser leg runs with CCRC_CHROME set from SCRATCH/w5p1-chrome (Step 0 writes it); an empty or
missing file leaves it unset, and the leg is then red, never skipped. Suite 11 (plan-pins-after) runs only by its
ID, after the results section is written. A suite with an expected file count is wrong (rc=125) when it is green
and vitest's `Test Files` total differs from that count; the contrast gate is wrong (rc=125) when it exits 0 and
prints no `ALL <n> PASS` line.

`--next` starts the first suite with no log, then another only while it has run at most NEXT_START_S seconds, so
one invocation ends inside a 600 s tool call; repeat it until it prints `SUITES: <n> of <n> run`. A suite's FIRST
log is its first run, which the wave-done's `suite:` line reads. `--rerun` of a PWA shard runs only the files its
first log names in a FAIL line (the whole shard after a timeout or a count mismatch), one file at a time
(`--no-file-parallelism`); of any other suite, the same command again.

Each run writes SCRATCH/w5p1-suite-<ID>-<name>.log: the command on its first line, the output with colour codes
stripped, then `files=<n>` where a count is expected, `seconds=<n>` and `rc=<n>`; it prints vitest's `Test Files`
and `Tests` lines (the gate's `ALL <n> PASS`), every FAIL line, the seconds and the rc. Every PWA run sets CI=1 (the
golden test never writes a missing snapshot file under CI) and removes CCRC_SW_DENYLIST from the environment (the
vite config, which vitest loads, refuses an entry covering /docs). A suite marked `fetch` runs `git fetch -q origin
main` once first. A suite that outlives SUITE_TIMEOUT_S is killed with its process group (its own, recorded at
spawn: never a pattern) and recorded as rc=124. Exit 0 only when every suite run is rc 0.
"""
import json, os, re, signal, subprocess, sys, time

SUITE_TIMEOUT_S = 540
NEXT_START_S = 25
VITEST = ['./node_modules/.bin/vitest', 'run']
TSC = ['node', 'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc', '--noEmit', '-p', 'tsconfig.json']
PINS = ['test/topology-clean.test.ts', 'test/source-bytes.test.ts', 'test/deviation-refs.test.ts', 'test/dtbd.test.ts']
# (id, name, package, argv, expected: a file count, 'gate', 'shard' or None, fetch first)
NAMED = [
    ('01', 'pwa-tsc', 'pwa', TSC, None, False),
    ('02', 'contrast-gate', 'pwa', ['node', 'design/contrast-check.mjs'], 'gate', False),
    ('03', 'pwa-shard-1', 'pwa', VITEST + ['--shard=1/3'], 'shard', False),
    ('04', 'pwa-shard-2', 'pwa', VITEST + ['--shard=2/3'], 'shard', False),
    ('05', 'pwa-shard-3', 'pwa', VITEST + ['--shard=3/3'], 'shard', False),
    ('06', 'browser-leg', 'pwa', VITEST + ['--config', 'vitest.browser.config.ts'], 1, False),
    ('07', 'docs-l0', 'server', VITEST + [
        'test/docs-shared.test.ts', 'test/single-definition.test.ts', 'test/docs-parity.test.ts',
        'test/ci-pipeline.test.ts'], 4, False),
    ('08', 'text-scans', 'server', VITEST + [
        'test/docs-url.test.ts', 'test/docs-grammar.test.ts', 'test/ci-merge-queue.test.ts', 'test/ci-verdict.test.ts',
        'test/oss-metadata.test.ts', 'test/license.test.ts', 'test/node-floor.test.ts', 'test/run-routes.test.ts',
        'test/no-routing-keystroke-from-server.test.ts', 'test/pane-history-route.test.ts',
        'test/resume-reclaim-l0.test.ts', 'test/child-reclaim-attention-arms.test.ts'], 12, False),
    ('09', 'typecheck-tests', 'server', VITEST + ['test/typecheck-tests.test.ts'], 1, False),
    ('10', 'plan-pins', 'server', VITEST + PINS, 4, True),
    ('11', 'plan-pins-after', 'server', VITEST + PINS, 4, True),
]
AFTER = '11'
SHARDS = ['03', '04', '05']
ANSI = re.compile(r'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]')
FAIL_FILE = re.compile(r'^\s*FAIL\s+(test/\S+?\.test(?:-d)?\.tsx?)\b', re.M)


def chrome(scratch):
    p = os.path.join(scratch, 'w5p1-chrome')
    return open(p, encoding='utf-8').read().strip() if os.path.exists(p) else ''


def suites():
    """id -> (id, name, pkg, argv, fetch, expected, shown command)."""
    table = {}
    for i, name, pkg, argv, want, fetch in NAMED:
        pre = ('CI=1 ' if pkg == 'pwa' else '') + ('CCRC_CHROME="$(cat <SCRATCH>/w5p1-chrome)" ' if i == '06' else '')
        shown = '( cd %s && %s%s )' % (pkg, pre, ' '.join(("'%s'" % a) if ' ' in a else a for a in argv))
        table[i] = (i, name, pkg, argv, fetch, want, shown)
    return table


def log_path(scratch, s, rerun):
    return os.path.join(scratch, 'w5p1-suite-%s-%s%s.log' % (s[0], s[1], '.rerun' if rerun else ''))


FETCHED = []


def fetch_once():
    if FETCHED:
        return
    f = subprocess.run(['git', 'fetch', '-q', 'origin', 'main'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if f.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit('w5p1-suites.py: git fetch origin main failed: %s' % f.stderr.strip())
    FETCHED.append(True)


def env_for(scratch, sid, pkg):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.pop('CCRC_SW_DENYLIST', None)
    env.pop('CCRC_CHROME', None)
    if pkg == 'pwa':
        env['CI'] = '1'
    if sid == '06' and chrome(scratch):
        env['CCRC_CHROME'] = chrome(scratch)
    return env


def last_total(out, label):
    got = re.findall(r'^\s*%s\s+.*\((\d+)\)\s*$' % label, out, re.M)
    return int(got[-1]) if got else None


def run(scratch, s, rerun):
    sid, name, pkg, argv, fetch, want, shown = s
    if rerun and sid in SHARDS:
        first = open(log_path(scratch, s, False), encoding='utf-8').read() \
            if os.path.exists(log_path(scratch, s, False)) else None
        if first is None:
            sys.exit('w5p1-suites.py: %s has no first run to re-run' % sid)
        only = sorted(set(FAIL_FILE.findall(first)))
        argv = VITEST + ['--no-file-parallelism'] + (only if only and re.search(r'^rc=1$', first, re.M)
                                                     else argv[2:])
        want = len(only) if only and re.search(r'^rc=1$', first, re.M) else 'shard'
        shown = '( cd pwa && CI=1 %s )' % ' '.join(argv)
    if fetch:
        fetch_once()
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=pkg, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                         env=env_for(scratch, sid, pkg), start_new_session=True)
    try:
        raw, _ = p.communicate(timeout=SUITE_TIMEOUT_S)
        rc = p.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGKILL):
            try:
                os.killpg(p.pid, sig)
            except OSError:
                break
            time.sleep(3)
        raw, _ = p.communicate()
        rc = 124
    secs = int(time.monotonic() - t0)
    out = ANSI.sub('', raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
    if rc == 0 and isinstance(want, int):
        got = last_total(out, 'Test Files')
        if got != want:
            out += '\nw5p1-suites.py: vitest ran %s files, the suite holds %d\n' % (got, want)
            rc = 125
    if rc == 0 and want == 'gate' and not re.search(r'^ALL \d+ PASS$', out, re.M):
        out += '\nw5p1-suites.py: the contrast gate printed no ALL <n> PASS line\n'
        rc = 125
    with open(log_path(scratch, s, rerun), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        fh.write('$ %s\n%s\n%sseconds=%d\nrc=%d\n' % (shown, out.rstrip('\n'),
                 ('files=%d\n' % want) if isinstance(want, int) else '', secs, rc))
    print('== %s %s%s: %s' % (sid, name, ' (re-run alone)' if rerun else '', shown))
    ts = [l.strip() for l in out.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\S+\(\d+,\d+\): error TS\d+', l)]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if re.match(r'^\s*(Test Files|Tests)\s', line) or re.match(r'^\s*FAIL\s', line) or \
                re.match(r'^(ALL \d+ PASS|FAIL\s)', line) or line.startswith('w5p1-suites.py:'):
            print('   ' + line.strip()[:300])
    for line in ts[:5]:
        print('   ' + line[:300])
    if len(ts) > 5:
        print('   (%d more compiler errors in the log)' % (len(ts) - 5))
    print('   %ds rc=%d' % (secs, rc))
    return rc


def shard_check(scratch, table):
    """One line: do the three shards' file totals add up to the hermetic file count? A shard's total is its first
    run's (`Test Files` counts failed files too), or, when that run printed none (a timeout), its re-run's, but only
    when the re-run ran the whole shard again."""
    totals = []
    for sid in SHARDS:
        s = table[sid]
        t = last_total(open(log_path(scratch, s, False), encoding='utf-8').read(), 'Test Files')
        again = log_path(scratch, s, True)
        if t is None and os.path.exists(again):
            text = open(again, encoding='utf-8').read()
            t = last_total(text, 'Test Files') if '--shard=' in text.splitlines()[0] else None
        totals.append(t)
    env = env_for(scratch, '03', 'pwa')
    lst = subprocess.run(VITEST[:1] + ['list', '--filesOnly', '--json'], cwd='pwa', capture_output=True, text=True,
                         env=env, timeout=300)
    listed = len(re.findall(r'"file"\s*:', lst.stdout))
    ok = None not in totals and sum(totals) == listed and listed > 0
    line = '%s pwa shards: %s = %s test files; `vitest list --filesOnly` holds %d hermetic files' % (
        'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH', ' + '.join(str(t) for t in totals),
        sum(totals) if None not in totals else '?', listed)
    open(os.path.join(scratch, 'w5p1-shards.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(line + '\n')
    return line


if len(sys.argv) < 3:
    sys.exit(__doc__)
SCRATCH = sys.argv[1]
if not os.path.isdir(SCRATCH):
    sys.exit('w5p1-suites.py: %s is not a directory' % SCRATCH)
if not os.path.isdir('server/test') or not os.path.isdir('pwa/test'):
    sys.exit('w5p1-suites.py: run me from the worktree root')
TABLE = suites()
ORDER = [i for i in TABLE if i != AFTER]
if sys.argv[2] == '--list':
    for s in TABLE.values():
        print('%-3s %-18s %s%s' % (s[0], s[1], s[6], '   [fetch]' if s[4] else ''))
    print('%d suites (%d before the results, 1 after); browser leg Chrome: %s'
          % (len(TABLE), len(ORDER), chrome(SCRATCH) or 'NONE RECORDED'))
    sys.exit(0)
if sys.argv[2] == '--next':
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    rcs = []
    for sid in ORDER:
        if os.path.exists(log_path(SCRATCH, TABLE[sid], False)):
            continue
        if rcs and time.monotonic() - t0 > NEXT_START_S:
            break
        rcs.append(run(SCRATCH, TABLE[sid], False))
    done = [i for i in ORDER if os.path.exists(log_path(SCRATCH, TABLE[i], False))]
    print('SUITES: %d of %d run' % (len(done), len(ORDER)))
    if len(done) == len(ORDER):
        print(shard_check(SCRATCH, TABLE))
    sys.exit(0 if all(rc == 0 for rc in rcs) else 1)
rerun = sys.argv[2] == '--rerun'
ids = sys.argv[3:] if rerun else sys.argv[2:]
if rerun and len(ids) != 1:
    sys.exit('w5p1-suites.py: --rerun takes exactly one ID')
for i in ids:
    if i not in TABLE:
        sys.exit('w5p1-suites.py: no suite %s (try --list)' % i)
rcs = [run(SCRATCH, TABLE[i], rerun) for i in ids]
if rerun and ids[0] in SHARDS and all(os.path.exists(log_path(SCRATCH, TABLE[i], False)) for i in ORDER):
    print(shard_check(SCRATCH, TABLE))
sys.exit(0 if all(rc == 0 for rc in rcs) else 1)
````

Then, one Bash call per line; repeat the second until it prints `SUITES: 10 of 10 run` and the shard line:

SCRATCH="$HOME/.cc-tmp/docs-w5p1-t14"; python3 "$SCRATCH/tools/w5p1-suites.py" "$SCRATCH" --next

Green means the branch names no real host, project, user or path, carries no raw control byte, defines no allocator-era number another plan on this branch or `origin/main` defines, and carries no to-be-allocated token.
- At the end: `SUITES: 10 of 10 run`, then ``OK pwa shards: 50 + 50 + 49 = 149 test files; `vitest list --filesOnly` holds 149 hermetic files``.

The full server suite is not run here: part 1 edits `pwa/package.json`, the lock, `pwa/tsconfig.json`, a vitest config and `.github/`, so this pull request's CI runs it in full (section 7.9), and the review reads while it runs.

**A red suite.** Re-run it ALONE once, `SCRATCH="$HOME/.cc-tmp/docs-w5p1-t14"; python3 "$SCRATCH/tools/w5p1-suites.py" "$SCRATCH" --rerun <ID>` (a red shard re-runs only the files its log names in a `FAIL` line, one file at a time; it writes the `.rerun.log` beside the first, and the results table shows both rcs). Then:
- **Green alone:** a load flake (Global Constraints' lesson 11 list: `contrast.test.ts`'s spawned-gate cases, `markdown-highlight.test.tsx`'s 65 536-character cases, `typecheck-tests`, `fleet-screen`, `session-pickers`, `start-program`, `header.test.tsx`, any case that timed out, a `Failed to start forks worker`). Add one line to `<SCRATCH>/w5p1-notes.md`: `- suite <ID> <name>: red on the first run (<the FAIL line>), green re-run alone; a load flake.` It still counts as a red FIRST run: the wave-done's `suite:` line says what the first complete run said (worker skill clause 15).
- **Red alone, in a file W5.1 touched** (any file Step 2's `scope` invariant lists): a finding (Step 4's last paragraph), and this task stops there.
- **Red alone, in a file W5.1 did not touch:** run the same file at the BASE, in a copy (one Bash call; `<pkg>` is `server` or `pwa`, `<file>` the `test/<name>` the `FAIL` line names):

```bash
SCRATCH="$HOME/.cc-tmp/docs-w5p1-t14"; rm -rf "$SCRATCH/base-copy" && mkdir "$SCRATCH/base-copy" && git archive "$(cat "$SCRATCH/w5p1-base")" | tar -x -C "$SCRATCH/base-copy" && git -C "$SCRATCH/base-copy" init -q && for p in server agent pwa; do ln -s "$PWD/$p/node_modules" "$SCRATCH/base-copy/$p/node_modules"; done && ( cd "$SCRATCH/base-copy/<pkg>" && env -u CCRC_SW_DENYLIST CI=1 ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run <file> )
```

  Red there too: it is `main-red`, not W5.1's (worker skill clause 16: reported once and left alone). - [ ] **Step 2: The invariants, net against the base.** Write the checker to `<SCRATCH>/tools/w5p1-invariants.py`:

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The W5 part 1 invariants (the plan's Task 14, Step 2). Scratch only: never committed. Read-only.

  python3 w5p1-invariants.py BASE BLOCK      from the worktree root; BLOCK is the issued deviation block, LO-HI

W5.1's OWN edits are the union of its own commits, `git log --first-parent --no-merges BASE..HEAD` (scope). A file's
NET change is judged against REF: BASE, or, when the first-parent line merged origin/main in (a fix round may), the
second parent of the LAST such merge, so main's own edits never count as W5.1's. Every shape is NET (a review fix
that inserted lines inside an appended block is still one append), except `frozen`, which reads every W5.1 commit
alone. Prints one PASS/FAIL line per invariant and `<n> invariants, <n> PASS`; exit 0 only when all PASS.
"""
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys

if len(sys.argv) != 3 or not re.fullmatch(r'\d+-\d+', sys.argv[2]):
    sys.exit(__doc__)
BASE = sys.argv[1]
LO, HI = (int(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split('-'))
PLAN = 'docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-13-native-docs-reader-w5-part1-docs-screen.md'
W4PLAN = 'docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-09-native-docs-reader-w4-pwa-foundation.md'
DOCS_SRC = ['DocImage.tsx', 'DocLink.tsx', 'DocMarkdown.tsx', 'DocsBanners.tsx', 'DocsFailureView.tsx', 'DocsHead.tsx',
            'DocsIndexView.tsx', 'DocsLeaf.tsx', 'DocsTreeView.tsx', 'docs.css', 'docsLinks.ts', 'docsText.ts',
            'docsTree.ts', 'failures.ts', 'fetchQueue.ts', 'objectUrls.ts', 'share.ts', 'useDocsVisit.ts']
LIB = ['api.ts', 'markdown.tsx', 'markdownGuard.ts', 'markdownLimits.ts', 'markdownParse.ts', 'markdownWorker.ts',
       'useParsedMarkdown.ts']
PWA_TESTS = ['app-docs-boundary.test.tsx', 'app.test.tsx', 'browser-leg.test.ts', 'chat-hardening.test.tsx',
             'contrast.test.ts', 'docs-api.test.ts', 'docs-banners.test.tsx', 'docs-failures.test.tsx',
             'docs-highlight-budget.test.tsx', 'docs-images.test.tsx', 'docs-links.test.tsx', 'docs-markdown.test.tsx',
             'docs-object-urls.test.ts', 'docs-refresh.test.tsx', 'docs-scans.test.ts', 'docs-screen.test.tsx',
             'docs-tree.test.ts', 'docs-truth.test.tsx', 'docs-visit.test.tsx', 'docsFixtures.ts',
             'fleet-screen.test.tsx', 'markdown-bounds.test.tsx', 'markdown-limits.test.ts', 'markdown-parse.test.ts',
             'markdown-worker-built.test.ts', 'router-location.test.tsx', 'session-docs-link.test.tsx',
             'shell-css.test.ts', 'tap-targets.test.tsx', 'use-parsed-markdown.test.tsx']
SCOPE = set(['.github/workflows/ci.yml', W4PLAN, 'pwa/browser/docs-headers.browser.test.ts', 'pwa/browser/harness.ts',
             'pwa/design/audit.mjs', 'pwa/package-lock.json', 'pwa/package.json', 'pwa/src/app.tsx',
             'pwa/src/fleet/SessionActionsSheet.tsx', 'pwa/src/screens/DocsScreen.tsx',
             'pwa/src/screens/FleetScreen.tsx', 'pwa/src/session/SessionHeader.tsx', 'pwa/tsconfig.json',
             'pwa/vite.config.ts', 'pwa/vitest.browser.config.ts', 'server/test/ci-pipeline.test.ts',
             'server/test/docs-shared.test.ts', 'server/test/single-definition.test.ts', 'shared/docs.ts']
            + ['pwa/src/docs/' + f for f in DOCS_SRC] + ['pwa/src/lib/' + f for f in LIB]
            + ['pwa/test/' + f for f in PWA_TESTS])
FORBIDDEN = ['server/src', 'agent', 'ccd', 'deploy', 'README.md', 'CLAUDE.md', 'pwa/src/session/chat.css',
             'pwa/src/components/Sheet.tsx', 'pwa/index.html', 'pwa/src/lib/sw-denylist.ts',
             'server/test/docs-parity.test.ts']
FROZEN = ['pwa/test/golden', 'pwa/test/markdownCorpus.ts', 'pwa/test/markdown-golden.test.tsx',
          'pwa/test/message-links.test.tsx']
FIVE = ['unified', 'remark-parse', 'remark-rehype', 'hast-util-to-jsx-runtime', 'html-url-attributes']
SINGLE = 'server/test/single-definition.test.ts'
SHARED_TEST = 'server/test/docs-shared.test.ts'
API = 'pwa/src/lib/api.ts'
VITE = 'pwa/vite.config.ts'
CI = '.github/workflows/ci.yml'
DOCS_NAME = 'pwa/src/docs/docsText.ts'


def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['git'] + list(a), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def show(rev, path):
    """The file's text at rev, or None when rev has no such file."""
    p = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', '%s:%s' % (rev, path)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return p.stdout if p.returncode == 0 else None


def head(path):
    return open(path, encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.isfile(path) else ''


results = []


def check(name, ok, answer):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print('%s %-13s %s' % ('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', name, answer))


def hunks(path):
    """[(a, b, c, d, minus lines, plus lines)] of `git diff -U0 REF HEAD -- path`."""
    out = []
    patch = git('diff', '-U0', REF, 'HEAD', '--', path)
    parts = re.split(r'^(@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+\d+(?:,\d+)? @@.*)$', patch, flags=re.M)
    for i in range(1, len(parts), 2):
        m = re.match(r'@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@', parts[i])
        body = parts[i + 1].splitlines()
        out.append((int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2) or 1), int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(4) or 1),
                    [l[1:] for l in body if l.startswith('-')], [l[1:] for l in body if l.startswith('+')]))
    return out


def spans(hs):
    return ['-%d,%d +%d,%d' % h[:4] for h in hs] or 'none'


def headings(text):
    """(offset, heading) of every `## ` line OUTSIDE a fenced block: Task 12's text quotes a `## Deviations found`
    heading inside its template fence, and Task 14's tools spell headings inside theirs."""
    out, fence, at = [], None, 0
    for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
        m = re.match(r'^(`{3,}|~{3,})', line)
        if m:
            if fence is None:
                fence = m.group(1)
            elif m.group(1)[0] == fence[0] and len(m.group(1)) >= len(fence) and line.strip() == m.group(1):
                fence = None
        elif fence is None and line.startswith('## '):
            out.append((at, line.rstrip('\n')))
        at += len(line)
    return out


def section(text, name):
    """The text of the one `## <name>` section outside fences (to the next such heading), or None."""
    marks = headings(text)
    found = [i for i, (_at, h) in enumerate(marks) if h == '## ' + name]
    if len(found) != 1:
        return None
    i = found[0]
    return text[marks[i][0]:marks[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(marks) else len(text)]


def inside(h, lo, hi):
    """Does hunk h change or insert only strictly between REF lines lo and hi (1-based)?"""
    a, b = h[0], h[1]
    return lo <= a < hi if b == 0 else lo < a and a + b - 1 < hi


merges = git('rev-list', '--first-parent', '--merges', '%s..HEAD' % BASE).split()
REF = git('rev-parse', merges[0] + '^2').strip() if merges else git('rev-parse', BASE).strip()
commits = git('rev-list', '--first-parent', '--no-merges', '%s..HEAD' % BASE).split()
touched = set(l for l in git('log', '--first-parent', '--no-merges', '--format=', '--name-only',
                                '%s..HEAD' % BASE).splitlines() if l)
print('base %s, ref %s, tip %s, %d W5.1 commits, %d merges of main' % (
    git('rev-parse', '--short=12', BASE).strip(), REF[:12], git('rev-parse', '--short=12', 'HEAD').strip(),
    len(commits), len(merges)))

subjects = [git('log', '-1', '--format=%s', c).strip() for c in commits]
odd = [s for s in subjects if not re.search(r' \(docs W5\.1( review)?\)$', s)]
check('subjects', commits and not odd, '%d first-parent commits since the base; subjects not ending (docs W5.1) or '
      '(docs W5.1 review): %s' % (len(commits), odd or 'none'))

extra = sorted(touched - SCOPE - {PLAN})
missing = sorted(SCOPE - touched)
check('scope', not extra and not missing, '%d files touched by W5.1 commits (this plan among them: %s); outside the '
      'scope: %s; scope files untouched: %s' % (len(touched), PLAN in touched, extra or 'none', missing or 'none'))

moved = sorted(set(git('diff', '--name-only', REF, 'HEAD', '--', *FORBIDDEN).split()))
check('untouched', not moved, 'server/src/, agent/, ccd/, deploy/, README.md, CLAUDE.md, chat.css, Sheet.tsx, '
      'index.html, sw-denylist.ts, docs-parity.test.ts changed vs ref: %s' % (moved or 'none'))

per_commit = [c[:12] for c in commits
              if subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', c + '^', c, '--', *FROZEN]).returncode != 0]
net = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', REF, 'HEAD', '--', *FROZEN]).returncode == 0
n_golden = len([f for f in git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'HEAD', 'pwa/test/golden/markdown').split()
                if f.endswith('.html')])
check('frozen', not per_commit and net, '%d golden files; golden files, the corpus, the golden test and '
      'message-links changed by a W5.1 commit: %s; net vs ref: %s' % (n_golden, per_commit or 'none',
                                                                       'unchanged' if net else 'CHANGED'))

sh = hunks(SINGLE)
ref_single = show(REF, SINGLE).count('\n')
named = [h for h in sh if h[1] == 1 and h[3] == 1 and len(h[4]) == 1 and len(h[5]) == 1 and any(
    h[5][0].replace(x, '', 1) == h[4][0] for x in (", `%s`" % DOCS_NAME, "'%s', " % DOCS_NAME))]
eof = [h for h in sh if h[1] == 0 and h[0] == ref_single]
other = [h for h in sh if h not in named and h not in eof]
check('single-def', len(named) == 2 and len(eof) == 1 and not other,
      '%s vs ref (%d lines): %d line(s) naming docsText.ts beside worktree-gone in place, %d EOF append (%s lines), '
      'other hunks: %s' % (SINGLE, ref_single, len(named), len(eof), eof[0][3] if eof else 0, spans(other)))

ref_st = show(REF, SHARED_TEST).splitlines()
opened = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_st) if l == "  describe('githubBlobUrl (spec 3.11; M3.11)', () => {"),
              None)
closed = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_st) if opened and i + 1 > opened and l == '  });'), None)
th = hunks(SHARED_TEST)
eof = [h for h in th if h[1] == 0 and h[0] == len(ref_st)]
bad = [h for h in th if h not in eof and not (opened and closed and inside(h, opened, closed))]
check('shared-test', opened and closed and len(eof) <= 1 and not bad,
      '%s: the M3.11 describe spans ref lines %s-%s; %d hunks inside it, %d EOF append; other hunks: %s'
      % (SHARED_TEST, opened, closed, len(th) - len(eof) - len(bad), len(eof), spans(bad)))

ref_sd = show(REF, 'shared/docs.ts').splitlines()
h_at = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_sd) if l.startswith('// (H) ')), None)
i_at = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_sd) if l.startswith('// (I) ')), None)
dh = hunks('shared/docs.ts')
bad = [h for h in dh if not (h_at and i_at and inside(h, h_at, i_at - 1))]
check('section-h', h_at and i_at and dh and not bad,
      'shared/docs.ts: section H spans ref lines %s-%s; %d hunks inside it; other hunks: %s'
      % (h_at, (i_at - 2) if i_at else None, len(dh) - len(bad), spans(bad)))

ref_api = show(REF, API).splitlines()
cls = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_api) if l.startswith('export class ApiError ')), None)
cls_end = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_api) if cls and i + 1 > cls and l == '}'), None)
mk = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(ref_api) if l.startswith('export function createApi(')), None)
IMPORT_LINE = re.compile(r"^(import \{|  [\w ,]+,?|\} from '[./\w-]+';)$")
kinds = {'imports': [], 'apierror': [], 'throw': [], 'docs-block': [], 'other': []}
for h in hunks(API):
    if cls and h[1] == 0 and h[0] < cls and all(IMPORT_LINE.match(l) for l in h[5]):
        kinds['imports'].append(h)
    elif cls and cls_end and inside(h, cls - 1, cls_end + 1):
        kinds['apierror'].append(h)
    elif h[1] == 1 and h[3] == 1 and h[4] == ['      throw new ApiError(res.status, body);'] and \
            h[5] == ["      throw new ApiError(res.status, body, res.headers.get('content-type'));"]:
        kinds['throw'].append(h)
    elif mk and h[1] == 0 and h[0] > mk and any(l.strip() == 'docs: ((): DocsLoaders => {' for l in h[5]):
        kinds['docs-block'].append(h)
    else:
        kinds['other'].append(h)
check('api', kinds['apierror'] and len(kinds['throw']) == 1 and len(kinds['docs-block']) == 1 and not kinds['other'],
      '%s vs ref: %s' % (API, ', '.join('%s %d' % (k, len(v)) for k, v in kinds.items())
                         + ('; other hunks: %s' % spans(kinds['other']) if kinds['other'] else '')))


def json_paths(a, b, at=()):
    """Every path where two parsed JSON values differ."""
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        out = []
        for k in sorted(set(a) | set(b)):
            if k not in a or k not in b:
                out.append(at + (k,))
            else:
                out += json_paths(a[k], b[k], at + (k,))
        return out
    return [] if a == b else [at]


ref_pkg, tip_pkg = json.loads(show(REF, 'pwa/package.json')), json.loads(head('pwa/package.json'))
pkg_diff = json_paths(ref_pkg, tip_pkg)
pw = tip_pkg.get('devDependencies', {}).get('playwright-core', '')
keep = lambda t: [l for l in t.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\s*"(engines|%s)":' % '|'.join(map(re.escape, FIVE)), l)]
pins_kept = keep(show(REF, 'pwa/package.json')) == keep(head('pwa/package.json')) and len(keep(head('pwa/package.json'))) == 6
check('manifest', sorted(pkg_diff) == [('devDependencies', 'playwright-core'), ('scripts', 'test:browser')]
      and re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', pw) and pins_kept,
      'pwa/package.json differs at %s; playwright-core %r; engines and the five W4 pins byte-equal: %s'
      % (['/'.join(p) for p in pkg_diff] or 'nothing', pw, pins_kept))

ref_lock, tip_lock = json.loads(show(REF, 'pwa/package-lock.json')), json.loads(head('pwa/package-lock.json'))
lock_diff = json_paths(ref_lock, tip_lock)
want = [('packages', '', 'devDependencies', 'playwright-core'), ('packages', 'node_modules/playwright-core')]
lock_ver = tip_lock.get('packages', {}).get('node_modules/playwright-core', {}).get('version')
check('lock', sorted(lock_diff) == sorted(want) and lock_ver == pw,
      'pwa/package-lock.json differs from ref at %s; it installs playwright-core %s' % (
          ['/'.join(k or '""' for k in p) for p in lock_diff] or 'nothing', lock_ver))

nav = lambda t: [l for l in t.splitlines() if 'navigateFallbackDenylist' in l]
check('vite-line', len(nav(head(VITE))) == 1 and nav(show(REF, VITE)) == nav(head(VITE)),
      'the navigateFallbackDenylist line, byte-equal to ref: %s' % (nav(head(VITE)) or 'absent'))

ci = {'job': [], 'needs': [], 'results': [], 'comment': [], 'other': []}
for h in hunks(CI):
    if h[1] == 0 and h[5].count('  browser-pwa:') == 1 and all(l == '' or l.startswith('  ') for l in h[5]):
        ci['job'].append(h)
    elif h[1] == 1 and h[3] == 1 and h[4][0].startswith('    needs: [') and h[5][0] == h[4][0][:-1] + ', browser-pwa]':
        ci['needs'].append(h)
    elif h[1] == 1 and h[3] == 1 and h[4][0].lstrip().startswith('RESULTS: ') and \
            h[5][0] == h[4][0] + ' browser-pwa=${{ needs.browser-pwa.result }}':
        ci['results'].append(h)
    elif h[4] and h[5] and all(re.match(r'^\s*#', l) for l in h[4] + h[5]):
        ci['comment'].append(h)
    else:
        ci['other'].append(h)
check('ci', len(ci['job']) == 1 and len(ci['needs']) == 1 and len(ci['results']) == 1 and len(ci['comment']) <= 1
      and not ci['other'], '%s vs ref: %s' % (CI, ', '.join('%s %d' % (k, len(v)) for k, v in ci.items())
                                              + ('; other hunks: %s' % spans(ci['other']) if ci['other'] else '')))

w4 = hunks(W4PLAN)
bad = [h for h in w4 if not (h[1] == 1 and h[3] == 1 and h[4][0].startswith('  "red": "')
                             and h[5][0].startswith('  "red": "'))]
check('w4-plan', w4 and not bad, '%s: %d row `red` line(s) re-measured in place; other hunks: %s'
      % (W4PLAN, len(w4) - len(bad), spans(bad)))

css = lambda rev: sorted(f for f in git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', rev, 'pwa').split() if f.endswith('.css'))
added, removed = sorted(set(css('HEAD')) - set(css(REF))), sorted(set(css(REF)) - set(css('HEAD')))
check('stylesheets', added == ['pwa/src/docs/docs.css'] and not removed,
      'pwa/**/*.css: %d at ref, %d at the tip, added %s, removed %s' % (len(css(REF)), len(css('HEAD')), added or 'none',
                                                                       removed or 'none'))


def files_under(*roots):
    return [f for f in git('ls-files', '--', *roots).split() if os.path.isfile(f)]


src = dict((f, head(f)) for f in files_under('pwa/src'))
NEVER = ['navigator.share(', 'react-dom/server', '?inline', '<iframe', 'srcDoc']
never = sorted('%s: %s' % (f, w) for f, t in src.items() for w in NEVER if w in t)
blob_files = sorted(f for f, t in src.items()
                    if (f.startswith('pwa/src/docs/') or f.startswith('pwa/src/lib/markdown'))
                    and ('URL.createObjectURL(' in t or 'new Blob(' in t))
messages = sorted(f for f, t in src.items() if f.startswith('pwa/src/docs/') and ('postMessage(' in t
                                                                                  or "'message'" in t))
check('spellings', not never and blob_files == ['pwa/src/docs/objectUrls.ts'] and not messages,
      'pwa/src: %s; createObjectURL/new Blob under docs and lib/markdown* only in %s; postMessage or a message '
      'listener under docs: %s' % ((', '.join(never) or 'no navigator.share(, react-dom/server, ?inline, <iframe or '
                                    'srcDoc'), blob_files or 'none', messages or 'none'))

plan = head(PLAN)
dev = section(plan, 'Deviations found')
heads = [h for _at, h in headings(plan) if h == '## Deviations found']
defs = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^- \*\*D-(\d+) \(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\)\*\* — ', dev or '', re.M)]
loose = [l for l in (dev or '').splitlines() if re.match(r'^- \*\*D-', l)
         and not re.match(r'^- \*\*D-\d+ \(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\)\*\* — ', l)]
check('deviations', len(heads) == 1 and len(defs) >= 5 and not loose and defs == list(range(LO, LO + len(defs)))
      and defs[-1] <= HI, '## Deviations found x%d outside fences; defined %s (issued %d-%d; the first %d expected in '
      'order); malformed definition lines: %d' % (len(heads), ['D-%d' % n for n in defs] or 'none', LO, HI,
                                                  len(defs), len(loose)))

TOKEN = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])D-\d+')
new_tokens = {}
for f in sorted(set(git('diff', '--name-only', REF, 'HEAD').split()) - {PLAN}):
    before = show(REF, f) or ''
    if not os.path.isfile(f):
        continue
    for h in hunks(f):
        for line in h[5]:
            for tok in TOKEN.findall(line):
                if tok not in before:
                    new_tokens.setdefault(f, set()).add(tok)
outside = plan.replace(dev, '') if dev else plan
plan_tokens = sorted(set(TOKEN.findall(outside)))
check('no-d-number', not new_tokens and not plan_tokens,
      'D-<n> tokens new in W5.1 files: %s; in this plan outside ## Deviations found: %s' % (
          dict((k, sorted(v)) for k, v in new_tokens.items()) or 'none', plan_tokens or 'none'))

print('%d invariants, %d PASS' % (len(results), sum(results)))
sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)
````

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The build gate (spec section 7.7's W5 row, Global Constraints' lesson 10; the plan's Task 14, Step 3). Scratch
only: never committed.

  python3 w5p1-gate.py SCRATCH BASE copy [--link]   two `git archive` copies, SCRATCH/gate-base and SCRATCH/gate-tip,
                                                     each with `git init` and its own `npm ci` in pwa/ (--link: the
                                                     worktree's pwa/node_modules linked instead; planning only)
  python3 w5p1-gate.py SCRATCH BASE build base|tip   `npm run build` in that copy's pwa/ (NODE_ENV=production,
                                                     CCRC_SW_DENYLIST unset), then what the bundle holds
  python3 w5p1-gate.py SCRATCH BASE check            the verdicts, into SCRATCH/w5p1-gate.txt

Run from the worktree root; nothing is built or installed inside it (`npm run build` writes ../server/dist-pwa, so
it only ever runs in a copy). `git init` in each copy is load-bearing: without a repository Tailwind's source
detection ignores no .gitignore and scans node_modules through the link, and the stylesheet grows. `build` records
into SCRATCH/gate-<which>.json: the rc; the emitted `assets/markdownWorker-*.js` and how many times sw.js names it;
the number of `denylist:[` in sw.js; the precache entries (`{url:"...",revision:...}`), each also with its content
hash stripped; the bytes of every `assets/index-*.js` and `assets/index-*.css`; the docs chrome in the built
stylesheet (the counts Task 11's check reads); any built file naming playwright or the browser harness; and what
the BUILT worker answers, loaded in a plain `node` child with a stub `self` and no `document` (the loader of
markdown-worker-built.test.ts): a docs job and a chat job of `a<br>b`, and a docs job of 400 spans of a 31-plus
chord. `copy` records HEAD in SCRATCH/gate-head, and `check` fails `measured-at` when HEAD has moved since. `check`
prints one PASS/FAIL line per gate item and `<n> gate checks, <n> PASS`; exit 0 only when all PASS.
"""
import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys

TIMEOUT_S = 540
FLOOD = ' '.join(['`' + 'a+' * 31 + 'a`'] * 400)
FLOOD_ELEMENTS = 1 + 400 * 64
LOADER = r"""
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const [chunk, jobsJson] = process.argv.slice(1);
const replies = [];
globalThis.self = { postMessage: (r) => replies.push(r) };
const report = (o) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(o) + '\n');
try {
  await import(pathToFileURL(chunk).href);
} catch (e) {
  report({ load: 'threw', message: String(e?.message).slice(0, 200), document: typeof document });
  process.exit(0);
}
if (typeof self.onmessage !== 'function') { report({ load: 'no-onmessage' }); process.exit(0); }
for (const job of JSON.parse(jobsJson)) {
  self.onmessage({ data: job });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
}
report({ load: 'ok', document: typeof document, replies });
"""
JOBS = [{'id': 1, 'profile': 'docs', 'src': 'a<br>b'}, {'id': 2, 'profile': 'chat', 'src': 'a<br>b'},
        {'id': 3, 'profile': 'docs', 'src': FLOOD}]


def die(msg):
    print('w5p1-gate.py: ' + msg, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)


if len(sys.argv) < 4:
    die(__doc__)
S, BASE, CMD = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
if not os.path.isdir('pwa') or not os.path.isdir('server/test'):
    die('run me from the worktree root')
COPY = {'base': os.path.join(S, 'gate-base'), 'tip': os.path.join(S, 'gate-tip')}


def env():
    e = dict(os.environ)
    e.pop('CCRC_SW_DENYLIST', None)
    e['NODE_ENV'] = 'production'
    return e


def sh(argv, cwd, e=None, timeout=TIMEOUT_S):
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=e or env(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as t:
        return 124, t.stdout or '', t.stderr or ''


def strip_hash(u):
    return re.sub(r'-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8}(\.[a-z]+)$', r'\1', u)


def worker_answers(chunk):
    """What the built worker answers to JOBS, from a plain node child (no document): a summary per job."""
    rc, out, err = sh(['node', '--input-type=module', '-e', LOADER, chunk, json.dumps(JOBS)], S,
                      {'PATH': os.environ.get('PATH', '')}, 120)
    try:
        r = json.loads(out.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        return {'load': 'no-answer', 'rc': rc, 'stderr': err[-400:]}
    got = {'load': r.get('load'), 'document': r.get('document')}
    for reply in r.get('replies', []):
        o = reply.get('outcome', {})
        text = json.dumps(o.get('tree')) if o.get('kind') == 'tree' else ''
        got[str(reply.get('id'))] = {'kind': o.get('kind'), 'elements': o.get('elements'),
                                     'br': text.count('"tagName": "br"'), 'brText': text.count('"value": "<br>"')}
    return got


def measure(which):
    dist = os.path.join(COPY[which], 'server', 'dist-pwa')
    assets = os.path.join(dist, 'assets')
    names = sorted(os.listdir(assets)) if os.path.isdir(assets) else []
    workers = ['assets/' + f for f in names if re.fullmatch(r'markdownWorker-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.js', f)]
    sw = open(os.path.join(dist, 'sw.js'), encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(dist, 'sw.js')) \
        else ''
    urls = re.findall(r'\{url:"([^"]+)",revision:', sw)
    size = lambda pat: dict((f, os.path.getsize(os.path.join(assets, f))) for f in names if re.fullmatch(pat, f))
    css = [open(os.path.join(assets, f), encoding='utf-8').read() for f in names if re.fullmatch(r'index-[\w-]+\.css', f)]
    t = css[0] if len(css) == 1 else ''
    n = lambda pat: len(re.findall(pat, t))
    files = []
    for d, _ds, fs in os.walk(dist):
        files += [os.path.join(d, f) for f in fs]
    hit = lambda pat: sorted(os.path.relpath(f, dist) for f in files
                             if re.search(pat, open(f, 'rb').read().decode('latin-1')))
    return {'workers': workers, 'workerNamed': [sw.count(w) for w in workers], 'denylists': sw.count('denylist:['),
            'precache': urls, 'precacheNames': sorted(strip_hash(u) for u in urls),
            'indexJs': size(r'index-[\w-]+\.js'), 'indexCss': size(r'index-[\w-]+\.css'), 'sheets': len(css),
            'chrome': {'door': n(r'\.docs-door\{[^}]*min-height:var\(--tap-min\)[^}]*\}'),
                       'doorActive': n(r'\.docs-door:active\{[^}]*color:var\(--ink-primary\)[^}]*\}'),
                       'fresh': n(r'\.docs-fresh\[data-state=[a-z]+\]'), 'docBody': n(r'\.doc-body[ .:{]')},
            'testCode': hit(r'playwright|resolveChrome|startOrigins|ccrc-marker'),
            'answers': worker_answers(os.path.join(dist, workers[0])) if len(workers) == 1 else None}


if CMD == 'copy':
    link = '--link' in sys.argv[4:]
    head_now = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    open(os.path.join(S, 'gate-head'), 'w').write(head_now)
    for which, rev in (('base', BASE), ('tip', 'HEAD')):
        d = COPY[which]
        if os.path.exists(d):
            shutil.rmtree(d)
        os.makedirs(d)
        tar = subprocess.run(['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', rev], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        subprocess.run(['tar', '-x', '-C', d], input=tar, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'init', '-q'], check=True)
        if link:
            os.symlink(os.path.realpath('pwa/node_modules'), os.path.join(d, 'pwa', 'node_modules'))
            print('%s: %s, pwa/node_modules linked (planning only)' % (which, rev[:12]))
        else:
            e = env()
            e.pop('NODE_ENV')
            rc, out, err = sh(['npm', 'ci', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], os.path.join(d, 'pwa'), e)
            print('%s: %s, npm ci rc=%d %s' % (which, rev[:12], rc, (out + err).strip().splitlines()[-1:]))
            if rc != 0:
                die('npm ci failed in the %s copy; stop and report' % which)
    sys.exit(0)

if CMD == 'build':
    which = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else ''
    if which not in COPY or not os.path.isdir(COPY[which]):
        die('build takes base or tip, after copy')
    rc, out, err = sh(['npm', 'run', 'build'], os.path.join(COPY[which], 'pwa'))
    open(os.path.join(S, 'gate-%s-build.log' % which), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(out + err + '\nrc=%d\n' % rc)
    m = dict(measure(which), rc=rc)
    json.dump(m, open(os.path.join(S, 'gate-%s.json' % which), 'w'), indent=1)
    print('%s build rc=%d; workers %s; %d precache entries; index js %s; index css %s; docs chrome %s; answers %s' % (
        which, rc, m['workers'] or 'none', len(m['precache']), sorted(m['indexJs'].values()),
        sorted(m['indexCss'].values()), m['chrome'], json.dumps(m['answers'])))
    sys.exit(0 if rc == 0 else 1)

if CMD == 'check':
    lines, oks = [], []

    def check(name, ok, answer):
        ok = bool(ok)
        oks.append(ok)
        lines.append('%s %-15s %s' % ('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', name, answer))

    try:
        b, t = (json.load(open(os.path.join(S, 'gate-%s.json' % w))) for w in ('base', 'tip'))
    except OSError as e:
        die('a gate step has not run (%s)' % e)
    at = open(os.path.join(S, 'gate-head')).read().strip()
    now = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    check('measured-at', at == now, 'the tip copy is HEAD %s; HEAD is %s' % (at[:12], now[:12]))
    check('builds', b['rc'] == 0 and t['rc'] == 0, 'npm run build rc: base %d, tip %d' % (b['rc'], t['rc']))
    check('worker-chunk', len(t['workers']) == 1 and len(b['workers']) == 1 and t['workerNamed'] == [1],
          'markdownWorker chunks: tip %s, named %s time(s) in sw.js; base %s' % (
              t['workers'] or 'none', t['workerNamed'] or 0, b['workers'] or 'none'))
    check('one-denylist', t['denylists'] == 1 and b['denylists'] == 1,
          'denylist:[ in sw.js: tip %d, base %d' % (t['denylists'], b['denylists']))
    added = sorted(set(t['precacheNames']) - set(b['precacheNames']))
    removed = sorted(set(b['precacheNames']) - set(t['precacheNames']))
    sz = lambda m, k: sum(m[k].values())
    check('precache', not added and not removed and len(t['precache']) == len(b['precache']),
          '%d entries at the base, %d at the tip; added %s; removed %s (no lazy chunk); index js %d -> %d bytes '
          '(%+d), index css %d -> %d bytes (%+d)' % (
              len(b['precache']), len(t['precache']), added or 'none', removed or 'none', sz(b, 'indexJs'),
              sz(t, 'indexJs'), sz(t, 'indexJs') - sz(b, 'indexJs'), sz(b, 'indexCss'), sz(t, 'indexCss'),
              sz(t, 'indexCss') - sz(b, 'indexCss')))
    c, bc = t['chrome'], b['chrome']
    check('docs-chrome', t['sheets'] == 1 and c['door'] == 1 and c['doorActive'] == 1 and c['fresh'] >= 1
          and c['docBody'] >= 1 and not any(bc.values()),
          'built index css (%d sheet): tip %s; base %s' % (t['sheets'], json.dumps(c), json.dumps(bc)))
    check('no-test-code', not t['testCode'], 'built files naming playwright or the browser harness: %s'
          % (t['testCode'] or 'none'))
    ta, ba = t['answers'] or {}, b['answers'] or {}
    one = lambda a, k: a.get(k) or {}
    tip_ok = (ta.get('load') == 'ok' and ta.get('document') == 'undefined'
              and one(ta, '1').get('kind') == 'tree' and one(ta, '1').get('br') == 1
              and one(ta, '2').get('kind') == 'tree' and one(ta, '2').get('br') == 0
              and one(ta, '2').get('brText') == 1
              and one(ta, '3') == {'kind': 'too-wide', 'elements': FLOOD_ELEMENTS, 'br': 0, 'brText': 0})
    base_differs = one(ba, '1').get('br') == 0 and one(ba, '3').get('kind') == 'tree'
    check('built-worker', tip_ok and base_differs,
          'tip: load %s, document %s; docs a<br>b %s; chat a<br>b %s; docs chord flood %s. base: docs a<br>b %s; '
          'chord flood %s' % (ta.get('load'), ta.get('document'), json.dumps(one(ta, '1')), json.dumps(one(ta, '2')),
                              json.dumps(one(ta, '3')), json.dumps(one(ba, '1')), json.dumps(one(ba, '3'))))
    lines.append('%d gate checks, %d PASS' % (len(oks), sum(oks)))
    open(os.path.join(S, 'w5p1-gate.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    print('\n'.join(lines))
    sys.exit(0 if all(oks) else 1)

die('unknown command %r' % CMD)
````
